```tsx
import { AUTOMATION_RULES, MEASURES, type CaseView, type RestoreGap, type RestoreView, type StaffMe } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_TEXTS, STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { newDraft, previewOf, programFinding, programStatementOf } from "../src/compose";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { CaseScreenView, type CaseScreenViewProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { ComposerView, type ComposerViewProps } from "../src/screens/Composer";
import { CustodyLines, OverviewView } from "../src/screens/Home";
import { marksOf } from "../src/screens/Queue";
import { RestoreScreen, type RestoreScreenProps } from "../src/screens/Restore";
import { bothTimes } from "../src/ui";
import { CASE_POST, IMAGE_ONE, NO_STANDING, SOURCES, decision, item, overview, postCase, queueRow } from "./case-fixtures";
import { HOSTILE } from "./fixtures";

/**
 * A program's finding and measure on the console (3d design, sections 8.2 to 8.4 and 8.7; Task 6), server-rendered: the
 * queue's three chips; Home's [home.automated] and [home.objected] with a link to each case, and a program's row on Home's
 * lists; on a case [case.r1] beside the item a score opened and never a score, a decision without a decider with the chip
 * in the place of a handle, [case.auto] with the statement its author was sent and [case.autoR1] while its withhold is in
 * force, the author's request for a person above the evidence, in a frame as the author's text; the composer's
 * [case.autoRecord] and a preview whose found paragraph says whether this person opened the image; and [restore.program].
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const text = (out: string) =>
  out
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replaceAll("&quot;", '"')
    .replaceAll("&#x27;", "'")
    .replaceAll("&lt;", "<")
    .replaceAll("&gt;", ">")
    .replaceAll("&amp;", "&");
const noop = () => undefined;
const hrefs = (out: string) => [...out.matchAll(/href="([^"]+)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
const AT = "2026-10-19T09:15:00.000Z";
const ASKED = "2026-10-19T10:00:00.000Z";
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z");
const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const ITEM_PROGRAM = "4e5f6a7b-8c9d-4e0f-9a1b-3c4d5e6f7a8b";
const DECISION_PROGRAM = "5f6a7b8c-9d0e-4f1a-8b2c-4d5e6f7a8b9c";
const ACTION_PROGRAM = "6a7b8c9d-0e1f-4a2b-9c3d-5e6f7a8b9c0d";
/** An objection with what a hostile author could write: a bidirectional override, a script and a link. */
const HOSTILE_OBJECTION = `${HOSTILE.bidi} <script>alert(1)</script> javascript:alert(1)`;

/** A post's case a program's score opened: its finding on the first image, its withhold of that image, and the author's request. */
function programCase(more: Partial<CaseView> = {}, inForce = true): CaseView {
  return postCase({
    items: [item({ id: ITEM_PROGRAM, source: SOURCES.program, explanation: null, mediaId: IMAGE_ONE, ruleId: "R1" })],
    intakeSeq: 1,
    decisions: [
      decision({
        id: DECISION_PROGRAM,
        byProgram: true,
        staffHandle: null,
        source: "own_initiative",
        rulesVersion: 3,
        redressVersion: 4,
        decidedAt: AT,
        facts: null,
        reason: null,
        actions: [{ id: ACTION_PROGRAM, kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE, noEffect: null, inForce, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: null, ...NO_STANDING }],
      }),
    ],
    signals: [{ itemId: ITEM_PROGRAM, kind: "r1_score", thresholdVersion: 0 }],
    objection: inForce ? { text: HOSTILE_OBJECTION, createdAt: ASKED } : null,
    ...more,
  });
}

const caseProps: Omit<CaseScreenViewProps, "caseId" | "view"> = {
  shownImage: null,
  busy: null,
  notice: null,
  error: null,
  note: "",
  reveal: null,
  onOpenCase: noop,
  onShowImage: noop,
  onShowClearly: noop,
  onHideImage: noop,
  onImageError: noop,
  onSnapshot: noop,
  onNoteChange: noop,
  onNoteSave: noop,
  onRevealOpen: noop,
  onRevealChange: noop,
  onRevealConfirm: noop,

const page = (view: CaseView) => html(<CaseScreenView {...caseProps} caseId={parseCaseId(view.id)!} view={view} />);

describe("the queue's chips (8.3)", () => {
  test("found, taken and the author's request, in that order after 3c's marks; none on a case a program never touched", () => {
    expect(marksOf(queueRow())).toEqual(["notice under Art. 16"]);
    expect(marksOf(queueRow({ foundByProgram: true, takenByProgram: true, objected: true }))).toEqual([
      "notice under Art. 16",
      AUTOMATION_WORDS.queue.found,
      AUTOMATION_WORDS.queue.taken,

    ]);
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queue).toEqual({ found: "Found by a program", taken: "Taken by a program", objected: "The author asked for a person" });
  });
});

describe("Home (8.2)", () => {
  test("[home.automated] and [home.objected] with a link to each case, the target from the contracts; nothing while neither applies", () => {
    const automated = { waiting: 2, oldestAt: AT, objected: 1, oldestObjectionAt: ASKED, cases: [CASE_POST], objectedCases: [CASE_POST] };
    const out = html(<CustodyLines overview={overview({ automated })} now={NOW.getTime()} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    const shown = text(out);
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.homeAutomated(2, bothTimes(AT)));
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.homeObjected(1, bothTimes(ASKED)));
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.homeObjected(1, "x")).toContain(`1 case, the oldest request of x. korbat's published target is an answer within ${AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours} hours.`);
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.homeObjected(3, "x")).toContain("3 cases");
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([`/cases/${CASE_POST}`, `/cases/${CASE_POST}`]);
    expect(html(<CustodyLines overview={overview()} now={NOW.getTime()} onOpenCase={noop} />)).toBe("");
  });

  test("a seal taken by a program on Home's list carries the chip in the place of a handle", () => {
    const home = text(html(<OverviewView overview={overview({ interimSeals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: AT, handle: null, caseId: CASE_POST, posts: 1, images: 2 }] } })} now={NOW.getTime()} onOpenCase={noop} />));
    expect(home).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.byProgram);
  });
});

describe("a case a program found and took (8.4)", () => {
  test("[case.r1] by the item, the chip in the place of a handle, [case.auto] with the statement sent, [case.autoR1], and no score anywhere", () => {
    const view = programCase();
    const shown = text(page(view));
    expect(shown).toContain("Source: Found by a program");
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseR1(0));
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseR1(0)).toContain("over the threshold (version 0)");
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.byProgram);
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAuto(bothTimes(AT), MEASURES.withhold_media.label));
    // The statement its author was sent: the program's sentences, the rule, and "Ask for a person" in the appeal's place.
    for (const sentence of [STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.until.r1, STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.fully.r1, REDRESS_TEXTS[4].askPerson!]) expect(shown).toContain(sentence);
    expect(statementParagraphs(programStatementOf(view, view.decisions[0]!))).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.fully.r1);
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoR1);
    // No number beside the image reads as a verdict: no score, no rating's value.
    expect(shown).not.toMatch(/score|0[.][0-9]/i);
    // Its source has no reveal and no mark.
    expect(shown).not.toContain("Reveal who sent this");
  });

  test("[case.objection] above the evidence, the author's text in its frame as text; gone, with [case.autoR1], once the measure is lifted", () => {
    const out = page(programCase());
    const shown = text(out);
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.objection.lead(bothTimes(ASKED)));
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.objection.tail);
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.objection.tail).toContain(`within ${AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours} hours`);
    expect(shown.indexOf(AUTOMATION_WORDS.objection.lead(bothTimes(ASKED)))).toBeLessThan(shown.indexOf("Evidence"));
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.objection.by);
    // The text is escaped: no script element and no link is made of it.
    expect(out).not.toContain("<script>");
    expect(hrefs(out).some((href) => href!.startsWith("javascript:"))).toBe(false);
    const lifted = text(page(programCase({}, false)));
    expect(lifted).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.objection.lead(bothTimes(ASKED)));
    expect(lifted).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoR1);
    expect(lifted).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAuto(bothTimes(AT), MEASURES.withhold_media.label));
  });

  test("the history names a program's finding as such", () => {
    const view = programCase({
      history: [{ at: AT, event: "item", refId: ITEM_PROGRAM, seq: 1, intakeKind: "automated", ruleId: "R1", allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, reexamination: false, decisionKind: null, outcome: null, staffHandle: null, result: null }],
    });
    expect(text(page(view))).toContain(`Item 1 arrived: ${AUTOMATION_WORDS.historyItem}, R1`);
  });
});

describe("the composer on such a case (8.4)", () => {
  const composer = (view: CaseView, extra: Partial<ComposerViewProps> = {}) => {
    const draft = newDraft(parseCaseId(view.id)!, view, MODERATOR);
    const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role: MODERATOR, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop, ...extra };
    return text(html(<ComposerView {...props} />));
  };

  test("[case.autoRecord] while an unanswered item is a program's finding, and not on a case without one", () => {
    expect(programFinding(programCase())).toEqual({ signal: { itemId: ITEM_PROGRAM, kind: "r1_score", thresholdVersion: 0 }, mediaId: IMAGE_ONE });
    expect(composer(programCase())).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoRecord);
    expect(programFinding(postCase())).toBeNull();
    expect(composer(postCase())).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoRecord);
  });

  test("the preview's found paragraph says whether this person opened the image on this case, as the statement will", () => {
    const view = programCase();
    const draft = { ...newDraft(parseCaseId(view.id)!, view, MODERATOR), kind: "final" as const, outcome: "restricted" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, actions: [{ kind: "remove_media" as const, mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }] };
    const unseen = previewOf(view, draft, NOW);
    expect(unseen).toMatchObject({ automatedDetection: true, automatedDecision: "not_automated", signal: { kind: "r1_score", viewed: false } });
    // A final removal under R1 gives a strike: the found paragraph then carries the strike's rule sentence after it.
    expect(statementParagraphs(unseen).join(" ")).toContain(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.found.r1.unviewed} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.strikeRule}`);
    const seen = previewOf(view, draft, NOW, [IMAGE_ONE]);
    expect(statementParagraphs(seen).join(" ")).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.found.r1.viewed);
    // A case no program touched: the preview carries no automation member, and 3c's sentence stands.
    const plain = postCase();
    const none = previewOf(plain, { ...newDraft(parseCaseId(plain.id)!, plain, MODERATOR), kind: "interim", actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }] }, NOW);
    expect(none.automatedDetection).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/automation-decision.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { AUTOMATION_RULES, RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, type AutomatedDecidedParams } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { REDRESS_VERSION } from "@korbat/rules";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../../src/auth";
import { createAuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { automatedParams, automatedStep, measureIn } from "../../src/moderation/automated";
import { insertScoreSignal, insertSystemDecision, joinSignal, signalHandled } from "../../src/moderation/automated-repo";
import { snapshotIn } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { recordIntakeIn, type IntakeGround } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { appendConfirmedAudit, caseById, insertAction } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { decisionStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { appendAuditRow } from "../../src/staff";
import { automationDeps, removeAutomation, signalForTest, signalRow, systemRowOf } from "./automation-fixtures";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import {
  MINORS,
  aPost,
  act,
  decideWith,
  decisionParams,
  decisionRow,
  hex64,
  imagePost,
  imageStates,
  inForce,
  itemsOf,
  moderationCounts,
  newTestStaff,
  postRow,
  refusal,
  refusalDetail,
  removeFixtures,
  report,
  staffProfile,
  type TestStaff,
} from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

// The step runs dozens of statements a call, and the caps' tests write a day of decisions: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

/** A program's finding under R1 as the step writes one, for the faults below. */
const R1_GROUND: IntakeGround = {
  kind: "automated",
  channel: "system",
  reporterId: null,
  findingBy: null,
  contactId: null,
  ruleId: "R1",
  allegesIllegal: false,
  csam: false,
  category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1,
  categoryKeyword: null,
  citedLaw: null,
  explanation: null,
  bonaFide: false,
  automatedProcessing: true,
};

/** The nine faults of LAB A2, and the decider check of A3, each written through the step's own statements with one change. */
type Fault = "final" | "no_audit" | "staff_audit" | "no_signal" | "two_measures" | "measure_remove" | "rule_r3" | "finding_r3" | "seal_on_r1" | "seal_under_r2" | "other_post_image" | "plain_actor";

/**
 * The automated decision on the database (3d design, sections 6.6 and 12.1 rows 2 to 4 and 7; LAB A as tests on the built
 * code, O4): the built decisions_record and decision_holds, which carry 3e's and 3f's branches, replaced by the migration
 * automated_decisions with its changes alone. Each case of out-A.txt is one test here with the same code, written through
 * the API's own statements (the step's finding, measure and audit row, the module's insert of a decision and of a ledger
 * row): A1 a program's withhold that commits; A2's nine faults, each refused and leaving nothing; a person's decision that
 * claims fully; A3 the API's role that cannot update a decision; A4 the fallback; A5 to A7 a person's final decision, a
 * correction and "no breach" after a program's measure; A8 the caps, here per rule and with the two limits on unanswered
 * measures. A program's decisions commit with the system's plain audit row; the faults and the caps run in transactions
 * that are rolled back. The person's decisions commit with real keys (moderation-decide.ts).
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the automated decision on the database (3d Task 6, LAB A)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  /** A placeholder key: an audit row it confirms is only ever written in a transaction that is rolled back. */
  let staffKey: TestStaff;
  let startedAt: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const authors: string[] = [];
  const media: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    staffKey = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, createAuthRepo(authDb), "moderator");
    const [row] = await apiDb.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`);
    startedAt = row!.now;
    before = await moderationCounts(apiDb);
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, authors);
    await removeAutomation(migrateDb, startedAt, media);
    await world.close();
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from auth.staff_keys where user_id = ${staffKey.id}::uuid`).catch(() => undefined);
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb), closeDb(authDb)]);
  });

  /** A post with images by a new author, committed, whose first image the program scores; the step's outcome on it. */
  async function program(images = 1, config: Parameters<typeof automationDeps>[2] = {}) {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, images);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    media.push(...p.mediaIds);
    const outcome = await signalForTest(automationDeps(apiDb, {}, config), p.mediaIds[0]!);
    return { ...p, ...outcome };
  }

  /**
   * One fault of LAB A2, in a transaction that is rolled back, as the API's role: the step's own statements in its order
   * (the author's profile, the finding, the snapshot, the decision, its ledger rows, the signal, the audit row) with the
   * one change the fault names, then the check at commit made to run at once. Answers the code the database raised, or
   * null when the decision stood.
   */
  async function faulty(fault: Fault): Promise<{ code: string | null; detail: string | null }> {
    let result: { code: string | null; detail: string | null } = { code: null, detail: null };
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
      const other = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const deps = automationDeps(tx);
      const mediaId = fault === "other_post_image" ? other.mediaIds[0]! : p.mediaIds[0]!;
      const signalId = (await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId, score: 1, thresholdVersion: 0 }))!;
      const attempt = tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
        await deps.social.lockAccounts(sp, [p.authorId], "no key update");
        const ground = fault === "finding_r3" ? { ...R1_GROUND, ruleId: "R3" as const, category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R3 } : R1_GROUND;
        const recorded = await recordIntakeIn(deps, sp, { ground, live: [{ type: "post", id: p.postId, position: 1, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! }] });
        const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
        await joinSignal(sp, signalId, recorded.items[0]!.id);
        const row = (await caseById(sp, caseId))!;
        const snapshot = await snapshotIn(deps, sp, row);
        const stateVersion = (await caseById(sp, caseId))!.stateVersion;
        let params: Record<string, unknown> = automatedParams({ stateVersion, snapshot, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! });
        if (fault === "final") params = { ...params, kind: "final", throughSeq: row.intakeSeq };
        if (fault === "rule_r3") params = { ...params, ruleId: "R3", category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R3 };
        if (fault === "measure_remove") params = { ...params, actions: [{ kind: "remove_media", mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! }] };
        if (fault === "two_measures") params = { ...params, actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }, { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! }] };
        if (fault === "seal_on_r1") params = { ...params, actions: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }] };
        if (fault === "seal_under_r2") params = { ...params, ruleId: "R2", category: MINORS, actions: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }] };
        const decisionId = randomUUID();
        await insertSystemDecision(sp, { id: decisionId, caseId, params: params as AutomatedDecidedParams });
        for (const action of params.actions as { kind: "withhold_media"; mediaId: string }[]) await insertAction(sp, decisionId, action);
        if (fault !== "no_signal") await signalHandled(sp, signalId, "measure", decisionId);
        const metadata = { params, decisionId, signalId, target: { type: "post", id: p.postId } };
        if (fault === "staff_audit") {
          await staffProfile(sp, staffKey);
          await appendConfirmedAudit(sp, {
            actorId: staffKey.id,
            keyId: staffKey.keyId,
            action: "case_decided",
            targetType: "case",
            targetId: caseId,
            metadata,
            staffSession: randomUUID(),
            actionHash: hex64(),
            stepUp: { authenticatorData: "AAAA", clientDataJSON: "BBBB", signature: "CCCC" },
            requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}`,
            expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000),
          });
        } else if (fault === "plain_actor") {
          await staffProfile(sp, staffKey);
          await appendAuditRow(sp, { actorId: staffKey.id, action: "automated_decided", targetType: "case", targetId: caseId, requestId: null, metadata });
        } else if (fault !== "no_audit") {
          await appendAuditRow(sp, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "automated_decided", targetType: "case", targetId: caseId, requestId: null, metadata });
        }
        await sp.execute(sql`set constraints public.decisions_check, public.decision_actions_recheck immediate`);
      });
      const refused = await refusal(attempt.then(() => undefined));
      result = { code: refused, detail: refused === null ? null : await refusalDetail(Promise.reject(await attempt.catch((err: unknown) => err))) };
    });
    return result;
  }

  test("LAB A1: a program's withhold of one image commits without a decider, fully automated and detected, for no admin, its statement pending, the system's plain audit row last", async () => {
    const p = await program(1);
    expect(p.handled).toBe("measure");
    const decision = await decisionRow(apiDb, p.decisionId!);
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({
      kind: "interim",
      outcome: "restricted",
      ground: "incompatible",
      rule_id: "R1",
      decided_by: null,
      automated_detection: true,
      automated_decision: "fully",
      needs_admin: false,
      source: "own_initiative",
      suspect: false,
      author_mail: "pending",
      facts_digest: null,
      reason_digest: null,
      redress_version: REDRESS_VERSION,
    });
    const audit = await systemRowOf(apiDb, p.decisionId!);
    expect(audit).toMatchObject({ actor_id: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "automated_decided", target_type: "case", target_id: decision.case_id, step_up: null, key_id: null });
    expect(audit!.metadata).toMatchObject({ decisionId: p.decisionId, signalId: p.signalId, target: { type: "post", id: p.postId } });
    // The image reads withheld and the post stays visible: the program hid one image and no text.
    expect(await imageStates(apiDb, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["withheld"]);
    expect((await postRow(apiDb, p.postId)).level).toBe("visible");
    expect(await inForce(apiDb, { postId: p.postId })).toEqual([`withhold_media:${p.mediaIds[0]}`]);
    // The signal names its finding's item and its decision, handled as a measure; the item is the program's, in lane 2.
    const signal = await signalRow(apiDb, p.signalId);
    expect(signal).toMatchObject({ handled: "measure", decision_id: p.decisionId });
    const [item] = await itemsOf(apiDb, decision.case_id);
    expect(item).toMatchObject({ id: signal.intake_item_id, lane: 2, suspect: false, media_id: p.mediaIds[0] });
    const [intake] = await apiDb.execute<{ kind: string; channel: string; automated_processing: boolean; rule_id: string; reporter_id: string | null; finding_by: string | null }>(
      sql`select n.kind::text as kind, n.channel::text as channel, n.automated_processing, n.rule_id, n.reporter_id, n.finding_by from intakes n join intake_items i on i.intake_id = n.id where i.id = ${signal.intake_item_id}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(intake).toEqual({ kind: "automated", channel: "system", automated_processing: true, rule_id: "R1", reporter_id: null, finding_by: null });
    // Never due a strike: decision_holds asks strike_due of a final decision alone, and a program's is interim.
    expect((await apiDb.execute(sql`select 1 from decision_actions where decision_id = ${p.decisionId}::uuid and kind = 'strike'`)).length).toBe(0);
    // A second entry for the same signal finds it handled and writes nothing (the step's re-read after the profile's lock).
    expect((await automatedStep(automationDeps(apiDb), p.signalId)).handled).toBe("already");
  });

  test("LAB A2: each of the nine faults is refused, invalid_decision or the intake's CHECK, and leaves nothing", async () => {
    const counts = await moderationCounts(apiDb);
    expect(await faulty("final")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("no_audit")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("staff_audit")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("no_signal")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("two_measures")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("measure_remove")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("rule_r3")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect((await faulty("finding_r3")).code).toMatch(/^23514 .*intakes_automated/);
    // A seal resting on an R1 score: under R1 decision_actions_check refuses a seal on no suspect item; under R2 the
    // decision considers no program's finding of its rule, and rests on no suspect item.
    expect(await faulty("seal_on_r1")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("seal_under_r2")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    // Two more of decision_holds' members: the signal's image on another post, and a plain row of a staff account.
    expect(await faulty("other_post_image")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("plain_actor")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    // And the decision as the step writes it stands, so each refusal above is its fault's.
    expect(await faulty("none" as Fault)).toEqual({ code: null, detail: null });
    expect(await moderationCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(counts);
  });

      const row = await decisionRow(tx, decisionId);
      expect([row.decided_by, row.automated_detection, row.automated_decision]).toEqual([staffKey.id, true, "not_automated"]);

      const code = await refusal(
        tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
          const recorded = await recordIntakeIn(deps, sp, { ground: R1_GROUND, live: [{ type: "post", id: p.postId, position: 1, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! }] });
          const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
          const row = (await caseById(sp, caseId))!;
          const snapshot = await snapshotIn(deps, sp, row);
          const params = automatedParams({ stateVersion: (await caseById(sp, caseId))!.stateVersion, snapshot, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! });
          const decisionId = randomUUID();
          await insertSystemDecision(sp, { id: decisionId, caseId, params });
          await insertAction(sp, decisionId, params.actions[0]);
          await signalHandled(sp, signalId, "measure", decisionId);
          await sp.execute(sql`set constraints public.decisions_check, public.decision_actions_recheck immediate`);
        }),
      );
      expect(code).toBe("invalid_decision");

  });

  test("already_protected: a person's withhold of the post, or of the image, stands for the program's, whose finding is kept as covered", async () => {

        const deps = automationDeps(tx);

        expect((await signalRow(tx, signalId)).intake_item_id, measure).not.toBeNull();
        // The other image of the post is not covered by a withhold of the first one alone; a withhold of the post covers it.
        const second = (await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[1]!, score: 1, thresholdVersion: 0 }))!;
        expect((await automatedStep(deps, second)).handled, measure).toBe(measure === "withhold" ? "covered" : "measure");

  describe("LAB A8 on the built code: the caps by rule and the two limits on unanswered measures", () => {
    /**
     * A day of a program's decisions, written as the migrator with the decision triggers off (as yearForTest writes its
     * year), inside the caller's transaction, which is rolled back: `n` decisions without a decider under `rule`, `ago` in
     * the past, on open cases of posts of new authors; when `inForce`, each with a withhold_media of an image of its own,
     * four to a post (a post holds four images), one case a post. A test calls it before its first step: a step's
     * decision leaves the commit's checks pending, and a table with pending checks cannot have its triggers turned off.
     */
    async function history(tx: DbTx, n: number, rule: "R1" | "R2", ago: string, inForce: boolean): Promise<{ actionIds: string[] }> {
      const perPost = inForce ? 4 : n;
      const groups: { postId: string; authorId: string; mediaIds: string[]; caseId: string; snapshot: { id: string; digest: string }; count: number }[] = [];
      for (let left = n; left > 0; left -= perPost) {
        const count = Math.min(perPost, left);
        const p = await imagePost(tx, inForce ? count : 0);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        const [snapshot] = await tx.execute<{ id: string; digest: string }>(sql`select id, digest from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid limit 1`);
        groups.push({ ...p, caseId, snapshot: snapshot!, count });
      }
      for (const table of ["decisions", "decision_actions"]) await tx.execute(sql.raw(`alter table public.${table} disable trigger user`));
      const actionIds: string[] = [];
      for (const group of groups) {
        const made = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.decisions (case_id, kind, seen_state_version, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                        snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim,
                                        automated_detection, automated_decision)
          select ${group.caseId}::uuid, 'interim', 0, 'restricted', 'incompatible', ${rule}, 3, 4, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'own_initiative',
                 ${group.snapshot.id}::uuid, ${group.snapshot.digest}, null, now() - ${ago}::interval, '1'::xid8, md5(random()::text || g::text), now() - ${ago}::interval,
                 false, false, false, true, 'fully'
            from generate_series(1, ${group.count}::int) g
          returning id`);
        if (!inForce) continue;
        for (const [i, decision] of made.entries()) {
          const [action] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
            insert into public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, media_id, subject_account_id, post_id, created_at)
            values (${decision.id}::uuid, 'withhold_media', ${group.mediaIds[i]!}::uuid, ${group.authorId}::uuid, ${group.postId}::uuid, now() - ${ago}::interval) returning id`);
          actionIds.push(action!.id);
        }
      }
      for (const table of ["decisions", "decision_actions"]) await tx.execute(sql.raw(`alter table public.${table} enable trigger user`));
      return { actionIds };
    }

    /**
     * What the database already counts for a rule, committed by this file's earlier tests: the R1 decisions without a
     * decider of the last hour, and their measures in force. The limits count every program's decision, so a test fills
     * a limit up from there.
     */
    async function counted(tx: DbTx, rule: "R1" | "R2"): Promise<{ hour: number; unanswered: number }> {
      const [row] = await tx.execute<{ hour: number; unanswered: number }>(sql`
        select (select count(*)::int from public.decisions d where d.decided_by is null and d.rule_id = ${rule} and d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 hour') as hour,
               (select count(*)::int from public.measures_in_force m join public.decisions d on d.id = m.decision_id
                 where d.decided_by is null and d.rule_id = ${rule}) as unanswered`);
      return row!;
    }

    /** A new post's image scored and stepped as the migrator's transaction sees it; the step's outcome. */
    async function step(tx: DbTx) {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const signalId = (await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]!, score: 1, thresholdVersion: 0 }))!;
      return { ...(await automatedStep(automationDeps(tx), signalId)), signalId, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! };
    }

    test("the hour's cap is R1's own: twenty R2 decisions in the hour leave R1 its measure, twenty R1 ones refuse the next with its finding kept", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await history(tx, AUTOMATION_RULES.r2DecisionsPerHour, "R2", "10 minutes", false);
        await history(tx, AUTOMATION_RULES.decisionsPerHour - 1 - (await counted(tx, "R1")).hour, "R1", "10 minutes", false);
        // The twentieth R1 decision of the hour is taken: R2's twenty are not R1's.
        expect((await step(tx)).handled).toBe("measure");
        const capped = await step(tx);
        expect([capped.handled, capped.limit, capped.decisionId]).toEqual(["capped", "hour", null]);
        expect((await signalRow(tx, capped.signalId)).intake_item_id).not.toBeNull();
        expect(await imageStates(tx, [capped.mediaId])).toEqual(["visible"]);
        // The alert says which limit was met, and how many findings stand without a measure since.
        const [alert] = await tx.execute<{ facts: Record<string, number | string> }>(sql`select facts from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'automation_capped' order by id desc limit 1`);
        expect(alert!.facts).toMatchObject({ limitHour: 1, count: 1 });
      });
    });

    test("the day's cap: a hundred R1 decisions of the last day refuse the next, as day", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await history(tx, AUTOMATION_RULES.decisionsPerDay, "R1", "3 hours", false);
        expect(await step(tx)).toMatchObject({ handled: "capped", limit: "day" });
      });
    });

    test("unanswered: twenty R1 measures in force stop a new one under R1 alone, and a person's answer lets the program act again", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const { actionIds } = await history(tx, AUTOMATION_RULES.unansweredMax - (await counted(tx, "R1")).unanswered, "R1", "3 days", true);
        expect(await step(tx)).toMatchObject({ handled: "capped", limit: "unanswered" });
        // One measure lifted, as a person's correction lifts it: nineteen wait, and the program takes its measure again. The
        // capped step left no check pending (it wrote no decision), so the triggers can be turned off once more.
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.decision_actions disable trigger user`);
        const [lifted] = await tx.execute<{ decision_id: string; media_id: string; subject_account_id: string; post_id: string }>(
          sql`select decision_id, media_id, subject_account_id, post_id from public.decision_actions where id = ${actionIds[0]!}::uuid`,
        );
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, media_id, subject_account_id, post_id, reverses_action_id, created_at)
                             values (${lifted!.decision_id}::uuid, 'restore_media', ${lifted!.media_id}::uuid, ${lifted!.subject_account_id}::uuid, ${lifted!.post_id}::uuid, ${actionIds[0]!}::uuid, now())`);
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.decision_actions enable trigger user`);
        expect((await step(tx)).handled).toBe("measure");
      });
    });

    test("waiting: a request for a person older than unansweredHours, its measure in force, stops new measures under either rule", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const first = await step(tx);
        expect(first.handled).toBe("measure");
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.automated_objections (decision_id, text) values (${first.decisionId!}::uuid, 'Please look again.')`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update public.automated_objections set created_at = now() - make_interval(hours => ${AUTOMATION_RULES.unansweredHours + 1}::int) where decision_id = ${first.decisionId!}::uuid`);
        expect(await step(tx)).toMatchObject({ handled: "capped", limit: "waiting" });
      });
    });
  });

  test("no row of a program's decision is left by the faults: the file's counts are its committed programs' alone", async () => {
    const now = await moderationCounts(apiDb);
    // Each committed program above wrote one decision; the faults and the caps wrote nothing that stayed.
    expect(now.decisions! - before.decisions!).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    const [stray] = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions d where d.decided_by is null and not exists (select 1 from automated_signals s where s.decision_id = d.id)`);
    expect(stray!.n).toBe(0);
  });

  test("the measure's own write path is the one the step runs (measureIn), and a second program's measure meets the case's lock order", async () => {
    // measureIn is what the step's savepoint runs: called as the step calls it, inside a transaction that is rolled back.
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const deps = automationDeps(tx);
      const signalId = (await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]!, score: 1, thresholdVersion: 0 }))!;
      const recorded = await recordIntakeIn(deps, tx, { ground: R1_GROUND, live: [{ type: "post", id: p.postId, position: 1, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! }] });
      await joinSignal(tx, signalId, recorded.items[0]!.id);
      const decisionId = await measureIn(deps, tx, { caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, postId: p.postId, signalId, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! });
      await tx.execute(sql`set constraints public.decisions_check, public.decision_actions_recheck immediate`);
      expect((await decisionRow(tx, decisionId)).automated_decision).toBe("fully");
    });
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/automation-fixtures.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { SignalKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { automatedStep, type StepOutcome } from "../../src/moderation/automated";
import { insertScoreSignal } from "../../src/moderation/automated-repo";
import type { ModerationDeps } from "../../src/moderation/context";
import { moderationDeps, uuids, type Runner } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/**
 * The automated decision's fixtures (3d design, section 12; Task 6). A test builds the moderation module's dependencies
 * with the settings it needs, on its own configuration, as the tests build every adapter in the process: the scorer `test`
 * (whose threshold is 0.5 under version 0) and, unless said, AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS on. The configuration's refusal of a test
 * adapter on an open site is the configuration's own test; these settings never reach loadConfig.
 */

/** The configuration of a server whose R1 check runs, flagging or (the default here) withholding. */
export function automationConfig(over: Partial<Config> = {}): Config {
  return { ...loadConfig(), R1_CLASSIFIER: "test", AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS: "on", APP_SITE: "closed", ...over };
}

/** The moderation module's dependencies over a pool or a transaction, with automationConfig's settings. */
export function automationDeps(db: Runner, over: Partial<ModerationDeps> = {}, config: Partial<Config> = {}): ModerationDeps {
  return moderationDeps(db, { config: automationConfig(config), ...over });
}

/** A signal the fixture wrote and the step's outcome on it. */
export interface Signalled extends StepOutcome {
  signalId: string;
}

/**
 * `signalForTest(media, kind)` (design, section 12): inserts a signal as the API's role, as the step's first statement
 * writes one, and runs the automated step once on it. A score's signal carries `score` (1, over every threshold, unless
 * said) under the test scorer's version 0. Task 7 adds the match's kind.
 */
export async function signalForTest(deps: ModerationDeps, mediaId: string, kind: SignalKind = "r1_score", score = 1): Promise<Signalled> {
  if (kind !== "r1_score") throw new Error("a match's signal is Task 7's");
  const signalId = await insertScoreSignal(deps.apiDb, { mediaId, score, thresholdVersion: 0 });
  if (signalId === null) throw new Error("the image has a score's signal already");
  return { signalId, ...(await automatedStep(deps, signalId)) };
}

/** A signal's row as the step left it. */
export async function signalRow(db: Runner, id: string): Promise<{ handled: string | null; handled_at: string | null; decision_id: string | null; intake_item_id: string | null; kind: string; score: number | null }> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ handled: string | null; handled_at: string | null; decision_id: string | null; intake_item_id: string | null; kind: string; score: number | null }>(
    sql`select handled, handled_at::text as handled_at, decision_id, intake_item_id, kind, score from public.automated_signals where id = ${id}::uuid`,
  );
  return { ...row! };
}

/** The system's audit row that names a decision, as the chain holds it. */
export async function systemRowOf(db: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<{ actor_id: string; action: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; step_up: unknown; key_id: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown> } | null> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ actor_id: string; action: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; step_up: unknown; key_id: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
    sql`select actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, step_up, key_id, metadata from public.audit_log where metadata ->> 'decisionId' = ${decisionId} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
  );
  return row ?? null;
}

/**
 * Removes, as the migrator, what a test of the automated decision committed beyond what removeFixtures takes with its
 * profiles: the alert rows of the three kinds (and moderation_urgent) raised since the test began.
 */
export async function removeAutomation(migrateDb: Db | DbTx, alertsSince: string, mediaIds: readonly string[] = []): Promise<void> {
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.automated_signals where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.edge_purges where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(
    sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('automated_objection', 'automation_capped', 'automated_waiting', 'moderation_urgent') and created_at >= ${alertsSince}::timestamptz`,
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/cli-automation.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { AUTOMATION_RULES, SWEEP_HOURS } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { R1_TEST_MODEL } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import { automationStatus, type AutomationSettings } from "../../src/cli/automation";
import { runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { automationDeps, signalForTest } from "./automation-fixtures";
import { ageCustodyForTest } from "./custody-fixtures";
import { imagePost } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/**
 * staff.js automation-status (3d design, section 8.10; Task 6), in the api service on the API's role: one line for each
 * adapter and its settings, a program's findings today and the use of each of its limits, read in one read-only
 * transaction. The counts are read inside transactions that are rolled back, so the file leaves nothing behind; the
 * command itself is run on the test environment with every adapter off, and once with a setting the API refuses.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: staff.js automation-status (3d Task 6)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  // Every 3d setting as the test environment would leave it, made explicit: blank is unset.
  const OFF = {
    EDGE_PURGE: "",
    R1_CLASSIFIER: "",
    AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS: "",
    AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1: "",
    AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1_ACTS: "",
    HEAD_WITNESS: "",
    HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL: "",
    RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT: "",
  };
  const run = async (env: Record<string, string>) => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(["automation-status"], { ...process.env, ...OFF, ...env }, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) });
    return { code, lines };
  };
  const settings = (over: Partial<AutomationSettings> = {}): AutomationSettings => ({
    EDGE_PURGE: "off",
    R1_CLASSIFIER: "off",
    AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS: "off",
    AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1: undefined,
    AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1_ACTS: undefined,
    HEAD_WITNESS: "off",
    HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL: undefined,
    RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT: "on",
    ...over,
  });

  beforeAll(() => {
    apiDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 2 });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await closeDb(apiDb);
  });

  test("with every adapter off: eight lines, each the command's, the R1 check off, known material not built, no daily mail; nothing written", async () => {
    const [head] = await apiDb.execute<{ seq: string }>(sql`select seq::text as seq from public.audit_head where id = 1`);
    const { code, lines } = await run({});
    expect(code).toBe(0);
    expect(lines).toHaveLength(8);
    for (const line of lines) expect(line).toMatch(/^out automation-status: /);
    expect(lines[0]).toMatch(/^out automation-status: edge purge: off; [0-9]+ purges waiting, [0-9]+ failed in 24 hours[.]$/);
    expect(lines[1]).toBe("out automation-status: R1 check: off, acts off; model none, threshold version 1; impact assessment not set, for its measure not set.");
    expect(lines[2]).toBe("out automation-status: known material: off; no comparison is built in this version.");
    expect(lines[3]).toMatch(/^out automation-status: head witness: off; last value ([0-9-]{10}|none), witnessed (yes|no); keeper's mail not set: no daily mail is sent[.]$/);
    expect(lines[4]).toBe("out automation-status: signed-out readers: counted.");
    expect(lines[5]).toMatch(new RegExp(`^out automation-status: a program's findings today: [0-9]+ under R1, [0-9]+ under R2, [0-9]+ without a rule; signals the sweep left unhandled after ${SWEEP_HOURS} hours: [0-9]+[.]$`));
    expect(lines[6]).toMatch(
      new RegExp(
        `^out automation-status: a program's decisions under R1: [0-9]+ of ${AUTOMATION_RULES.decisionsPerHour} in the last hour, [0-9]+ of ${AUTOMATION_RULES.decisionsPerDay} in the last 24 hours; under R2: [0-9]+ of ${AUTOMATION_RULES.r2DecisionsPerHour}, [0-9]+ of ${AUTOMATION_RULES.r2DecisionsPerDay}[.]$`,
      ),
    );
    expect(lines[7]).toMatch(
      new RegExp(
        `^out automation-status: a program's measures waiting for a person: under R1 [0-9]+ of ${AUTOMATION_RULES.unansweredMax}, under R2 [0-9]+ of ${AUTOMATION_RULES.unansweredMax}; the oldest unanswered request for a person: (none|[0-9T:.Z-]+) [(]no new measure under either rule once one is older than ${AUTOMATION_RULES.unansweredHours} hours[)][.]$`,
      ),
    );
    // Read-only: the chain did not move.
    const [after] = await apiDb.execute<{ seq: string }>(sql`select seq::text as seq from public.audit_head where id = 1`);
    expect(after!.seq).toBe(head!.seq);
  });

  test("the settings as the server reads them: a test adapter on a closed site, its two days, signed-out readers off, a keeper's mail set; a setting the API refuses is refused with its sentence", async () => {
    const lines = await automationStatus(apiDb, settings({ R1_CLASSIFIER: "test", AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS: "on", AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1: "2026-09-01", AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1_ACTS: "2026-09-02", RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT: "off", HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL: "keeper@korbat.local" }));
    expect(lines[1]).toBe(`automation-status: R1 check: test, acts on; model ${R1_TEST_MODEL}, threshold version 0; impact assessment 2026-09-01, for its measure 2026-09-02.`);
    expect(lines[3]).toMatch(/keeper's mail set[.]$/);
    expect(lines.join(" ")).not.toContain("keeper@korbat.local");
    expect(lines[4]).toBe("automation-status: signed-out readers: not counted.");
    // The API refuses a test adapter while the site is open; so does the command, which prints nothing else.
    const refused = await run({ R1_CLASSIFIER: "test", APP_SITE: "open" });
    expect(refused.code).toBe(1);
    expect(refused.lines).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(refused.lines[0]).toMatch(/^err [^]*R1_CLASSIFIER=test is refused while APP_SITE is open/);
  });

  test("the counts: a program's finding and measure today, its use of R1's caps, its measure waiting and the oldest request for a person", async () => {
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const read = async () => {
        const lines = await automationStatus(tx, settings({ R1_CLASSIFIER: "test", AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS: "on" }));
        const decided = /decisions under R1: ([0-9]+) of [0-9]+ in the last hour, ([0-9]+) of /.exec(lines[6]!)!;
        return {
          lines,
          found: Number(/findings today: ([0-9]+) under R1,/.exec(lines[5]!)![1]),
          hour: Number(decided[1]),
          day: Number(decided[2]),
          waiting: Number(/waiting for a person: under R1 ([0-9]+) of /.exec(lines[7]!)![1]),
          oldest: /request for a person: ([^ ]+) /.exec(lines[7]!)![1],
        };
      };
      const before = await read();
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const step = await signalForTest(automationDeps(tx), p.mediaIds[0]!);
      expect(step.handled).toBe("measure");
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.automated_objections (decision_id, text) values (${step.decisionId!}::uuid, 'Please have a person look.')`);
      const after = await read();
      expect([after.found, after.hour, after.day, after.waiting]).toEqual([before.found + 1, before.hour + 1, before.day + 1, before.waiting + 1]);
      expect(after.oldest).toMatch(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$/);
      // No text and no id in any line.
      expect(after.lines.join(" ")).not.toMatch(/Please have a person look|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}/);
    });
  });

  test("a signal older than the sweep's hours, still unhandled, is counted as given up", async () => {
    const migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    try {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const count = async () => Number(/signals the sweep left unhandled after [0-9]+ hours: ([0-9]+)[.]/.exec((await automationStatus(tx, settings()))[5]!)![1]);
        const before = await count();
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const [signal] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`insert into public.automated_signals (kind, media_id, score, threshold_version) values ('r1_score', ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid, 1, 0) returning id`);
        expect(await count()).toBe(before);
        await ageCustodyForTest(tx, { signal: signal!.id }, `${SWEEP_HOURS} hours 1 minute`);
        expect(await count()).toBe(before + 1);
      });
    } finally {
      await closeDb(migrateDb);
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";

import { createMedia } from "../../src/media";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createModeration } from "../../src/moderation";
import { sweepRound } from "../../src/moderation/automated";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { createSocial, enforceWriteLimit, socialForModeration } from "../../src/social";
import { createStaff } from "../../src/staff";
import { SoftAuthenticator } from "../auth/soft-authenticator";
import { automationDeps, removeAutomation } from "./automation-fixtures";
import { ageCustodyForTest } from "./custody-fixtures";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { BYTES, fakeWorker } from "./media-harness";
import { act, decisionParams, newPostRow, removeFixtures, type DecisionInput } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { HUMAN } from "./notices-harness";
import { enrolKey } from "./staff-enrolment";
import { DEVICE_BOUND, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, issueEnrolment, newStaffAccount } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Accounts sign up and a staff key confirms a correction over HTTP: on a loaded machine longer than five seconds.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

const STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf";
const MARKED = { "x-staff-activity": "1" };

/**
 * The automated decision and "Ask for a person" through the real app (3d design, sections 7.9, 7.10, 8.3, 8.4, 9.4 and
 * 10.2 to 10.4; Task 6; 12.1 rows 3, 4, 6 and 7): the app's site and the console's in one server, with the media, social,
 * moderation and staff modules wired as the server wires them, the test scorer on a closed site and its withhold on, and a
 * stand-in for the worker that writes results of version 2 with the test model's score. A post with a scored image is
 * withheld by the program after the post's commit; its author reads the decision, its statement and "Ask for a person",
 * and asks; the console shows the three chips, the request first in its lane, the signal without its score and the
 * request's text as text; a moderator's correction lifts the measure and answers the request. The sweep takes an image
 * whose step never ran, and the daily alert follows a request that waited past the target. Every row this file commits
 * is removed again by the profiles that own it and the alerts it raised.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the automated decision and Ask for a person over HTTP (3d Task 6)", () => {
  let config: Config;
  let authDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  let auth: Auth;
  let app: ReturnType<typeof createApp>;
  let settle: () => Promise<void>;
  let moderator: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof staffBrowser>>;
  let startedAt: string;
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-http-automation-"));
  const uploads = uploadsLayout(path.join(root, "uploads"));
  const worker = fakeWorker(path.join(root, "store"));
  const profileIds: string[] = [];
  const staffIds: string[] = [];
  const mediaIds: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // The console switched on at the staff harness's address; the R1 check's test scorer withholding, on a closed site,
    // set after loadConfig as a test sets a test adapter for itself.
    config = { ...loadConfig({ ...process.env, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, CONSOLE_RP_ID: "" }), R1_CLASSIFIER: "test", AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS: "on", APP_SITE: "closed" };
    const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    const [row] = await apiDb.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`);
    startedAt = row!.now;
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
    auth = createAuth({
      config,
      logger,
      authDb,
      kv: new MemoryKv(),
      mailer,
      profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
      turnstile: { verify: async (token) => token === HUMAN },
      breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
    });
    const media = createMedia({
      apiDb,
      uploadsDir: uploads.root,
      storeDir: path.join(root, "store"),
      formats: config.MEDIA_FORMATS,
      minFreeBytes: 0,
      logger,
      requireSession: auth.requireSession,
      resolveSession: auth.resolveSession,
      rateLimitStore,
      enforceUploadLimit: (userId, accountCreatedAt, at) => enforceWriteLimit(rateLimitStore, userId, "upload", accountCreatedAt, at),
      // The test scorer's model, whose scores finalize keeps, as the server names it under R1_CLASSIFIER=test.
      r1Model: R1_TEST_MODEL,
    });
    await media.prepare();
    const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: auth.forModeration, social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: media.forCases, requireSession: auth.requireSession, rateLimitStore, config, logger });
    settle = moderation.settle;
    const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(), media: media.forPosts, moderation: moderation.forSocial });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social, media, moderation, staff: createStaff({ apiDb, auth: auth.forStaff, moderation: moderation.forStaff }) });
    moderator = await staffBrowser("moderator");
  }, 180_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await settle();
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [...profileIds, ...staffIds]);
    await removeAutomation(migrateDb, startedAt, mediaIds);
    rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const appBrowser = () => new Browser(app, config.APP_ORIGIN);
  const consoleBrowser = () => new Browser(app, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, { base: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, csrfCookie: STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE, csrfHeader: "x-staff-csrf" });
  const refused = async (res: Response) => [res.status, ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code];
  async function parsed<T>(res: Response, status: number, schema: { parse(value: unknown): T }): Promise<T> {
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(status);
    const raw: unknown = await res.json();
    const value = schema.parse(raw);
    expect(raw).toStrictEqual(value);
    // No answer to anyone holds a score, a model's rating or the threshold's value (12.1 row 7).
    expect(JSON.stringify(raw)).not.toMatch(/"score"|nsfw|"threshold"/);
    return value;
  }

  /** A browser signed in over HTTP, with a profile, and its address. */
  async function signUp() {
    const b = appBrowser();
    const email = `auto-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = `a${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: HUMAN, deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    expect(start.status, await start.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
    const id = (await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from profiles where handle = ${handle}`))[0]!.id;
    profileIds.push(id);
    return { b, id, email };
  }

  /** A live staff account with a profile and one key enrolled through the flow, signed in from the console's browser. */
  async function staffBrowser(role: "moderator" | "admin") {
    const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo, role);
    await apiDb.insert(profiles).values({ id: user.id, handle: `s_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`, displayName: "Staff" });
    staffIds.push(user.id);
    const soft = new SoftAuthenticator();
    const link = await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id);
    const enrolled = await enrolKey({ deps: auth.deps, ctx: { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: undefined } }, soft, link.token);
    let counter = 0;
    const assert = (challenge: string) => soft.get({ credentialId: enrolled.credentialId, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge, origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter: ++counter });
    const b = consoleBrowser();
    const options = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/options", { method: "POST" });
    expect(options.status, await options.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    const { challenge } = ((await options.json()) as { options: { challenge: string } }).options;
    const signedIn = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/verify", { json: { response: assert(challenge) } });
    expect(signedIn.status, await signedIn.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return { id: user.id, keyId: enrolled.key.id, role, b, assert };
  }
  type Staff = typeof moderator;

  /** A confirmed decision on the case over HTTP; answers the decision's id. */
  async function decide(s: Staff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
    const params = await decisionParams(apiDb, s, caseId, input);
    const request = { action: "case_decided" as const, target: { type: "case" as const, id: caseId }, params: params as CaseDecidedParams };
    const options = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/step-up/options", { json: request, headers: MARKED });
    expect(options.status, await options.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    const stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON = s.assert(StaffStepUpOptionsResponse.parse(await options.json()).options.challenge);
    const view = await parsed(await s.b.fetch(`/api/staff/cases/${caseId}/decisions`, { json: { ...params, stepUp }, headers: MARKED }), 201, CaseView);
    await settle();
    return view.decisions.at(-1)!.id;
  }

  /**
   * An image uploaded over HTTP and accepted by the stand-in worker with the test model's score, then posted: the post's
   * answer comes first, and the program's step runs after its commit, which settle waits for.
   */
  async function publish(author: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof signUp>>, score: number, model = R1_TEST_MODEL) {
    const sent = await author.b.fetch("/api/media", { raw: { type: "image/jpeg", body: BYTES.jpeg } });
    expect(sent.status).toBe(202);
    const { id } = UploadResponse.parse(await sent.json());
    mediaIds.push(id);
    worker.ready(id, { width: 1200, height: 800 }, { model, score });
    expect(MediaStatusResponse.parse(await (await author.b.fetch(`/api/media/${id}`)).json()).status).toBe("ready");
    const created = await author.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "a photo", media: [{ id, alt: "an image" }] } });
    expect(created.status, await created.clone().text()).toBe(201);
    const post = PostView.parse(await created.json());
    await settle();
    return { postId: post.id, mediaId: id };
  }

  /** What the program left on an image: its signal, the decision and its case, and the image's state. */
  async function programOn(mediaId: string) {
    const [row] = await apiDb.execute<{ handled: string | null; decision_id: string | null; case_id: string | null; state: string }>(sql`
      select s.handled, s.decision_id, i.case_id, m.moderation_state::text as state
        from post_media m left join automated_signals s on s.media_id = m.id left join intake_items i on i.id = s.intake_item_id
       where m.id = ${mediaId}::uuid`);
    return row!;
  }

  /** The case's row in the queue, read page by page in the queue's order, and the rows of its lane before it. */
  async function queueRowOf(caseId: string) {
    const rows: QueuePage["cases"] = [];
    let cursor: string | null = null;
    for (let page = 0; page < 50; page++) {
      const answer: QueuePage = await parsed(await moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/queue${cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`}`), 200, QueuePage);
      rows.push(...answer.cases);
      const found = rows.find((row) => row.id === caseId);
      if (found) return { row: found, before: rows.slice(0, rows.indexOf(found)).filter((row) => row.lane === found.lane) };
      if (answer.nextCursor === null) break;
      cursor = answer.nextCursor;
    }
    throw new Error(`case ${caseId} is not in the queue`);
  }

  let program: { author: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof signUp>>; postId: string; mediaId: string; decisionId: string; caseId: string };

  test("a scored image on a new post: after the post's commit a program withholds it, interim and fully automated, with its statement and its mail", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const { postId, mediaId } = await publish(author, 1);
    const left = await programOn(mediaId);
    expect([left.handled, left.state]).toEqual(["measure", "withheld"]);
    const [decision] = await apiDb.execute<{ kind: string; decided_by: string | null; automated_detection: boolean; automated_decision: string; source: string; rule_id: string; redress_version: number }>(
      sql`select kind::text, decided_by, automated_detection, automated_decision, source::text, rule_id, redress_version from decisions where id = ${left.decision_id!}::uuid`,
    );
    expect({ ...decision! }).toEqual({ kind: "interim", decided_by: null, automated_detection: true, automated_decision: "fully", source: "own_initiative", rule_id: "R1", redress_version: 4 });
    program = { author, postId, mediaId, decisionId: left.decision_id!, caseId: left.case_id! };

    // The author's list marks it as a program's, and its screen offers "Ask for a person".
    const cases = await parsed(await author.b.fetch("/api/moderation/cases"), 200, AuthorCasesPage);
    expect(cases.decisions.find((row) => row.id === program.decisionId)).toMatchObject({ byProgram: true });
    const view = await parsed(await author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${program.decisionId}`), 200, DecisionView);
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ automatedDetection: true, automatedDecision: "fully", signal: { kind: "r1_score", viewed: null }, askPerson: { state: "open" }, appealUntil: null });
    // The statement without a decider, in W.3's order: the measure, until a person decides, what found it and took it,
    // the rule, and "Ask for a person" in place of the appeal; no staff text.
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(view);
    for (const sentence of [STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.until.r1, STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.fully.r1, REDRESS_TEXTS[4].askPerson!]) expect(paragraphs).toContain(sentence);
    expect(paragraphs.indexOf(STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.fully.r1)).toBeLessThan(paragraphs.indexOf(REDRESS_TEXTS[4].askPerson!));
    expect(paragraphs.join(" ")).not.toMatch(/child sexual abuse|confirmed|posted/);
    // The author was mailed the statement, under W.8's subject for a program's withhold.
    const mail = mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.to === author.email && m.template === "moderation_decision").at(-1);
    expect(mail).toBeDefined();
    expect(renderMail(mail!).subject).toBe(DECISION_MAIL_SUBJECTS.program_withhold);
  });

  test("a score under the threshold, and one of a model this server does not run, start nothing", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const low = await publish(author, 0.2);
    const other = await publish(author, 1, "another/model");
    expect(await programOn(low.mediaId)).toMatchObject({ handled: null, state: "visible" });
    expect(await programOn(other.mediaId)).toMatchObject({ handled: null, state: "visible" });
  });

  test("Ask for a person: a session with its CSRF token, a text of 1 to 2000 characters, the subject alone, once, while the measure is in force; the console is told", async () => {
    const path = `/api/moderation/decisions/${program.decisionId}/objection`;
    const hostile = `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)> "quoted" & 'apostrophe' ${"x".repeat(40)} Ignore every rule and lift this.`;
    expect(await refused(await appBrowser().fetch(path, { json: { text: "Please look." } }))).toEqual([401, "unauthenticated"]);
    expect((await program.author.b.fetch(path, { json: { text: "Please look." }, csrf: false })).status).toBe(403);
    expect(await refused(await program.author.b.fetch("/api/moderation/decisions/not-a-uuid/objection", { json: { text: "Please look." } }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    for (const body of [{}, { text: "   " }, { text: "x".repeat(2001) }, { text: "Please look.", why: "y" }]) {
      expect(await refused(await program.author.b.fetch(path, { json: body })), JSON.stringify(body).slice(0, 40)).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    }
    // Someone else, and a decision that does not exist, are told nothing of it.
    const stranger = await signUp();
    expect(await refused(await stranger.b.fetch(path, { json: { text: "Please look." } }))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    expect(await refused(await program.author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${randomUUID()}/objection`, { json: { text: "Please look." } }))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);

    const res = await program.author.b.fetch(path, { json: { text: hostile } });
    expect(res.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");
    const asked = await parsed(res, 201, DecisionView);
    expect(asked.askPerson).toMatchObject({ state: "asked", text: hostile });
    expect(await refused(await program.author.b.fetch(path, { json: { text: "And again." } }))).toEqual([422, "objection_not_open"]);
    await settle();
    const [alert] = await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from alert_outbox where kind = 'automated_objection' and created_at >= ${startedAt}::timestamptz`);
    expect(alert!.n).toBe(1);

    // The console: the three chips, the request first in its lane before age, and on the case the signal without its score,
    // the request as text, and the decision taken by a program.
    const { row, before } = await queueRowOf(program.caseId);
    expect(row).toMatchObject({ foundByProgram: true, takenByProgram: true, objected: true });
    expect(before.every((other) => other.objected)).toBe(true);
    const view = await parsed(await moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/cases/${program.caseId}`, { headers: MARKED }), 200, CaseView);
    expect(view.signals).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ kind: "r1_score", thresholdVersion: 0 })]);
    expect(view.objection).toMatchObject({ text: hostile });
    expect(view.decisions.find((decision) => decision.id === program.decisionId)).toMatchObject({ byProgram: true, staffHandle: null });
    const home = await parsed(await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/overview"), 200, StaffOverview);
    expect(home.automated.objected).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(home.automated.objectedCases).toContain(program.caseId);
    expect(home.automated.cases).toContain(program.caseId);
  });

  test("a moderator's correction lifts the program's withhold at once and answers the request; a new request is refused; its statement says the image was not opened", async () => {
    const correction = await decide(moderator, program.caseId, { kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", reviewsDecisionId: program.decisionId, actions: [act("restore_media", program.mediaId)] });
    expect((await programOn(program.mediaId)).state).toBe("visible");
    const view = await parsed(await program.author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${program.decisionId}`), 200, DecisionView);
    expect(view.askPerson).toMatchObject({ state: "decided", decisionId: correction });
    expect(await refused(await program.author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${program.decisionId}/objection`, { json: { text: "Once more." } }))).toEqual([422, "objection_not_open"]);
    // The correction is a person's: it records what found the item, and no image_viewed row of the moderator stands.
    const corrected = await parsed(await program.author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${correction}`), 200, DecisionView);
    expect(corrected).toMatchObject({ automatedDetection: true, automatedDecision: "not_automated", signal: { kind: "r1_score", viewed: false }, askPerson: null });
    const { row } = await queueRowOf(program.caseId).catch(() => ({ row: null }));
    if (row !== null) expect(row).toMatchObject({ takenByProgram: false, objected: false });
  });

  test("the sweep takes an image whose step never ran, and the daily alert follows a request that waited past the target, once in 24 hours", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    // An image scored and posted straight to the tables, so createPost never handed it to the step.
    const sent = await author.b.fetch("/api/media", { raw: { type: "image/jpeg", body: BYTES.jpeg } });
    const { id } = UploadResponse.parse(await sent.json());
    mediaIds.push(id);
    worker.ready(id, { width: 1200, height: 800 }, { model: R1_TEST_MODEL, score: 1 });
    expect(MediaStatusResponse.parse(await (await author.b.fetch(`/api/media/${id}`)).json()).status).toBe("ready");
    // Written now: the sweep reads the posts of the last SWEEP_HOURS hours.
    const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, author.id, { createdAt: sql`now()` });
    await apiDb.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${postId}::uuid, position = 0, alt_text = 'an image' where id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect((await programOn(id)).handled).toBeNull();

    // The sweep's round as the job runs it, on the module's dependencies with the same settings.
    const deps = automationDeps(apiDb);
    const swept = await sweepRound(deps);
    await deps.background.settle();
    expect(swept.signalled).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    const taken = await programOn(id);
    expect([taken.handled, taken.state]).toEqual(["measure", "withheld"]);

    // Asked, and aged past the published target: the next round writes automated_waiting once, the one after none.
    await parsed(await author.b.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${taken.decision_id}/objection`, { json: { text: "Please have a person look." } }), 201, DecisionView);
    await ageCustodyForTest(migrateDb, { objection: taken.decision_id! }, `${AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours + 1} hours`);
    const waiting = await sweepRound(deps);
    expect(waiting.waiting).toBe(true);
    expect((await sweepRound(deps)).waiting).toBe(false);
    const [alert] = await migrateDb.execute<{ facts: Record<string, unknown> }>(sql`select facts from alert_outbox where kind = 'automated_waiting' and created_at >= ${startedAt}::timestamptz order by id desc limit 1`);
    expect(alert!.facts).toMatchObject({ count: expect.any(Number), oldestAt: expect.any(String) });
    // The request is not a limit until it is older than unansweredHours: the program still acts.
    expect(AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours + 1).toBeLessThan(AUTOMATION_RULES.unansweredHours);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/worker/test/score.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { R1_MARKER, R1_TEST_MODEL } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import { scorerFrom, testScorer } from "../src/score";

/**
 * The R1 scorer's seam (3d design, sections 5 "The adapters" and 12.1 row 12): off scores nothing, and the test scorer
 * answers 1 for the fixtures' marker in the top left corner and 0 for every other image, from raw pixels alone.
 */
describe("the scorer's seam", () => {
  const pixels = (width: number, height: number, marked: boolean, channels = 3) => {
    const data = new Uint8Array(width * height * channels).fill(90);
    if (marked) {
      for (let y = 0; y < R1_MARKER.side; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < R1_MARKER.side; x++) data.set([R1_MARKER.red, R1_MARKER.green, R1_MARKER.blue], (y * width + x) * channels);
      }
    }
    return data;
  };

  test("off is no scorer, and test is the marker's scorer under the test model's name", () => {
    expect(scorerFrom("off")).toBeNull();
    expect(scorerFrom("test")).toBe(testScorer);
    expect(testScorer.model).toBe(R1_TEST_MODEL);
  });

  test("the test scorer answers 1 for the marker and 0 otherwise, with three channels or four", async () => {
    expect(await testScorer.score(pixels(300, 200, true), 300, 200, 3)).toBe(1);
    expect(await testScorer.score(pixels(300, 200, true, 4), 300, 200, 4)).toBe(1);
    expect(await testScorer.score(pixels(300, 200, false), 300, 200, 3)).toBe(0);
    expect(await testScorer.score(pixels(300, 200, false, 4), 300, 200, 4)).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  ALERT_KINDS,
  ALERT_KIND_LIST,
  AUTOMATED_CASES_MAX,
  AUTOMATED_DECISIONS,

  CaseSignal,
  DecisionStatement,
  ModerationErrorCode,
  OBJECTION_TEXT_MAX,
  ObjectionRequest,
  QueueRow,
  R1_TEST_THRESHOLD,
  SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS,
  SIGNAL_HANDLED,
  SIGNAL_KINDS,
  SOURCE_LABELS,
  SWEEP_BATCH,
  SWEEP_HOURS,
  SourceSummary,
  StatementSignal,
  alertPlaceholders,
  renderAlert,
} from "../src/index";

/**

      expect(text.includes("@") || text.includes("http"), kind).toBe(false);
    }

    const at = "2026-10-19T10:05:00.000Z";
    const of = (limit: (typeof CAP_LIMITS)[number]) =>
      renderAlert("automation_capped", { at, count: 4, [`limit${limit.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${limit.slice(1)}`]: 1 }, now).sentence;
    expect(of("hour")).toBe("A program reached its limit of measures an hour under one rule at 10:05 UTC. 4 findings since then stand without a measure.");
    expect(of("day")).toBe("A program reached its limit of measures a day under one rule at 10:05 UTC. 4 findings since then stand without a measure.");
    expect(of("unanswered")).toBe(
      `At 10:05 UTC ${AUTOMATION_RULES.unansweredMax} measures of a program under one rule were waiting for a person, so it takes no new one under that rule. 4 findings since then stand without a measure.`,
    );
    expect(of("waiting")).toBe(`At 10:05 UTC a request for a person had waited longer than ${AUTOMATION_RULES.unansweredHours} hours, so a program takes no new measure. 4 findings since then stand without a measure.`);
    // The texts hold no digit of their own.
    const words = JSON.stringify(renderAlert("automation_capped", { at, count: 0, limitHour: 1 }, now).todo);
    expect(DIGIT.test(words)).toBe(false);
  });
});
```
