    bytes.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000), layout.expiryAt);
    Buffer.from(await stepUpBinding(sessionHandle, await stepUpActionHash(action))).copy(bytes, layout.bindingAt);
    return bytes.toString("base64url");
  }

  /**
   * A case as its route answers it: with the person's saved texts of a decision's kinds that no decision has named yet,
   * oldest first, each with its salt, so that the page can hold it to its digest. The forged draft, where a step asked for
   * one, carries this server's words under the saved digest.
   */
  function caseAnswer(view: CaseView): CaseView {
    const drafts = state.texts
      .filter((text) => text.caseId === view.id && DRAFT_KINDS.includes(text.kind) && !text.used)
      .map((text): StaffTextDraft => ({ id: text.id, kind: text.kind as StaffTextDraft["kind"], text: text.text, salt: text.salt, digest: text.digest, createdAt: text.createdAt }));
    const forged = state.forgedDraft;
    const last = forged !== null && forged.caseId === view.id ? drafts.findLast((draft) => draft.kind === forged.kind) : undefined;
    return { ...view, drafts: drafts.map((draft) => (draft === last ? { ...draft, text: FORGED_DRAFT } : draft)) };
  }

  /**
   * The appeals of the fixtures' cases that no review has answered, newest first, as the list's route answers them: each
   * with its case, its decision and the marks the case's own answer carries, and never the appellant's statement.
   */
  /** 3e Task 4: the replies that wait in the fixtures' cases, oldest first, as the queue's first page lists them: never their text. */
  function queueReplies(): QueueReply[] {
    const rows: QueueReply[] = [];
    for (const view of state.cases.values()) {
      for (const decided of view.decisions) {
        for (const action of decided.actions) {
          if ((action.kind !== "suspend" && action.kind !== "terminate") || !action.reply || action.reply.answeredAt !== null) continue;
          rows.push({ caseId: view.id, decisionId: decided.id, kind: action.kind, days: action.days, filedAt: action.reply.filedAt, onTime: action.reply.onTime, endsAt: action.period?.endsAt ?? null });
        }
      }
    }
    return rows.sort((a, b) => (a.filedAt < b.filedAt ? -1 : 1));
  }

  /**
   * 3e Task 4: the Standing screen's four lists, each with a row the walk reads: an account at the ladder's strikes whose
   * handle the walk opens a case on, a reporting record, a notice korbat could not send (a hostile handle, shown as text)
   * and a termination that waits for its appeal.
   */
  function standingLists(): StandingLists {
    return {
      atThreeStrikes: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: STANDING_HANDLE, caseId: null, activeStrikes: 3, ruleId: "R1", newestOn: "2026-10-04", maxDays: 3, mayTerminate: false }] },
      reportingRecords: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: "rep_orter", caseId: null, reports: 8, unfounded: 5, warnedOn: null, marksSince: null }] },
      noticesUndelivered: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: HOSTILE.script, caseId: CASE_POST, decidedOn: "2026-10-01", startsAt: "2026-10-15T09:00:00.000Z" }] },
      terminationsWaiting: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: "term_inated", caseId: CASE_POST, decidedOn: "2026-09-01", finalOn: null, heldBy: "appeal", replyOnTime: null }] },
    };
  }

  function pendingAppeals(): AppealRow[] {
    const rows: AppealRow[] = [];
    for (const view of state.cases.values()) {
      for (const appeal of view.appeals) {
        const decided = view.decisions.find((found) => found.id === appeal.decisionId);
        if (appeal.result !== null || appeal.reviewer === null || !decided) continue;
        rows.push({
          id: appeal.id,
          caseId: view.id,
          decisionId: decided.id,
          filedAt: appeal.filedAt,
          decidedAt: decided.decidedAt,
          deadline: iso(Date.parse(decided.decidedAt) + 182 * 24 * HOUR),
          ruleId: decided.ruleId,
          legal: decided.ground === "illegal",
          actions: decided.actions.map((action) => action.kind),
          reviewer: appeal.reviewer,
          needsAdmin: appeal.needsAdmin,
          mayReview: appeal.mayReview,
          standingFirst: false,
        });
      }
    }
    return rows.sort((a, b) => (a.filedAt < b.filedAt ? 1 : -1));
  }

  function parse<T>(schema: z.ZodType<T>, body: unknown, what: string): T {
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      problem(`${what}: a body the contracts refuse`);
      throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
    }
    return parsed.data;
  }

  /** One staff route's answer. */
  async function route(req: IncomingMessage, url: URL, body: unknown): Promise<Answer> {
    const key = `${req.method} ${url.pathname}`;

    if (key === "POST /api/staff/enroll/options") {
      const input = parse(StaffEnrollOptionsRequest, body, key);
      if (input.token !== state.enrolmentToken || state.enrolmentUsed) throw refuse("staff_enrollment_invalid");
      // Bound, as the API binds it, to the enrolment's id, which the page is never told: random bytes stand for its hash.
      const challenge = ceremonyChallenge("staff_register", randomBytes(CEREMONY_CHALLENGE.bindingBytes));
      state.challenges.set(challenge, { purpose: "register" });
      const securityKey = input.kind === "security_key";
      // As @simplewebauthn/server 14.0.2 writes them for the console: the security-key hint only with cross-platform attachment.
      const options = {
        challenge,
        rp: { id: "localhost", name: "korbat" },
        user: { id: userHandle, name: input.name, displayName: input.name },
        pubKeyCredParams: [-8, -7, -257].map((alg) => ({ alg, type: "public-key" })),
        timeout: 300_000,
        attestation: "none",
        excludeCredentials: state.keys.filter((k) => k.credentialId !== null).map((k) => ({ id: k.credentialId, type: "public-key" })),
        authenticatorSelection: { residentKey: "required", userVerification: "required", requireResidentKey: true, ...(securityKey ? { authenticatorAttachment: "cross-platform" } : {}) },
        extensions: { credProps: true },
        ...(securityKey ? { hints: ["security-key"] } : {}),
      };
      // As in production, the console's relying party ID is not the app's, so the page may signal a refused key.
      return { status: 200, body: { options, rpShared: false } };
    }

    if (key === "POST /api/staff/enroll/verify") {
      const input = parse(StaffEnrollVerifyRequest, body, key);
      if (input.token !== state.enrolmentToken || state.enrolmentUsed) throw refuse("staff_enrollment_invalid");
      clientData(input.response.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.create", "register", "staff_key_refused");
      const refusal = flagRefusal(flagsOf(authDataOf(Buffer.from(input.response.response.attestationObject, "base64url"))));
      // A refusal leaves the link usable, so the person can try another key.
      if (refusal) throw refuse(refusal);
      state.enrolmentUsed = true;
      const stored: KeyRecord = { id: randomUUID(), name: input.name, createdAt: iso(Date.now()), lastUsedAt: null, credentialId: input.response.id };
      state.keys.push(stored);
      return { status: 200, body: { key: { id: stored.id, name: stored.name, createdAt: stored.createdAt, lastUsedAt: stored.lastUsedAt } } };
    }

    if (key === "POST /api/staff/signin/options") {
      if (body !== undefined) problem(`${key}: a body, where the route takes none`);
      state.signInOptionsServed += 1;
      if (state.stepUpChallengeAtNextSignIn) {
        state.stepUpChallengeAtNextSignIn = false;
        // The forged case: a step-up challenge for revoking one of the person's sessions, bound to a handle of this
        // server's choosing. Never recorded as issued, so an assertion made over it would be a problem here too.
        const victim = [...state.sessions.values()][0]?.handle ?? randomUUID();
        const challenge = await stepUpChallenge(randomUUID(), { action: "staff_session_revoked", target: { type: "staff_session", id: victim }, params: {} });
        return { status: 200, body: { options: { challenge, rpId: "localhost", timeout: 300_000, userVerification: "required", allowCredentials: [] } } };
      }
      const challenge = ceremonyChallenge("staff_signin");
      state.challenges.set(challenge, { purpose: "signin" });
      return { status: 200, body: { options: { challenge, rpId: "localhost", timeout: 300_000, userVerification: "required", allowCredentials: [] } } };
    }

    if (key === "POST /api/staff/signin/verify") {
      const input = parse(StaffSignInVerifyRequest, body, key);
      clientData(input.response.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "signin", "staff_key_invalid");
      const staffKey = state.keys.find((k) => k.credentialId !== null && k.credentialId === input.response.id);
      if (!staffKey || input.response.response.userHandle !== userHandle) throw refuse("staff_key_invalid");
      const refusal = flagRefusal(flagsOf(Buffer.from(input.response.response.authenticatorData, "base64url")));
      // Read after the signature, as the API reads them; staff_key_refused stands for flags it cannot read at all.
      if (refusal) throw refuse(refusal === "staff_key_refused" ? "staff_key_invalid" : refusal);
      staffKey.lastUsedAt = iso(Date.now());
      const session: SessionRecord = {
        handle: randomUUID(),
        token: b64url(32),
        csrf: b64url(32),
        browser: CURRENT_BROWSER,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        lastUsedAt: Date.now(),
        credentialId: staffKey.credentialId,
      };
      state.sessions.set(session.handle, session);
      const setCookies = [`${SESSION_COOKIE}=${session.token}; ${COOKIE}; HttpOnly; Max-Age=43200`, `${CSRF_COOKIE}=${session.csrf}; ${COOKIE}; Max-Age=43200`];
      return { status: 200, body: me(session), headers: { "set-cookie": setCookies } };
    }

    // Everything below needs a staff session.
    const routes = new Set([
      "GET /api/staff/me",
      "GET /api/staff/sessions",
      "GET /api/staff/keys",
      "GET /api/staff/audit",
      "POST /api/staff/signout",
      "POST /api/staff/step-up/options",
      "GET /api/staff/overview",
      "GET /api/staff/queue",
      "GET /api/staff/appeals",
      "POST /api/staff/findings",
      "GET /api/staff/standing",
      // 3f: the contact point.
      "GET /api/staff/contact",
      // 3f, Task 2: the orders.
      "GET /api/staff/orders",
      "POST /api/staff/orders",
      // 3f, Task 6: the audit log's download and its mark, and what a restore lost.
      "POST /api/staff/audit/export",
      "POST /api/staff/audit/export/mark",
      "GET /api/staff/restore",
    ]);
    const revoke = req.method === "DELETE" && /^\/api\/staff\/sessions\/[^/]+$/.test(url.pathname);
    const ofCase = /^\/api\/staff\/cases\/([0-9a-f-]{36})(?:\/(snapshots|texts|decisions))?$/.exec(url.pathname);
    const image = req.method === "GET" ? IMAGE_PATH.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    const reveal = req.method === "POST" ? /^\/api\/staff\/items\/([0-9a-f-]{36})\/reveal$/.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    const review = req.method === "POST" ? /^\/api\/staff\/decisions\/([0-9a-f-]{36})\/review$/.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    // 3f: a message closed, by its id in the path. An id that is no lower-case uuid is the route's 400, as the API's.
    const closing = req.method === "POST" ? /^[/]api[/]staff[/]contact[/]([^/]+)[/]close$/.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    // 3f, Task 2: an order, its links, its events and its corrections, by its id in the path.
    const ofOrder = /^[/]api[/]staff[/]orders[/]([^/]+)(?:[/](items|events|correct|effect))?$/.exec(url.pathname);
    // 3f, Task 6: a gap closed as not needed, by its id in the path.
    const gapClose = req.method === "POST" ? /^[/]api[/]staff[/]restore[/]gaps[/]([0-9a-f-]{36})[/]close$/.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    // 3d Task 2: an admin's release of a seal for good, by the seal's ledger row.
    const sealRelease = req.method === "POST" ? /^[/]api[/]staff[/]seals[/]([0-9a-f-]{36})[/]release$/.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    if (!routes.has(key) && !revoke && !ofCase && !image && !reveal && !review && !closing && !ofOrder && !gapClose && !sealRelease) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    const session = requireStaff(req);

    // Moderation cases (3c design, section 7.3), answered from the fixtures' cases.
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/overview") {
      // The path's three lists: one decision of another staff account that answered a report without a seal, and what
      // the walk itself did, read from the cases as they now stand.
      const cases = [...state.cases.values()];
      const declined = cases.flatMap((view) => view.sealsDeclined.filter((text) => text.staffHandle === PERSON_HANDLE).map((text) => ({ at: text.createdAt, handle: text.staffHandle, caseId: view.id })));
      const seals = cases.flatMap((view) =>
        view.decisions
          .filter((decided) => decided.kind === "interim" && decided.staffHandle === PERSON_HANDLE)
          .flatMap((decided) => decided.actions.filter((action) => action.kind === "seal_media" && action.inForce).map((action) => ({ at: decided.decidedAt, handle: decided.staffHandle, caseId: view.id, posts: action.sealed?.posts ?? 0, images: action.sealed?.images ?? 0 }))),
      );
      // The appeals: those of the fixtures' cases that still wait, and one more that nobody at korbat can review now.
      const waiting = pendingAppeals().length + 1;
      return {
        status: 200,
        body: overview({
          appealsWaiting: waiting,
          appealsYouMayReview: pendingAppeals().filter((row) => row.mayReview).length,
          appealsWithoutReviewer: 1,
          reveals: { total: 1 + state.reveals.length, items: [{ at: iso(now - 26 * HOUR), handle: HOSTILE.script, caseId: CASE_POST }] },
          protectionLifted: { total: 1, items: [{ at: iso(now - 3 * HOUR), handle: HOSTILE.img, caseId: CASE_FROZEN, kind: "dismissed" }] },
          sealsDeclined: { total: declined.length, items: declined },
          interimSeals: { total: seals.length, items: seals },
          // Two due rules are late, so the home screen shows its line for late erasures with the runbook's sentence.
          erasureOverdue: { caseEvidence: 0, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 0, redactions: 0, images: 60, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 2 },
          // 3f: what the walk's step set, nothing at the contact point and a working channel otherwise.
          ...state.authorities,
          contact: { ...state.authorities.contact, dueAt: nearestDue() },
          reportsOwed: state.reportsOwed,
          copy: state.copy,
          restore: state.restoreOverview,
          quarantine: state.quarantine,
          destructive: state.destructive,
          automated: state.automated,
        }),
      };
    }
    // 3f: the contact point's messages, newest first, all or only those nobody handled, a page at a time.
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/contact") {
      const open = url.searchParams.get("open");
      const cursor = url.searchParams.get("cursor");
      if ((open !== null && open !== "1") || (cursor !== null && !/^[0-9]+$/.test(cursor))) throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
      const listed = state.contactMessages.filter((m) => open === null || m.disposition === null).sort((a, b) => b.receivedAt.localeCompare(a.receivedAt));
      const from = cursor === null ? 0 : Number(cursor);
      const items = listed.slice(from, from + CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE);
      return { status: 200, body: { items, nextCursor: from + CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE < listed.length ? String(from + CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE) : null } };
    }
    if (closing) {
      const id = closing[1]!;
      if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(id)) {
        problem(`POST ${url.pathname}: an id that is not a lower-case uuid`);
        throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
      }
      const request = parse(ContactCloseRequest, body, "the close of a message");
      const found = state.contactMessages.find((m) => m.id === id);
      if (!found) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      if (found.disposition !== null) throw new Refusal(409, "message_handled");
      found.disposition = request.disposition;
      found.handledBy = PERSON_HANDLE;
      found.handledAt = new Date().toISOString();
      state.contactClosed.push({ id, disposition: request.disposition });
      return { status: 204 };
    }
    // 3f, Task 2: the orders, opened from a message or without one, with their links, their events and their corrections.
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/orders") {
      const open = state.orders.filter((order) => order.closedAt === null).map(orderSummary);
      return { status: 200, body: { open, closed: state.orders.filter((order) => order.closedAt !== null).map(orderSummary) } };
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/orders") {
      const request = parse(OrderOpenRequest, body, "the opening of an order");
      const at = new Date().toISOString();
      const message = request.messageId === null ? null : (state.contactMessages.find((m) => m.id === request.messageId) ?? null);
      if (request.messageId !== null && message === null) throw new Refusal(422, "order_needs_message");
      if (message !== null && message.disposition !== null) throw new Refusal(409, "message_handled");
      const tco = request.kind === "tco_removal";
      const receivedAt = message === null ? null : message.receivedAt;
      const items = request.links.map((link, i) => orderItem(link, i + 1, at));
      const view: OrderView = {
        id: randomUUID(),
        kind: request.kind,
        memberState: request.memberState,
        authority: request.authority,
        reference: request.reference,
        openedAt: at,
        state: !tco ? "no_clock" : receivedAt === null ? "unknown_deadline" : "running",
        clock: tco ? runningClock(receivedAt, items.length) : null,
        dueAt: null,
        closedAt: null,
        closeGround: null,
        items,
        itemsInForce: 0,
        verified: false,
        noticesHeld: 0,
        channel: request.channel,
        messageId: request.messageId,
        receivedAt,
        sentAt: null,
        issuedAt: null,
        sectionC: request.sectionC,
        emergency: request.emergency,
        crossBorder: request.memberState !== "DE",
        withholdFromAuthor: request.withholdFromAuthor,
        preserve: tco,
        openedBy: PERSON_HANDLE,
        openedVia: "console",
        importedAt: null,
        tellPerson: null,
        events: [{ id: randomUUID(), kind: "opened", ground: null, at, effectiveAt: null, itemId: null, by: PERSON_HANDLE, via: "console" }],
        owed: { received: receivedAt === null, verification: true, issuedAt: tco, texts: true, document: true, holdUntil: false, tellPerson: request.kind === "dsa_art10", scrutinyUntil: null },
        hold: request.sectionC ? { until: null, basis: tco ? "regulation" : "authority", open: true, extended: false, endedAt: null, endReason: null, releasedAt: null, noticesHeld: 0 } : null,
        mayClose: true,
        mayEvents: tco ? ["annex3_sent", "closed_without_effect"] : ["receipt_confirmed", "closed_without_effect"],
        mayCorrect: "entry",
      };
      state.orders.push(view);
      if (message !== null) Object.assign(message, { disposition: "order", handledAt: at, handledBy: PERSON_HANDLE, orders: [view.id] });
      state.orderWrites.push({ what: "opened", id: view.id, body: request, key: false });
      return { status: 201, body: view };
    }
    if (ofOrder) {
      const id = ofOrder[1]!;
      const part = ofOrder[2];
      if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(id)) {
        problem(`${req.method} ${url.pathname}: an id that is not a lower-case uuid`);
        throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
      }
      const view = state.orders.find((order) => order.id === id);
      if (!view) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      if (req.method === "GET" && part === undefined) return { status: 200, body: orderAnswer(view) };
      if (req.method !== "POST" || part === undefined) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      const at = new Date().toISOString();
      if (part === "items") {
        const request = parse(OrderItemsRequest, body, "the links added to an order");
        view.items.push(...request.links.map((link, i) => orderItem(link, view.items.length + i + 1, at)));
        if (view.clock !== null) view.clock.itemsOpen += request.links.length;
        state.orderWrites.push({ what: "items", id, body: request, key: false });
        return { status: 201, body: orderAnswer(view) };
      }
      if (part === "events") {
        const { stepUp, ...params } = parse(OrderEventRecordRequest, body, "an order's event");
        await confirmedOrder(stepUp, { action: "order_event_recorded", target: { type: "order", id }, params }, session);
        if (!orderAnswer(view).mayEvents.includes(params.kind)) throw new Refusal(422, "order_event_refused");
        // 3f, Task 3: a removal order's one extension, recorded by an admin: the hold runs its extension longer, once.
        if (params.kind === "hold_extended" && view.hold !== null && view.hold.until !== null) {
          view.hold = { ...view.hold, extended: true, until: iso(Date.parse(view.hold.until) + ORDER_RULES.holdExtensionDays * 86_400_000) };
          const message = state.contactMessages.find((m) => m.id === params.messageId);
          if (message) Object.assign(message, { disposition: "order", handledAt: at, handledBy: PERSON_HANDLE, orders: [view.id] });
        }
        const clock = view.clock;
        if (params.kind === "annex3_sent" && clock !== null && params.ground !== null) {
          Object.assign(clock, { stopped: true, stoppedAt: at, stopGround: params.ground, deadlineAt: null, targetAt: null });
          view.state = "stopped";
          view.mayEvents = ["grounds_ceased", "clarification_received", "closed_without_effect"];
        }
        if ((params.kind === "clarification_received" || params.kind === "grounds_ceased") && clock !== null) {
          // A fresh hour from the clarification's delivery, or from the Annex III when that is later; from now when the grounds cease.
          const message = params.messageId === null ? null : state.contactMessages.find((m) => m.id === params.messageId);
          const from = message ? iso(Math.max(Date.parse(message.receivedAt), Date.parse(clock.stoppedAt ?? at))) : at;
          Object.assign(clock, runningClock(from, clock.itemsOpen), { stoppedAt: null, stopGround: null });
          view.state = "running";
          view.mayEvents = ["annex3_sent", "closed_without_effect"];
        }
        view.events.push({ id: randomUUID(), kind: params.kind, ground: params.ground, at, effectiveAt: null, itemId: null, by: PERSON_HANDLE, via: "console" });
        state.orderWrites.push({ what: "event", id, body: params, key: true });
        return { status: 201, body: orderAnswer(view) };
      }
      if (part === "correct") {
        const request = parse(OrderCorrectRequest, body, "the correction of an order");
        const rule = orderAnswer(view).mayCorrect;
        if (rule === null) throw new Refusal(409, "order_closed");
        if (rule === "caution" && Object.keys(request.facts).some((member) => member !== "sectionC")) throw new Refusal(403, "admin_required");
        if (rule === "admin") {
          if (request.stepUp === undefined) throw refuse("staff_step_up_required");
          await confirmedOrder(request.stepUp, { action: "order_corrected", target: { type: "order", id }, params: { facts: request.facts } }, session);
        } else if (request.stepUp !== undefined) problem(`${url.pathname}: a key asked for a correction under the rule ${rule}`);
        const { closeItems, ...facts } = request.facts;
        for (const close of closeItems ?? []) {
          const item = view.items.find((found) => found.id === close.itemId);
          if (!item || item.closedAt !== null || item.disabledAt !== null) throw new Refusal(422, "order_event_refused");
          Object.assign(item, { closedAt: at, closedReason: close.reason });
          if (view.clock !== null) view.clock.itemsOpen -= 1;
        }
        Object.assign(view, facts);
        view.events.push({ id: randomUUID(), kind: "corrected", ground: rule, at, effectiveAt: null, itemId: null, by: PERSON_HANDLE, via: "console" });
        state.orderWrites.push({ what: "corrected", id, body: request.facts, key: request.stepUp !== undefined });
        return { status: 201, body: orderAnswer(view) };
      }
      if (part === "effect") {
        // 3f, Task 3: "Disable for an order", confirmed by the key over exactly these facts and these items.
        const { stepUp, ...params } = parse(OrderEffectRequest, body, "an order's effect");
        await confirmedOrder(stepUp, { action: "order_effected", target: { type: "order", id }, params }, session);
        if (view.closedAt !== null) throw new Refusal(409, "order_closed");
        if (view.kind === "dsa_art9" && !view.verified && !(state.role === "admin" && params.urgent)) throw new Refusal(409, "order_not_verified");
        const facts: Record<string, unknown> = { kind: view.kind, memberState: view.memberState, authority: view.authority, reference: view.reference, sectionC: view.sectionC, emergency: view.emergency, withholdFromAuthor: view.withholdFromAuthor };
        if (Object.entries(facts).some(([member, value]) => (params as Record<string, unknown>)[member] !== value)) throw new Refusal(409, "order_changed");
        const chosen = params.items.map((one) => view.items.find((item) => item.id === one.itemId && item.postId === one.postId && !item.inForce && item.closedAt === null));
        if (chosen.some((item) => item === undefined)) throw new Refusal(409, "order_changed");
        for (const item of chosen as OrderItemView[]) {
          if (item.disabledAt === null && view.clock !== null) view.clock.itemsOpen -= 1;
          Object.assign(item, {
            inForce: true,
            disabledAt: item.disabledAt ?? at,
            decisionId: randomUUID(),
            caseId: randomUUID(),
            preserveUntil: view.preserve ? preservedUntil(at) : null,
            preserveEndedAt: null,
            erasedAt: null,
            reinstatedAt: null,
            reinstatedGround: null,
            post: item.post === null ? null : { ...item.post, state: "disabled", preview: null },
          });
          view.events.push({ id: randomUUID(), kind: "effect_given", ground: null, at, effectiveAt: null, itemId: item.id, by: PERSON_HANDLE, via: "console" });
        }
        view.itemsInForce = view.items.filter((item) => item.inForce).length;
        const open = view.items.filter((item) => item.disabledAt === null && item.closedAt === null).length;
        if (view.clock !== null) {
          view.clock.firstEffectAt ??= at;
          view.clock.lastEffectAt = at;
          if (open === 0) Object.assign(view.clock, { withinHour: view.clock.deadlineAt === null ? null : Date.parse(at) <= Date.parse(view.clock.deadlineAt) });
        }
        if (open === 0) view.state = "given_effect";
        view.mayEvents = [...view.mayEvents.filter((kind) => kind !== "closed_without_effect" && kind !== "annex2_sent"), ...(view.kind === "tco_removal" ? (["annex2_sent"] as const) : [])];
        state.orderWrites.push({ what: "effected", id, body: params, key: true });
        return { status: 201, body: orderAnswer(view) };
      }
      throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/standing") return { status: 200, body: standingLists() };
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/queue") {
      // Two pages: the two urgent cases, then the rest behind a cursor.
      const cursor = url.searchParams.get("cursor");
      if (cursor !== null && cursor !== "second-page") throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
      if (state.queueRows !== null && cursor === null) return { status: 200, body: { cases: state.queueRows, nextCursor: null, replies: queueReplies() } satisfies QueuePage };
      const page: QueuePage = cursor === null ? { cases: QUEUE_ROWS.slice(0, 2), nextCursor: "second-page", replies: queueReplies() } : { cases: QUEUE_ROWS.slice(2), nextCursor: null, replies: [] };
      return { status: 200, body: page };
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/appeals") {
      // One page: what waits in the fixtures' cases, newest first, and an appeal of a seal that only an admin reviews and
      // that korbat's one admin took part in, so that the list shows each mark.
      if (url.searchParams.get("cursor") !== null) throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
      const unreviewable: AppealRow = {
        id: "28a1b20d-7c39-4b0d-84a9-58f746db2a23",
        caseId: CASE_FROZEN,
        decisionId: "39b2c31e-8d4a-4c1e-95ba-69a857ec3b34",
        filedAt: iso(now - 30 * HOUR),
        decidedAt: iso(now - 9 * 24 * HOUR),
        deadline: iso(now + 170 * 24 * HOUR),
        ruleId: "R2",
        legal: false,
        actions: ["seal_media"],
        reviewer: "none_single_staff",
        needsAdmin: true,
        mayReview: false,
        standingFirst: false,
        released: state.appealReleased,
      };
      return { status: 200, body: { appeals: [unreviewable, ...pendingAppeals()], nextCursor: null } satisfies AppealsPage };
    }
    if (review) {
      const what = "POST /api/staff/decisions/:decision/review";
      const decisionId = review[1]!;
      const { stepUp, ...params } = parse(AppealReviewRequest, body, what);
      const found = [...state.cases.values()].find((view) => view.decisions.some((decided) => decided.id === decisionId));
      const reviewed = found?.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === decisionId);
      if (!found || !reviewed) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      // The assertion: by the session's own key, over a challenge issued for exactly this review of exactly this decision.
      const issued = clientData(stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
      const hash = await stepUpActionHash({ action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: decisionId }, params });
      if (issued.target !== decisionId || issued.hash !== hash || stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {
        problem(`${what}: an assertion for ${String(issued.target)} from ${stepUp.id}, over ${issued.hash === hash ? "these" : "other"} params`);
        throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
      }
      if (params.stateVersion !== found.stateVersion) throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.case_changed, "case_changed");
      const appeal = found.appeals.find((filed) => filed.decisionId === decisionId && filed.result === null);
      // The appeal the key confirmed is the decision's pending one, and this person is one the case's answer let review it.
      if (!appeal || appeal.id !== params.appealId) throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.case_changed, "case_changed");
      if (!appeal.mayReview) {
        problem(`${what}: a review by someone the case's answer did not mark as its reviewer`);
        throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.reviewer_conflict, "reviewer_conflict");
      }
      const [newest] = found.snapshots;
      const shownDigest = !newest || newest.withheld ? null : await snapshotDigest({ ...newest });
      if (!newest || params.snapshotId !== newest.id || params.snapshotDigest !== shownDigest) {
        problem(`${what}: a snapshot that is not the case's newest as the page was shown it`);
        throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.snapshot_mismatch, "snapshot_mismatch");
      }
      // The reason: one the page saved on this case as a review reason, not yet used, and never a digest this server made up.
      const saved = state.texts.find((text) => text.caseId === found.id && text.kind === "review_reason" && text.digest === params.reasonDigest && !text.used);
      if (!saved || state.forgedDigests.includes(params.reasonDigest)) {
        problem(`${what}: a review reason the page did not save on this case`);
        throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.text_not_found, "text_not_found");
      }
      // A review lifts what is still in force of the reviewed decision, and its answer says how much.
      // 3e: the strike is not lifted one by one: it is overruled with the whole finding, and only then.
      const inForce = reviewed.actions.filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null && action.kind !== "strike" && action.inForce).length;
      const lifted = params.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "overrule").length;
      if ((params.outcome === "kept" && lifted !== 0) || (params.outcome === "reversed" && lifted !== inForce) || (params.outcome === "partly_reversed" && (lifted === 0 || lifted >= inForce))) {
        problem(`${what}: an answer that its reversals do not bear out`);
        throw new Refusal(422, "invalid_decision");
      }
      const strikeIssue = strikeProblem(found, "review", params.outcome, null, null, params.actions, reviewed);
      if (strikeIssue !== null) {
        problem(`${what}: ${strikeIssue}`);
        throw new Refusal(422, "invalid_decision");
      }
      saved.used = true;
      state.reviews.push({ decisionId, params });
      applyReview(found, reviewed, params, saved.text, PERSON_HANDLE);
      return { status: 201, body: caseAnswer(found) };
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/findings") {
      const finding = parse(FindingRequest, body, key);
      if (finding.target.kind === "link" && finding.target.url === DEAD_LINK) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      state.findings.push(finding);
      return { status: 201, body: { caseId: CASE_POST } };
    }
    if (image) {
      const found = state.cases.get(image[1]!);
      state.imageRequests.push(url.pathname);
      if (state.refuseNextImage) {
        state.refuseNextImage = false;
        throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.image_refused, "image_refused");
      }
      // As gate V and the image route answer: only an image of the case's own post, and none while it is frozen.
      const listed = found?.snapshots.some((snapshot) => !snapshot.withheld && snapshot.media?.some((media) => media.id === image[2]));
      if (!found || !found.imagesAllowed || !listed) {
        problem(`${key}: an image the console must not ask for`);
        throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.image_refused, "image_refused");
      }
      return { status: 200, raw: { type: "image/webp", bytes: FIXTURE_WEBP }, headers: { "cache-control": "private, no-store", "x-content-type-options": "nosniff" } };
    }
    if (ofCase) {
      const found = state.cases.get(ofCase[1]!);
      if (!found) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      if (ofCase[2] === undefined && req.method === "GET") {
        if (state.recuseNextCaseRead) {
          state.recuseNextCaseRead = false;
          throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.staff_recused, "staff_recused");
        }
        return { status: 200, body: caseAnswer(found) };
      }
      if (ofCase[2] === "snapshots" && req.method === "POST") {
        state.snapshotsTaken += 1;
        // The fresh snapshot holds the account's fields as they read now; the case then carries it first.
        const [newest] = found.snapshots;
        if (found.target.type === "account" && newest && !newest.withheld) {
          found.snapshots = [{ ...newest, id: randomUUID(), takenAt: iso(Date.now()), handle: found.target.handle, displayName: found.target.displayName, bio: found.target.bio }, ...found.snapshots];
        }
        return { status: 200, body: { id: found.snapshots[0]!.id, digest: found.snapshots[0]!.digest } };
      }
      if (ofCase[2] === "texts" && req.method === "GET") return { status: 200, body: { texts: [] } };
      if (ofCase[2] === "texts" && req.method === "POST") {
        const saved = parse(StaffTextSaveRequest, body, key);
        // No text is saved empty: the page's own buttons and its save never send one.
        if (saved.text.trim() === "") {
          problem(`${key}: an empty text`);
          throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
        }
        // The server recomputes the digest: the console must have sent the digest of exactly the text it sent.
        if ((await textDigest(saved.salt, saved.text)) !== saved.digest) {
          problem(`${key}: a digest that is not the text's`);
          throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.text_invalid, "text_invalid");
        }
        if (state.refuseNextSave !== null) {
          const code = state.refuseNextSave;
          state.refuseNextSave = null;
          throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS[code], code);
        }
        const id = randomUUID();
        const stored = { id, caseId: found.id, kind: saved.kind, salt: saved.salt, createdAt: iso(Date.now()) };
        if (state.hostileNextSave) {
          state.hostileNextSave = false;
          // The forged case: a text of this server's own is stored in the person's name, and its digest answered. A
          // reveal confirmed under that digest would go through here, so only the page's own check stops it.
          const digest = await textDigest(saved.salt, FORGED_REASON);
          state.texts.push({ ...stored, text: FORGED_REASON, digest });
          state.forgedDigests.push(digest);
          return { status: 201, body: { id, digest } };
        }
        state.texts.push({ ...stored, text: saved.text, digest: saved.digest });
        // A note and a recorded choice not to seal are complete when saved, and listed on the case.
        if (saved.kind === "note") found.notes = [...found.notes, { id, staffHandle: PERSON_HANDLE, createdAt: iso(Date.now()), text: saved.text }];
        if (saved.kind === "seal_declined") found.sealsDeclined = [...found.sealsDeclined, { id, staffHandle: PERSON_HANDLE, createdAt: iso(Date.now()), text: saved.text }];
        return { status: 201, body: { id, digest: saved.digest } };
      }
      if (ofCase[2] === "decisions" && req.method === "POST") {
        const what = "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/decisions";
        const { stepUp, ...params } = parse(CaseDecisionRequest, body, what);
        // The assertion: by the session's own key, over a challenge issued for exactly this decision on exactly this case.
        const issued = clientData(stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
        const hash = await stepUpActionHash({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: found.id }, params });
        if (issued.target !== found.id || issued.hash !== hash || stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {
          problem(`${what}: an assertion for ${String(issued.target)} from ${stepUp.id}, over ${issued.hash === hash ? "these" : "other"} params`);
          throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
        }
        const flags = flagRefusal(flagsOf(Buffer.from(stepUp.response.authenticatorData, "base64url")));
        if (flags) throw refuse(flags === "staff_key_refused" ? "staff_step_up_invalid" : flags);
        if (params.stateVersion !== found.stateVersion) throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.case_changed, "case_changed");
        // The snapshot: the case's newest, under the digest of what the page was shown, recomputed here from its members.
        const [newest] = found.snapshots;
        // 3f, Task 3: on a post preserved for an order every copy is withheld, and the decision signs the newest's stored digest.
        const shownDigest = !newest ? null : newest.withheld ? (found.preserved ? newest.digest : null) : await snapshotDigest({ ...newest });
        if (!newest || params.snapshotId !== newest.id || params.snapshotDigest !== shownDigest) {
          problem(`${what}: a snapshot that is not the case's newest as the page was shown it`);
          throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.snapshot_mismatch, "snapshot_mismatch");
        }
        // 3e: the strike and its overruling, as the database holds them to the case's answer and the corrected decision.
        const strikeIssue = strikeProblem(found, params.kind, params.outcome, params.ground, params.ruleId, params.actions, found.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === params.reviewsDecisionId));
        if (strikeIssue !== null) {
          problem(`${what}: ${strikeIssue}`);
          throw params.kind === "correction" ? new Refusal(422, "invalid_decision") : new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.strike_mismatch, "strike_mismatch");
        }
        // Each text the decision names: one the page saved on this case, of its kind, not yet used, and never a digest this server made up.
        const named = [
          ["facts", params.factsDigest],
          [params.kind === "correction" ? "review_reason" : "reason", params.reasonDigest],
          ["legal_reference", params.legalReferenceDigest],
        ] as const;
        const texts: (string | null)[] = [];
        for (const [kind, digest] of named) {
          const saved = digest === null ? undefined : state.texts.find((text) => text.caseId === found.id && text.kind === kind && text.digest === digest && !text.used);
          if (digest !== null && (!saved || state.forgedDigests.includes(digest))) {
            problem(`${what}: a ${kind} text the page did not save on this case`);
            throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.text_not_found, "text_not_found");
          }
          if (saved) saved.used = true;
          texts.push(saved?.text ?? null);
        }
        // 3e Task 5: a mark names an item this decision answers that can be marked, as unfounded_marks_check holds it.
        const unmarkable = params.unfounded.filter((itemId) => !found.items.some((each) => each.id === itemId && each.markable && each.outcome === null && each.seq <= params.throughSeq));
        if (unmarkable.length > 0) {
          problem(`${what}: a mark on an item this decision does not answer or that cannot be marked`);
          throw new Refusal(422, "invalid_decision");
        }
        state.decisions.push({ caseId: found.id, params });
        applyDecision(found, params, { facts: texts[0] ?? null, reason: texts[1] ?? null, legalReference: texts[2] ?? null }, PERSON_HANDLE);
        return { status: 201, body: caseAnswer(found) };
      }
      throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    }
    if (reveal) {
      const itemId = reveal[1]!;
      const input = parse(IdentityRevealRequest, body, "POST /api/staff/items/:item/reveal");
      const issued = clientData(input.stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
      if (issued.target !== itemId || input.stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {
        problem(`reveal ${itemId}: an assertion for ${String(issued.target)} from ${input.stepUp.id}`);
        throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
      }
      const owner = [...state.cases.values()].find((view) => view.items.some((item) => item.id === itemId));
      // The reason must be one the page saved on the item's case, and used once.
      const reason = state.texts.find((text) => text.kind === "reveal_reason" && text.digest === input.reasonDigest && text.caseId === owner?.id);
      if (!owner || !reason || state.reveals.some((done) => done.reasonDigest === input.reasonDigest)) throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.text_not_found, "text_not_found");
      state.reveals.push({ itemId, reasonDigest: input.reasonDigest });
      return { status: 200, body: { handle: REVEALED_HANDLE, name: null } };
    }

    if (key === "GET /api/staff/me") return { status: 200, body: me(session) };
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/sessions") {
      const sessions: StaffSession[] = [...state.sessions.values()].map((s) => ({
        handle: s.handle,
        browser: s.browser,
        createdAt: iso(s.createdAt),
        lastUsedAt: iso(s.lastUsedAt),
        current: s === session,
      }));
      return { status: 200, body: { sessions } };
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/keys") return { status: 200, body: { keys: state.keys.map((k): StaffKey => ({ id: k.id, name: k.name, createdAt: k.createdAt, lastUsedAt: k.lastUsedAt })) } };
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/audit") return { status: 200, body: auditPage(url.searchParams) };
    // 3f, Task 6 (7.16): the download, confirmed by the session's key for exactly these places; its mark, only for the
    // place the session's newest download released and the hash that place holds.
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/audit/export") {
      const input = parse(AuditExportRequest, body, key);
      if (input.stepUp === undefined) throw new Refusal(403, "staff_step_up_required");
      const params = { after: input.after, through: input.through };
      await confirmedOrder(input.stepUp, { action: "audit_exported", target: { type: "audit", id: String(params.through) }, params } as StaffStepUpActionInput, session);
      state.exports.push(params);
      const cut = state.exportCut;
      state.exportCut = null;
      return { status: 200, raw: { type: "application/x-ndjson", bytes: exportBody(params.after, params.through, cut) } };
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/audit/export/mark") {
      const input = parse(AuditMarkRequest, body, key);
      const released = state.exports.at(-1);
      const row = state.audit.find((found) => found.seq === input.through);
      if (released === undefined || released.through !== input.through || row?.hash !== input.hash) throw new Refusal(409, "copy_mismatch");
      state.copyPlace = input.through;
      state.marks.push(input);
      return { status: 204 };
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/restore") return { status: 200, body: state.restore };
    if (sealRelease) {
      // 3d Task 2: the release, as the API answers it: an admin's, under a key that confirmed exactly this seal, these
      // posts, the ground and the recorded leave with its reference as the case showed them; the case as it now stands.
      if (state.role !== "admin") throw new Refusal(403, "admin_required");
      const what = "POST /api/staff/seals/:action/release";
      const { stepUp, ...params } = parse(SealReleaseRequest, body, what);
      const actionId = sealRelease[1]!;
      await confirmedOrder(stepUp, { action: "seal_released", target: { type: "seal", id: actionId }, params } as StaffStepUpActionInput, session);
      const found = [...state.cases.entries()].find(([, view]) => view.decisions.some((decided) => decided.actions.some((one) => one.id === actionId)));
      if (found === undefined) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      const [caseId, view] = found;
      const sealing = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.actions.some((one) => one.id === actionId))!;
      const block = sealing.release;
      if (block === undefined || block.leave === null || block.leave.id !== params.leaveId || block.leave.reference !== params.theirReference || block.postIds.join(",") !== params.postIds.join(",")) {
        throw new Refusal(409, "release_mismatch");
      }
      const released = {
        ...block,
        postIds: [],
        remaining: 0,
        releasedAt: iso(Date.now()),
        basis: "leave" as const,
        backupsClearAt: iso(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * HOUR),
        noticeHeld: block.tellHeld,
        releasedPosts: block.releasedPosts + params.postIds.length,
        releasedImages: block.releasedImages + 2 * params.postIds.length,
      };
      const custody = sealing.custody === undefined ? undefined : { ...sealing.custody, files: 0, moved: 0, movedAt: null, filesLeft: sealing.custody.moved };
      const answered = { ...view, decisions: view.decisions.map((decided) => (decided.id === sealing.id ? { ...decided, release: released, ...(custody === undefined ? {} : { custody }) } : decided)) };
      state.cases.set(caseId, answered);
      state.releases.push({ actionId, params });
      return { status: 201, body: answered };
    }
    if (gapClose) {
      if (state.role !== "admin") throw new Refusal(403, "admin_required");
      const input = parse(GapCloseBody, body, "POST /api/staff/restore/gaps/:gap/close");
      const id = gapClose[1]!;
      await confirmedOrder(input.stepUp, { action: "gap_closed", target: { type: "restore_gap", id }, params: { disposition: "not_needed" } } as StaffStepUpActionInput, session);
      const gap = state.restore.gaps.find((found) => found.id === id && found.closedAt === null);
      if (gap === undefined) throw new Refusal(409, "gap_mismatch");
      state.restore = { ...state.restore, gaps: state.restore.gaps.map((found) => (found.id === id ? { ...found, closedAt: iso(Date.now()), disposition: "not_needed" } : found)) };
      state.gapsClosed.push(id);
      return { status: 201, body: state.restore };
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/signout") {
      state.sessions.delete(session.handle);
      return { status: 204, headers: { "set-cookie": CLEAR_COOKIES } };
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/step-up/options") {
      const action = parse(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, body, key);
      const known =
        action.action === "identity_revealed"
          ? [...state.cases.values()].some((view) => view.items.some((item) => item.id === action.target.id))
          : action.action === "case_decided"
            ? state.cases.has(action.target.id)
            : action.action === "appeals_reviewed"
              ? [...state.cases.values()].some((view) => view.decisions.some((decided) => decided.id === action.target.id))
              : action.action === "order_event_recorded" || action.action === "order_corrected" || action.action === "order_effected"
                ? state.orders.some((order) => order.id === action.target.id)
                : action.action === "audit_exported"
                  ? Number(action.target.id) <= Math.max(...state.audit.map((row) => row.seq))
                  : action.action === "gap_closed"
                    ? state.restore.gaps.some((gap) => gap.id === action.target.id)
                    : action.action === "seal_released"
                      ? [...state.cases.values()].some((view) => view.decisions.some((decided) => decided.actions.some((one) => one.id === action.target.id)))
                      : state.sessions.has(action.target.id);
      if (!known) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      // The page builds a reveal's or a decision's params from the digests it computed itself: one a save's answer carried never gets here.
      const decided = action.action === "case_decided" ? CaseDecidedParams.parse(action.params) : null;
      const underDigests = decided ? [decided.factsDigest, decided.reasonDigest, decided.legalReferenceDigest] : action.action === "identity_revealed" || action.action === "appeals_reviewed" ? [(action.params as { reasonDigest: string }).reasonDigest] : [];
      if (underDigests.some((digest) => typeof digest === "string" && state.forgedDigests.includes(digest))) problem(`${key}: an action under a digest the page did not compute`);
      state.stepUpOptionsServed += 1;
      // The mismatched case: an API that asks the key to confirm the revocation of this very session instead of the one
      // chosen; for a reveal, the reveal of another item than the one chosen; for a decision, the same decision on the
      // case's next version, which the page never saw.
      let bound: StaffStepUpActionInput = action;
      if (state.mismatchNextStepUp) {
        if (decided) bound = { action: "case_decided", target: action.target, params: { ...decided, stateVersion: decided.stateVersion + 1 } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
        else if (action.action === "order_effected") {
          // 3f, Task 3: the effect of the same order with one more of its items than the page ticked.
          const params = action.params as { items: { itemId: string; postId: string }[] };
          const order = state.orders.find((found) => found.id === action.target.id);
          const extra = order?.items.find((item) => item.postId !== null && !params.items.some((one) => one.itemId === item.id));
          const items = extra ? [...params.items, { itemId: extra.id, postId: extra.postId! }].sort((a, b) => (a.postId < b.postId ? -1 : a.postId > b.postId ? 1 : 0)) : params.items;
          bound = { ...action, params: { ...params, items } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
        } else if (action.action === "seal_released") {
          // 3d Task 2: the release of the same seal on the same leave, under another reference than the page showed.
          bound = { ...action, params: { ...(action.params as object), theirReference: "OTHER 9/99" } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
        } else bound = { ...action, target: { ...action.target, id: action.action === "identity_revealed" ? randomUUID() : session.handle } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
      }
      state.mismatchNextStepUp = false;
      const challenge = await stepUpChallenge(session.handle, bound);
      state.challenges.set(challenge, { purpose: "step_up", target: bound.target.id, hash: await stepUpActionHash(bound) });
      const allow = session.credentialId === null ? [] : [{ id: session.credentialId, type: "public-key", transports: ["usb"] }];
      return { status: 200, body: { options: { challenge, rpId: "localhost", timeout: 300_000, userVerification: "required", allowCredentials: allow } } };
    }

    // DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle, confirmed by the session's own key for exactly this session.
    const handle = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice("/api/staff/sessions/".length));
    const { stepUp } = parse(StaffSessionRevokeRequest, body, "DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle");
    const issued = clientData(stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
    if (issued.target !== handle || stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {
      problem(`DELETE ${handle}: an assertion for ${String(issued.target)} from ${stepUp.id}`);
      throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
    }
    const refusal = flagRefusal(flagsOf(Buffer.from(stepUp.response.authenticatorData, "base64url")));
    if (refusal) throw refuse(refusal === "staff_key_refused" ? "staff_step_up_invalid" : refusal);
    if (!state.sessions.delete(handle)) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    state.revoked.push(handle);
    return { status: 204 };
  }

  /** The staff gate: the console's Host, an Origin on every write and never another, and same-origin fetch metadata. */
  function gate(req: IncomingMessage) {
    if (req.headers.host !== new URL(state.origin).host) {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Host ${String(req.headers.host)}`);
      throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    }
    const site = req.headers["sec-fetch-site"];
    if (site !== undefined && site !== "same-origin") {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Sec-Fetch-Site ${site}`);
      throw new Refusal(403, "csrf_failed");
    }
    const origin = req.headers.origin;
    if ((origin !== undefined || (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD")) && origin !== state.origin) {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Origin ${String(origin)}`);
      throw new Refusal(403, "csrf_failed");
    }
  }

  /** Answers one request under /api/staff, as the API behind Caddy's console site would. */
  async function handle(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, url: URL, raw: Buffer): Promise<void> {
    let answer: Answer;
    try {
      if (state.off) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      gate(req);
      let body: unknown;
      if (raw.length > 0) {
        try {
          body = JSON.parse(raw.toString("utf8"));
        } catch {
          problem(`${req.method} ${url.pathname}: a body that is not JSON`);
          throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
        }
      }
      answer = await route(req, url, body);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof Refusal)) throw err;
      answer = { status: err.status, body: { error: { code: err.code, message: "the fixture's own words" } }, headers: err.headers };
    }
    state.requests.push({ method: req.method ?? "", path: `${url.pathname}${url.search}`, status: answer.status, activity: req.headers["x-staff-activity"] === "1" });
    const headers: Record<string, string | string[]> = { "cache-control": "no-store", ...answer.headers };
    if (answer.raw) {
      res.writeHead(answer.status, { ...headers, "content-type": answer.raw.type, "content-length": String(answer.raw.bytes.length) });
      res.end(answer.raw.bytes);
      return;
    }
    if (answer.body === undefined) {
      res.writeHead(answer.status, headers);
      res.end();
      return;
    }
    res.writeHead(answer.status, { ...headers, "content-type": "application/json" });
    res.end(JSON.stringify(answer.body));
  }

  return {
    state,
    handle,
    /** Every staff session ends behind the page's back, as a revocation from the command line ends them. */
    endEverySession() {
      state.sessions.clear();
    },
    /**
     * Another staff member decides the case behind the page: a withhold of the post taken while deciding, under rule R6,
     * on the case as it stands. The post is then withheld and the case's version moves on, so a decision the page built
     * on the version it read is answered case_changed.
     */
    decideBehindThePage(caseId: string): void {
      const found = state.cases.get(caseId);
      const [newest] = found?.snapshots ?? [];
      if (!found || !newest) throw new Error("the fixtures hold no such case, or it has no snapshot");
      const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse({
        kind: "interim",
        stateVersion: found.stateVersion,
        throughSeq: 0,
        reviewsDecisionId: null,
        snapshotId: newest.id,
        snapshotDigest: hex64(),
        outcome: "restricted",
        ground: "incompatible",
        ruleId: "R6",
        rulesVersion: 2,
        redressVersion: 1,
        category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R6,
        categoryKeyword: null,
        actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }],
        factsDigest: hex64(),
        reasonDigest: hex64(),
        legalReferenceDigest: null,
        // 3e: every decision's params carry the marks and the withdrawal; this one sets neither.
        unfounded: [],
        replaced: false,
      });
      applyDecision(found, params, { facts: "The post repeats one link in every reply.", reason: "That is spam, which rule R6 names.", legalReference: null }, OTHER_STAFF);
      if (found.target.type === "post") found.target = { ...found.target, state: "withheld", level: "withheld" };
    },
    /** A new enrolment link, as `staff.js enroll` prints one for the person's next key; its token. */
    issueEnrolment(): string {
      state.enrolmentToken = b64url(32);
      state.enrolmentUsed = false;
      return state.enrolmentToken;
    },
  };
}

/**
 * 3e: an account's case in lane 2 that holds one rule report under R4 about its handle, unanswered, with a snapshot
 * whose handle is the one the profile holds now unless told otherwise, and the account's standing. `live` is the handle
 * the profile holds now; `snapped` the one the newest snapshot copied.
 */
export function retireCase(live = "Ada_L", snapped = "Ada_L", standing: Partial<CaseStanding> = {}): CaseView {
  const base = accountCase();
  const [copied] = base.snapshots;
  if (!copied || copied.withheld) throw new Error("the account case's snapshot shows its content");
  return accountCase({
    id: CASE_RETIRE,
    lane: 2,
    stateVersion: 1,
    intakeSeq: 1,
    suspicion: null,
    target: { type: "account", id: ACCOUNT_ID, handle: live, displayName: "Ada", bio: "", deleted: false },
    snapshots: [{ ...copied, authorHandle: snapped, handle: snapped, displayName: "Ada", bio: "" }],
    items: [item({ id: ITEM_RETIRE, ruleId: "R4", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS", link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada_l" })],
    history: [],
    standing: { ...NO_ACCOUNT_STANDING, ...standing },
  });
}

  };
}

/**
 * The console's case screens (3c design, section 8), server-rendered, and their pure parts. Every string someone wrote
 * arrives hostile and must come out as escaped text inside a frame; every link is one of the console's own pages or a
 * case's address built from a checked id; no page holds a link into the app; and an image is in the page only once its
 * person asked for it.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const noop = () => undefined;
const caseId = (id: string) => parseCaseId(id)!;
const NOW = Date.parse("2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z");

/** No element or link came from a hostile string, and every link is the console's own. */
function expectInert(out: string) {
  expect(out).not.toMatch(/<(script|svg|iframe|style|object|embed|a [^>]*href="(?!\/))/i);
  expect(out).not.toMatch(/href="javascript:/i);
  expect(out).not.toMatch(/ on[a-z]+="/i);
  for (const href of hrefs(out)) expect(CONSOLE_PATHS.includes(href) || CASE_PATH.test(href), href).toBe(true);
}

/** The addresses of every image element in rendered HTML. */
const images = (out: string): string[] => [...out.matchAll(/<img[^>]*src="([^"]*)"/g)].map((found) => found[1]!);

describe("a case's address and its images' addresses", () => {

    // A value that never went through the checks is refused, whatever its type claims.
    expect(() => staffImageSrc(caseId(CASE_POST), "../../audit" as never, "small")).toThrow();
    expect(() => staffImageSrc("https://evil.test" as never, image, "small")).toThrow();
    expect(() => staffImageSrc(caseId(CASE_POST), image, "original" as never)).toThrow();

    expect(blurred).toContain('class="evidence blurred"');

    const clear = html(<StaffImage caseId={caseId(CASE_POST)} mediaId={parseImageId(IMAGE_ONE)!} size="large" clear onError={noop} />);

describe("the hidden-characters view", () => {
  const RLO = String.fromCharCode(0x202e);
  const ZWSP = String.fromCharCode(0x200b);
  const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
  const CYRILLIC_A = String.fromCharCode(0x430);

  test("draws every character outside printable ASCII as its code point, and keeps the lines", () => {
    expect(showHidden("plain text, 100%")).toBe("plain text, 100%");
    expect(showHidden(`${RLO}gnp.exe`)).toBe("[U+202E]gnp.exe");
    expect(showHidden(`p${CYRILLIC_A}ypal`)).toBe("p[U+0430]ypal");
    expect(showHidden(`a${ZWSP}b`)).toBe("a[U+200B]b");
    expect(showHidden(`one${LF}two`)).toBe(`one[U+000A]${LF}two`);
    expect(showHidden(String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600))).toBe("[U+1F600]");
    expect(hasHidden("plain")).toBe(false);
    expect(hasHidden(`p${CYRILLIC_A}ypal`)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("lists the hosts of the web addresses a text mentions, each once, as the host the address really names", () => {
    expect(mentionedHosts("see https://example.com/a?b#c and http://example.com/other, also www.other.test/x.")).toEqual(["example.com", "www.other.test"]);
    expect(mentionedHosts(LOOKALIKE.address)).toEqual(["korbat.example.evil.test", "evil.test"]);
    expect(mentionedHosts("HTTPS://Example.COM:8443/path")).toEqual(["example.com:8443"]);
    expect(mentionedHosts("no address here, not even javascript:alert(3)")).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("an address whose host the console cannot read is counted, never passed over: one followed by a direction override, and one that is no address at all", () => {
    // The override stands where the host ends, so it is part of what a browser would take for the host.
    const overridden = `https://korbat.example${RLO}/tsop`;
    expect(mentionedAddresses(`see ${overridden} and http://good.test/x, then http://good.test/y`)).toEqual({ hosts: ["good.test"], unread: 1 });
    expect(mentionedAddresses(`${overridden} http://[not-an-address`)).toEqual({ hosts: [], unread: 2 });
    expect(mentionedAddresses("https://example.com/a")).toEqual({ hosts: ["example.com"], unread: 0 });
    expect(mentionedAddresses("no address")).toEqual({ hosts: [], unread: 0 });
    // The list of hosts is what it was: the hosts that were read.
    expect(mentionedHosts(`see ${overridden} and http://good.test/x`)).toEqual(["good.test"]);
  });
});

    expect(out).toContain(">Open a case</button>");

    expect([...out.matchAll(/<option value="(STATEMENT_CATEGORY_[A-Z_]+)"/g)].map((found) => found[1])).toEqual([...FINDING_CATEGORIES]);
    // The form posts nowhere by itself: the page sends the finding.
    expect(out).not.toMatch(/<form[^>]*action=/);
    expect(findingOf({ link: " http://localhost:8081/post/7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36 ", ruleId: "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS" })).toEqual({
      target: { kind: "link", url: "http://localhost:8081/post/7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36" },
      ground: "rule",
      ruleId: "R2",
      category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",

    for (const link of ["", "not a link", "javascript:alert(1)", `http://x.test/${"a".repeat(300)}`]) expect(findingOf({ link, ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" }), link).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the queue is read page by page from its start; its own refresh carries no activity mark, its person's reads do", async () => {
    const first: QueuePage = { cases: QUEUE_ROWS.slice(0, 2), nextCursor: "page_2-cursor", replies: [] };
    const second: QueuePage = { cases: QUEUE_ROWS.slice(2), nextCursor: null, replies: [] };
    const fake = fakeFetch({ "GET /api/staff/queue": { status: 200, body: first }, "GET /api/staff/queue?cursor=page_2-cursor": { status: 200, body: second } });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    expect(await readQueue(api, 1, true)).toEqual({ rows: first.cases, next: "page_2-cursor", replies: [] });
    expect(await readQueue(api, 2, false)).toEqual({ rows: QUEUE_ROWS, next: null, replies: [] });
    expect(fake.requests.map((request) => `${request.url} ${request.headers["x-staff-activity"] ?? "unmarked"}`)).toEqual([
      "/api/staff/queue 1",
      "/api/staff/queue unmarked",
      "/api/staff/queue?cursor=page_2-cursor unmarked",
    ]);
  });

  test("the screen reads the queue when it opens, marked, and again every 60 seconds, unmarked, until it is left", async () => {
    const page: QueuePage = { cases: QUEUE_ROWS, nextCursor: null, replies: [] };
    const fake = fakeFetch({ "GET /api/staff/queue": { status: 200, body: page } });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    const clock = new FakeClock();
    const marks = () => fake.requests.map((request) => request.headers["x-staff-activity"] ?? "unmarked");
    const stop = startQueueReads(clock, (activity) => void readQueue(api, 1, activity));
    await settle();
    // Opening the screen is its person's action.
    expect(marks()).toEqual(["1"]);
    expect(QUEUE_REFRESH_MS).toBe(60_000);
    await clock.advance(QUEUE_REFRESH_MS - 1);
    expect(marks()).toEqual(["1"]);
    // The refresh is the page's own: it never moves the session's idle end.
    await clock.advance(1);
    expect(marks()).toEqual(["1", "unmarked"]);
    await clock.advance(3 * QUEUE_REFRESH_MS);
    expect(marks()).toEqual(["1", "unmarked", "unmarked", "unmarked", "unmarked"]);
    // Leaving the screen ends its reads.
    stop();
    expect(clock.pending).toBe(0);
    await clock.advance(5 * QUEUE_REFRESH_MS);
    expect(marks()).toHaveLength(5);
  });
});
