```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { and, eq, gt, inArray, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { stepUpActionHash } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { auditHead, auditLog, closeDb, createDb, staffKeys, users, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { AUDIT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE, auditVerify, checkAuditRecord, describeReport, runStaffCommand, type AuditReport } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { SoftAuthenticator } from "../auth/soft-authenticator";
import { CHAIN_VECTORS } from "../staff/chain-vectors";
import { automationDeps, signalForTest } from "./automation-fixtures";
import { flowHarness } from "./flow-harness";
import { aPost, imagePost, report as reportOn } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { enrolKey } from "./staff-enrolment";
import { TEST_CONSOLE, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, issueEnrolment, newStaffAccount, newStaffKey, rolledBack, withLockTimeout } from "./staff-fixtures";
import { revokeConfirmed, signedIn } from "./staff-step-up";

/**
 * audit-verify (3a design, sections 7 and 12) against the real database: the canonical text in Node against the trigger's
 * in SQL, the chain under concurrent writers, rewrites by the owner detected against kept places, and every staff key's
 * one staff_key_added row. Every test that writes a row audit-verify must refuse does it in a transaction that ends in a
 * rollback and hands that transaction to the verifier's check, so no later suite sees a broken chain.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: audit-verify", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  const actorId = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000";

  /** One ordinary row, as a writer on the API role inserts it: no id, time or chain column supplied. */
  const insertRow = (db: Db | DbTx, action = `probe-${randomUUID()}`) =>
    db.insert(auditLog).values({ actorId, action, targetType: "user", targetId: randomUUID(), metadata: { via: "test" } }).returning();

  const readHead = async (db: Db | DbTx = apiDb) => (await db.select().from(auditHead))[0]!;
  const hashAt = async (seq: number) => (await apiDb.select({ hash: auditLog.hash }).from(auditLog).where(eq(auditLog.chainSeq, seq)))[0]!.hash;

  /**
   * What the owner can do: chain every row from place `from` again with the database's own text function, as migration
   * 0012's back-fill does, and move the head, so a plain recompute of the chain passes over the changed rows.
   */
  const rechainFrom = (tx: DbTx, from: number) =>
    tx.execute(
      sql.raw(`DO $$
        DECLARE r public.audit_log; prev text;
        BEGIN
          SELECT hash INTO prev FROM public.audit_log WHERE chain_seq = ${from - 1};
          FOR r IN SELECT * FROM public.audit_log WHERE chain_seq >= ${from} ORDER BY chain_seq LOOP
            prev := encode(sha256(convert_to(prev || public.audit_chain_text(r), 'UTF8')), 'hex');
            UPDATE public.audit_log SET prev_hash = (SELECT hash FROM public.audit_log WHERE chain_seq = r.chain_seq - 1), hash = prev WHERE id = r.id;
          END LOOP;
          UPDATE public.audit_head SET hash = prev WHERE id = 1;
        END $$`),
    );

  /** The verifier's own connections, as the command line opens them: one on each role. */
  const ownConnections = () => ({ api: createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 1 }), auth: createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 1 }) });

  /**
   * What the command line printed, and its exit code, for a run with the given environment changes; with `inherit` false,
   * the run sees `env` alone and nothing of the test environment.
   */
  async function cli(args: string[], env: Record<string, string> = {}, inherit = true) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, inherit ? { ...process.env, ...env } : env, { log: (line) => lines.push(line), error: (line) => lines.push(line) });
    return { code, text: lines.join("\n") };
  }

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    // The migrate role is not part of the API configuration; the test environment carries it.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    // A few committed rows, so the log is never empty whatever order the suites run in.
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await withLockTimeout(apiDb, (tx) => insertRow(tx));
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  test("a whole chain passes, with the head, and every kept place it is given", async () => {
    const head = await readHead();
    const connections = ownConnections();
    try {
      const plain = await auditVerify(connections, []);
      expect(plain).toMatchObject({ ok: true, rows: head.seq, head: { seq: head.seq, hash: head.hash }, keptChecked: 0, unanchored: head.seq, problems: [], problemCount: 0 });
      const kept = await auditVerify(connections, [
        { seq: 1, hash: await hashAt(1) },
        { seq: head.seq - 1, hash: await hashAt(head.seq - 1) },
      ]);
      expect(kept).toMatchObject({ ok: true, keptChecked: 2, unanchored: 1, problems: [] });
    } finally {
      await Promise.all([closeDb(connections.api), closeDb(connections.auth)]);
    }
  });

  describe("parity: the canonical text in Node and in SQL", () => {
    test("the vectors' rows, written through the trigger from a session in another time zone and date style, recompute to their stored hashes", async () => {
      // One connection, so the session's settings hold for the transaction below.
      const odd = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 1 });
      try {
        await odd.execute(sql`set timezone = 'Asia/Kathmandu'`);
        await odd.execute(sql`set datestyle = 'SQL, DMY'`);
        // Rolled back: the step-up row carries an assertion no stored key made, which audit-verify's step-up checks refuse.
        await rolledBack(odd, async (tx) => {
          const [settings] = await tx.execute<{ tz: string; ds: string }>(sql`select current_setting('TimeZone') as tz, current_setting('DateStyle') as ds`);
          expect(settings).toEqual({ tz: "Asia/Kathmandu", ds: "SQL, DMY" });
          const before = await readHead(tx);
          const written: number[] = [];
          for (const vector of CHAIN_VECTORS) {
            const [row] = await tx.insert(auditLog).values(vector.insert).returning({ id: auditLog.id });
            written.push(row!.id);
          }
          // The stored jsonb prints as the vectors say, so the unit vectors hold chain.ts to what the database embeds.
          const texts = await tx
            .select({ id: auditLog.id, metadata: sql<string>`${auditLog.metadata}::text`, stepUp: sql<string | null>`${auditLog.stepUp}::text` })
            .from(auditLog)
            .where(inArray(auditLog.id, written))
            .orderBy(auditLog.chainSeq);
          expect(texts.map((t) => [t.metadata, t.stepUp])).toEqual(CHAIN_VECTORS.map((v) => [v.metadataText, v.stepUpText]));

          // The API role cannot read the staff keys: they come from the auth role's pool, as the command line reads them.
          // Every hash recomputes. Two rows are refused for what they are: the step-up vector, whose assertion no stored
          // key made, and which is the last vector; and the vector that records a decision on a case with no step-up at
          // all, an action that only a staff key's confirmation may leave in the record.
          const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, [], authDb);
          expect(CHAIN_VECTORS.at(-1)!.insert.stepUp).not.toBeNull();
          expect(CHAIN_VECTORS.filter((vector) => vector.insert.stepUp !== null)).toHaveLength(1);
          const unconfirmed = CHAIN_VECTORS.findIndex((vector) => vector.insert.action === "case_decided" && vector.insert.stepUp === null);
          expect(unconfirmed).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
          expect(report.problems).toEqual([
            { place: before.seq + unconfirmed + 1, message: "its action, case_decided, needs a step-up, and it carries none" },
            { place: before.seq + CHAIN_VECTORS.length, message: expect.stringMatching(/^its step-up/) },
          ]);
          expect(report.rows).toBe(before.seq + CHAIN_VECTORS.length);
        });
      } finally {
        await closeDb(odd);
      }
    });
  });

  describe("concurrency", () => {
    test("several sessions insert at once, some inside transactions, while keys are enrolled: every run passes, during and after", async () => {
      const WRITERS = 6;
      const EACH = 10;
      const config = loadConfig();
      // One connection per writer, each with a lock timeout for the whole session.
      const writers = Array.from({ length: WRITERS }, () => createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 1 }));
      const connections = ownConnections();
      const reports: AuditReport[] = [];
      let writing = true;
      try {
        await Promise.all(writers.map((db) => db.execute(sql`set lock_timeout = '10s'`)));
        const verifying = (async () => {
          while (writing) reports.push(await auditVerify(connections, []));
        })();
        await Promise.all([
          ...writers.map(async (db, w) => {
            for (let i = 0; i < EACH; i++) {
              const action = `concurrent-verify-${w}-${i}`;
              if (i % 2 === 0) {
                await insertRow(db, action);
              } else {
                // A transaction that waits a moment before its insert, which is its last statement, as every audit write's.
                await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
                  await tx.execute(sql`select pg_sleep(${Math.random() * 0.01})`);
                  await insertRow(tx, action);
                });
              }
            }
          }),
          // Keys enrolled meanwhile: a key whose staff_key_added row lies beyond the head a run read is left to the next run.
          (async () => {
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await newStaffKey(authDb, migrateDb, repo);
          })(),
        ]);
        writing = false;
        await verifying;
        const final = await auditVerify(connections, []);
        const head = await readHead();

        expect(reports.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        for (const report of reports) expect(report.problems).toEqual([]);
        expect(final).toMatchObject({ ok: true, rows: head.seq, head: { seq: head.seq, hash: head.hash }, keysLeftToNextRun: 0, problems: [] });
        expect(final.keysChecked).toBe(await migrateDb.$count(staffKeys));
      } finally {
        writing = false;
        await Promise.all([...writers.map((db) => closeDb(db)), closeDb(connections.api), closeDb(connections.auth)]);
      }
    });
  });

  describe("rewrites by the owner", () => {
    test("a row changed alone fails a plain run, naming its place", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [row] = await insertRow(tx, "rewrite-alone");
        await insertRow(tx, "rewrite-alone-after");
        await tx.update(auditLog).set({ metadata: { via: "edited" } }).where(eq(auditLog.id, row!.id));
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.ok).toBe(false);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual([{ place: row!.chainSeq, message: "its hash does not match its content" }]);
      });
      // Nothing of it outlives the rollback.
      const connections = ownConnections();
      try {
        expect((await auditVerify(connections, [])).ok).toBe(true);
      } finally {
        await Promise.all([closeDb(connections.api), closeDb(connections.auth)]);
      }
    });

    test("a row changed with every later hash and the head recomputed passes a plain run, and fails against a place kept before the change", async () => {
      const head = await readHead();
      const target = head.seq - 1;
      const keptBefore = { seq: target - 1, hash: await hashAt(target - 1) };
      const keptAfter = { seq: head.seq, hash: head.hash };
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.update(auditLog).set({ action: "rewritten" }).where(eq(auditLog.chainSeq, target));
        await rechainFrom(tx, target);
        expect((await readHead(tx)).hash).not.toBe(head.hash);

        const plain = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(plain.problems).toEqual([]);
        // A place kept before the changed row still holds; the one kept at or after it no longer does.
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [keptBefore])).problems).toEqual([]);
        const anchored = await checkAuditRecord(tx, [keptBefore, keptAfter]);
        expect(anchored.ok).toBe(false);
        expect(anchored.problems).toEqual([{ place: head.seq, message: expect.stringMatching(new RegExp(`^the kept place ${head.seq}:${head.hash} no longer matches`)) }]);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("rewrites by the owner that each check of the chain catches", () => {
    /** Three new rows, as a writer inserts them, in the transaction `tx`; the newest is the head. */
    const threeRows = async (tx: DbTx) => {
      const first = (await insertRow(tx, "probe-a"))[0]!;
      const middle = (await insertRow(tx, "probe-b"))[0]!;
      const last = (await insertRow(tx, "probe-c"))[0]!;
      return [first, middle, last] as const;
    };

    test("a row changed with only its own hash recomputed breaks its link to the next row, which a later kept place does not see", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [, middle, last] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditLog).set({ metadata: { via: "edited" } }).where(eq(auditLog.id, middle.id));
        // The owner recomputes the changed row's own hash over its stored prev_hash, with the database's own text.
        await tx.execute(sql`update public.audit_log a set hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(a.prev_hash || public.audit_chain_text(a), 'UTF8')), 'hex') where a.id = ${middle.id}`);
        const link = { place: last.chainSeq, message: `its prev_hash is not the hash of place ${middle.chainSeq}` };
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([link]);
        // The place kept after it still holds its hash: only the link check catches the change.
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [{ seq: last.chainSeq, hash: last.hash }])).problems).toEqual([link]);
      });
    });

    test("a row deleted from the middle leaves its place missing and the next row's link broken", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [first, middle, last] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.delete(auditLog).where(eq(auditLog.id, middle.id));
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([
          { place: middle.chainSeq, message: `place ${middle.chainSeq} is missing` },
          { place: last.chainSeq, message: `its prev_hash is not the hash of place ${first.chainSeq}` },
        ]);
      });
    });

    test("the newest rows deleted and the head moved back pass a plain run, and fail against a place kept before", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [first, , last] = await threeRows(tx);
        const kept = { seq: last.chainSeq, hash: last.hash };
        await tx.delete(auditLog).where(gt(auditLog.chainSeq, first.chainSeq));
        await tx.update(auditHead).set({ seq: first.chainSeq, hash: first.hash }).where(eq(auditHead.id, 1));
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([]);
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [kept])).problems).toEqual([{ place: kept.seq, message: `the kept place ${kept.seq}:${kept.hash} no longer matches: no row is at that place` }]);
      });
    });

    test("the head: missing, behind the newest row, beyond it, or with another hash", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.delete(auditHead);
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([{ place: null, message: "the audit head is missing" }]);
      });
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [first, middle] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditHead).set({ seq: first.chainSeq, hash: first.hash }).where(eq(auditHead.id, 1));
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([{ place: middle.chainSeq, message: `rows lie beyond the head's place ${first.chainSeq}, from place ${middle.chainSeq}` }]);
      });
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [, , last] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditHead).set({ seq: last.chainSeq + 5 }).where(eq(auditHead.id, 1));
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([{ place: null, message: `the head names place ${last.chainSeq + 5}, but the newest row up to it is at place ${last.chainSeq}` }]);
      });
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [, , last] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditHead).set({ hash: "e".repeat(64) }).where(eq(auditHead.id, 1));
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([{ place: last.chainSeq, message: "the head's hash is not the hash of the row at its place" }]);
      });
    });

    test("a row moved to place 0, or beyond the head, is named", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [, middle] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditLog).set({ chainSeq: 0 }).where(eq(auditLog.id, middle.id));
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: 0, message: "its place is not in the chain, which runs from place 1" });
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: middle.chainSeq, message: `place ${middle.chainSeq} is missing` });
      });
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [, middle, last] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditLog).set({ chainSeq: last.chainSeq + 10 }).where(eq(auditLog.id, middle.id));
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: last.chainSeq + 10, message: `rows lie beyond the head's place ${last.chainSeq}, from place ${last.chainSeq + 10}` });
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: middle.chainSeq, message: `place ${middle.chainSeq} is missing` });
      });
    });

    /**
     * What the owner can do to plant a row the walk by place never reaches: turn the trigger off and drop the unique index
     * on chain_seq (or its NOT NULL), then insert. The planted row is a step-up action's with no confirmation, which a walk
     * that read it would refuse; it repeats the genuine row's prev_hash and hash, so no other row or the head changes.
     */
    const plant = (tx: DbTx, place: number | null, copy: { prevHash: string; hash: string }) =>
      tx.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, chain_version, chain_seq, prev_hash, hash)
        values (${actorId}::uuid, 'staff_session_revoked', 'staff_session', ${randomUUID()}, '{"params": {}}'::jsonb, 1, ${place}::bigint, ${copy.prevHash}, ${copy.hash})`);

    test("a second row at a place that ends a page of the walk is read and refused", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        // Enough rows that a page of the walk ends at a place, with rows after it.
        const page = AUDIT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE;
        const short = page + 5 - (await readHead(tx)).seq;
        if (short > 0) {
          await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata)
            select ${actorId}::uuid, 'probe-page', 'user', gen_random_uuid()::text, '{"via": "test"}'::jsonb from generate_series(1, ${short})`);
        }
        const [genuine] = await tx.select().from(auditLog).where(eq(auditLog.chainSeq, page));
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.audit_log disable trigger audit_chain`);
        await tx.execute(sql`drop index public.audit_log_chain_seq_idx`);
        // A plain index in its place, as the owner might leave it: equal places come back oldest row first, so a walk by
        // place alone reads the genuine row and never the second.
        await tx.execute(sql`create index audit_log_chain_seq_plain on public.audit_log (chain_seq)`);
        await plant(tx, page, genuine!);
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.ok).toBe(false);
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: page, message: "another row is already at this place" });
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: page, message: "its action, staff_session_revoked, needs a step-up, and it carries none" });
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: null, message: "1 row is at a place another row already holds" });
      });
    });

    test("3f: a correction of an order's record under the rule entry or caution carries no step-up and is accepted; one under admin needs it", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const before = (await readHead(tx)).seq;
        for (const rule of ["entry", "caution", "admin"]) {
          await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata)
            values (${actorId}::uuid, 'order_corrected', 'order', ${randomUUID()}, ${JSON.stringify({ rule, changed: [] })}::jsonb)`);
        }
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems.filter((problem) => problem.place !== null && problem.place > before)).toEqual([
          { place: before + 3, message: "its action, order_corrected, needs a step-up, and it carries none" },
        ]);
      });
    });

    test("3d Task 6: a program's decision passes with the system's keyless automated_decided row, and its line is printed", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const step = await signalForTest(automationDeps(tx), p.mediaIds[0]!);
        expect(step.handled).toBe("measure");
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems.filter((problem) => problem.message.includes(step.decisionId!))).toEqual([]);
        expect(report.ok).toBe(true);
        expect(report.systemDecisions).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
        expect(describeReport(report)).toContain(`audit-verify: ${report.systemDecisions} ${report.systemDecisions === 1 ? "decision" : "decisions"} without a decider, each with its automated_decided row.`);
      });
    });

    test("3d Task 6: a decision without a decider fails without its row, and a row of the action with a key, or another row that names it, is a problem of its own", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const { caseId } = await reportOn(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        const [snapshot] = await tx.execute<{ id: string; digest: string }>(sql`select id, digest from public.evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid limit 1`);
        // The decision's row as the owner could write it, with the decision triggers off: no step and no audit row.
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.decisions disable trigger user`);
        const [made] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.decisions (case_id, kind, seen_state_version, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                        snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim,
                                        automated_detection, automated_decision)
          values (${caseId}::uuid, 'interim', 0, 'restricted', 'incompatible', 'R1', 3, 4, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'own_initiative',
                  ${snapshot!.id}::uuid, ${snapshot!.digest}, null, now(), '1'::xid8, md5(random()::text), now(), false, false, false, true, 'fully')
          returning id`);
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.decisions enable trigger user`);
        const id = made!.id;
        const missing = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(missing.ok).toBe(false);
        expect(missing.problems).toContainEqual({ place: null, message: `decision ${id} has no decider and no automated_decided row in the chain` });
        expect(describeReport(missing).join(" ")).not.toContain("without a decider, each with its automated_decided row");
        // A row of the action that carries a key is the system's no longer, and does not tie the decision.
        const before = (await readHead(tx)).seq;
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, key_id)
                             values (${actorId}::uuid, 'automated_decided', 'case', ${caseId}, ${JSON.stringify({ decisionId: id })}::jsonb, ${randomUUID()})`);
        // Another action that names the decision as its decisionId.
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata)
                             values (${actorId}::uuid, 'case_decided', 'case', ${caseId}, ${JSON.stringify({ decisionId: id })}::jsonb)`);
        const keyed = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(keyed.problems).toContainEqual({ place: before + 1, message: "its action, automated_decided, is the system's and carries no key, and it carries one" });
        expect(keyed.problems).toContainEqual({ place: null, message: `decision ${id} has no decider and no automated_decided row in the chain` });
        expect(keyed.problems).toContainEqual({ place: before + 2, message: `it names decision ${id}, which has no decider, as its decisionId, and is not its automated_decided row` });
      });
    });

    test("a row with no place at all is counted and refused", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const head = await readHead(tx);
        const [newest] = await tx.select().from(auditLog).where(eq(auditLog.chainSeq, head.seq));
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.audit_log disable trigger audit_chain`);
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.audit_log alter column chain_seq drop not null`);
        await plant(tx, null, newest!);
        const total = (await tx.select({ n: sql<string>`count(*)::text` }).from(auditLog))[0]!.n;
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.ok).toBe(false);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual([
          { place: null, message: "1 row of the audit log has no place in the chain" },
          { place: null, message: `the audit log holds ${total} rows, but ${head.seq} were read up to the head and 0 lie beyond it` },
        ]);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("step-up confirmations", () => {
    const harness = () => flowHarness(repo, { console: TEST_CONSOLE });

    /**
     * A staff account with a key enrolled through the flow and three sessions; from the first it revokes the other two,
     * each confirmed with the key through the step-up flow: two genuine step-up rows, committed, as only the flow writes them.
     */
    async function confirmedRevocations() {
      const h = harness();
      const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo);
      const soft = new SoftAuthenticator();
      const enrolled = await enrolKey(h, soft, (await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id)).token);
      const [a, b, c] = [await signedIn(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, 1), await signedIn(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, 2), await signedIn(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, 3)];
      expect((await revokeConfirmed(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, a.session, b.session.handle, 4)).revoked).toBe(true);
      expect((await revokeConfirmed(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, a.session, c.session.handle, 5)).revoked).toBe(true);
      const rowOf = async (handle: string) => (await apiDb.select().from(auditLog).where(and(eq(auditLog.action, "staff_session_revoked"), eq(auditLog.targetId, handle))))[0]!;
      return { user, keyId: enrolled.key.id, a: a.session, b: b.session, c: c.session, first: await rowOf(b.session.handle), second: await rowOf(c.session.handle) };
    }

    /** The problems a check found, as place and message, each expected to name the step-up check. */
    const stepUpProblems = (report: AuditReport) => report.problems.map((p) => ({ place: p.place, stepUp: /step-up/.test(p.message) }));

    test("genuine confirmations pass: on the command line's own connections, with the console off, and with nothing but the database URLs", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await confirmedRevocations();
      expect(s.first).toMatchObject({ staffSession: s.a.handle, keyId: s.keyId, actorId: s.user.id });
      expect(s.first.stepUp).not.toBeNull();
      const connections = ownConnections();
      try {
        const report = await auditVerify(connections, []);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual([]);
        expect(report.ok).toBe(true);
      } finally {

    test("a confirmed row changed by the owner with the chain and the head recomputed fails on its step-up alone: its params, its target, its session, its hash with its params, or its time past the challenge's expiry", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {

        let enrolled: string | undefined;
        const between = {

        expect(report).toMatchObject({ ok: true, keysLeftToNextRun: 1, problems: [] });

      } finally {

      }
    });

      });
    });
  });

      for (const env of envs) {

        expect(run.text).toContain(`the chain holds: ${head.seq} rows, from place 1 to the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash}`);
        expect(run.text).toContain("1 kept place checked; 0 rows after the newest kept place are not yet anchored");
      }
    });

    test("audit-verify and audit-head run given the database URLs alone: no secret, no other setting, and a console setting the API refuses changes nothing", async () => {
      const head = await readHead();
      const urls = { DATABASE_URL_API: process.env.DATABASE_URL_API!, DATABASE_URL_AUTH: process.env.DATABASE_URL_AUTH! };
      const envs: Record<string, string>[] = [
        urls,
        // A final slash, which the API's configuration refuses in CONSOLE_ORIGIN.
        { ...urls, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: "https://console.example/" },
        // The console on the app's origin, which it refuses too.
        { ...urls, APP_ORIGIN: process.env.APP_ORIGIN!, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: process.env.APP_ORIGIN! },
      ];
      for (const env of envs) {
        const run = await cli(["audit-verify", `${head.seq}:${head.hash}`], env, false);
        expect(run.code, JSON.stringify(Object.keys(env))).toBe(0);
        expect(run.text).toContain(`the chain holds: ${head.seq} rows, from place 1 to the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash}`);
      }
      const headRun = await cli(["audit-head"], { DATABASE_URL_API: urls.DATABASE_URL_API }, false);
      expect(headRun.code).toBe(0);
      expect(headRun.text).toMatch(new RegExp(`^${head.seq}:${head.hash} `));
    });

    test("audit-verify exits 1 and names the place at fault when a kept place does not match", async () => {
      const head = await readHead();
      const run = await cli(["audit-verify", `1:${await hashAt(1)}`, `${head.seq}:${"f".repeat(64)}`]);
      expect(run.code).toBe(1);
      expect(run.text).toContain("audit-verify: FAILED");
      expect(run.text).toContain(`place ${head.seq}: the kept place ${head.seq}:${"f".repeat(64)} no longer matches`);
    });

    test("audit-head prints the newest place, its hash and its time, and they are what audit_head holds", async () => {
      const head = await readHead();
      const [newest] = await apiDb.select().from(auditLog).where(eq(auditLog.chainSeq, head.seq));
      const run = await cli(["audit-head"], { CONSOLE_ORIGIN: "" });
      expect(run.code).toBe(0);
      expect(run.text).toBe(`${head.seq}:${head.hash} ${newest!.createdAt.toISOString()}`);
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
        const set = await setLimits(tx, wanted);

        expect(await row()).toEqual({ h: 30, d: 150, o: 200, f: 20, r: 5 });
        const written = await auditRows(tx, "moderation_limits_set", null);
        expect(written.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ actor_id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", target_type: null, metadata: wanted, step_up: null });
        const count = written.length;
        expect(await setLimits(tx, wanted)).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "the limits already are 30 decisions an hour, 150 decisions a day, 200 case opens a day, 20 findings a day, 5 reveals a day; nothing changed" });
        expect((await auditRows(tx, "moderation_limits_set", null)).length).toBe(count);
        // One number differs: the row changes and a second audit row is written.
        expect(await setLimits(tx, { ...wanted, revealsPerDay: 6 })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
        expect(await row()).toMatchObject({ r: 6 });
        expect((await auditRows(tx, "moderation_limits_set", null)).length).toBe(count + 1);
        // The row gone, as the integration setup's truncate would leave it: the command inserts it.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from moderation_limits`);
        expect(await setLimits(tx, wanted)).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
        expect(await row()).toEqual({ h: 30, d: 150, o: 200, f: 20, r: 5 });
      });
    });

    test("run with the numbers the row already holds, it exits 1 and says so", async () => {
      const run = await cli(["limits", "60", "300", "400", "50", "10"], migrateEnv());
      expect(run.code).toBe(1);
      expect(run.lines).toEqual(["err limits: the limits already are 60 decisions an hour, 300 decisions a day, 400 case opens a day, 50 findings a day, 10 reveals a day; nothing changed"]);
    });
  });

  describe("alert-test (3f's review)", () => {

  describe("text-verify", () => {
    /** The problems text-verify reports about any of these ids, or at any of these places of the audit log. */
    const about = (problems: TextProblem[], ids: readonly string[]) => problems.filter((p) => ids.includes(p.id)).map((p) => `${p.about}: ${p.message}`);
    const placesOf = async (tx: DbTx, decisionIds: readonly string[]) =>
      [...(await tx.execute<{ place: string }>(sql`select chain_seq::text as place from audit_log where metadata ->> 'decisionId' = any(${`{${decisionIds.join(",")}}`}::text[])`))].map((row) => row.place);

    test("it finds nothing wrong with decisions, texts, snapshots, levels, states and seals as the triggers left them, erased ones included", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const removed = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const first = await report(tx, aPost(removed.postId));
        const withheld = await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const sealed = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const suspect = await report(tx, anAccount(sealed.authorId), "csam");
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, mod, suspect.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        const cleared = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const third = await report(tx, aPost(cleared.postId));
        const noAction = await decideIn(tx, mod, third.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const decisions = [withheld, removal, seal, noAction];
        const [sealAction] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from decision_actions where decision_id = ${seal}::uuid`);
        const mine = [...decisions, ...(await placesOf(tx, decisions)), removed.postId, sealed.postId, cleared.postId, ...removed.mediaIds, ...sealed.mediaIds, ...cleared.mediaIds, sealAction!.id];

        const report1 = await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
        expect(about(report1.problems, mine)).toEqual([]);
        expect(report1.decisions).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
        expect(report1.seals).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
        expect(report1.images).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5);
        expect(report1.problemCount).toBe(report1.problems.length);
        expect(report1.ok).toBe(report1.problemCount === 0);

        // Retention at work is nothing to report: an erased snapshot and an erased text keep their rows and digests.
        await ageCase(tx, third.caseId, "3 days");
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${third.caseId}::uuid)`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update staff_texts set text = null, salt = null, erased_at = now() where case_id = ${first.caseId}::uuid and confirmed_at is not null`);
        expect(about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine)).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("3d Task 6: a program's decision is held to the system's automated_decided row, which names its snapshot and no text; a change to it is reported", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const step = await signalForTest(automationDeps(tx), p.mediaIds[0]!);
        expect(step.handled).toBe("measure");
        const decision = step.decisionId!;
        const [place] = await placesOf(tx, [decision]);
        const mine = [decision, place!, p.postId, ...p.mediaIds];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The decision's category rewritten as the migrator: what the system's row records is no longer what is stored.
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set category = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE' where id = ${decision}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: category`]);
      });
    });

    test("it reports a decision changed as the migrator, a measure removed, a text and a snapshot that are gone or altered, and a decision with no row or with a row and no decision", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "illegal");
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const [place] = await placesOf(tx, [removal]);
        const q = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const other = await report(tx, aPost(q.postId));
        const kept = await decideIn(tx, mod, other.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const [keptPlace] = await placesOf(tx, [kept]);
        const mine = [removal, kept, place!, keptPlace!, p.postId];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // The decision's rule and outcome rewritten: what the key confirmed is no longer what is stored.
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set category = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', through_seq = 0 where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: category, throughSeq`]);
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set category = ${SPEECH}, through_seq = 1 where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // Its measure taken out of the ledger: the decision no longer holds what its row lists, and the post's level no longer follows.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from decision_actions where decision_id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: actions`, "post: its level is stored as removed, and the ledger of measures gives visible"]);
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.moderation_apply(array[${p.postId}]::uuid[], true)`);
        // A text deleted, and a snapshot's content rewritten.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from staff_texts where digest = (select legal_reference_digest from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid)`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update evidence_snapshots set body = 'another body' where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([
          "audit: its legalReferenceDigest names no saved text",
          "audit: the snapshot it names no longer recomputes to its digest",
          `decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: actions`,
        ]);
        // The other decision deleted outright, with what hangs on it: its row in the record now names nothing korbat holds.
        await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set answered_by = null, outcome = null where answered_by = ${kept}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from staff_texts where decision_id = ${kept}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from decisions where id = ${kept}::uuid`);
        expect((await found()).filter((line) => line.includes(String(keptPlace)))).toEqual([`decision: the audit row at place ${keptPlace} names it, and korbat holds no such decision`]);
      });
    });

    test("3e Task 5: a decision that marked reports verifies with its marks, a mark taken out of the record or a row whose list was altered is reported, and a row signed before 3e reads its missing list as none", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const first = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        const second = await intake(tx, ground.rule((await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)).id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId));
        const items = [first.recorded.items[0]!.id, second.items[0]!.id].sort();
        const marked = await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: items });
        const q2 = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const other = await report(tx, aPost(q2.postId));
        const plain = await decideIn(tx, mod, other.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const [place, plainPlace] = [(await placesOf(tx, [marked]))[0]!, (await placesOf(tx, [plain]))[0]!];
        const mine = [marked, plain, place, plainPlace];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The params signed both marks; one taken out of the record as the migrator is a difference in `unfounded`.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from unfounded_marks where item_id = ${items[0]!}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
        // A row signed before 3e carries neither member: its missing list reads as no marks, its missing replaced as false.
        await tx.execute(sql`update audit_log set metadata = metadata #- '{params,unfounded}' #- '{params,replaced}' where chain_seq = ${plainPlace}::bigint`);
        expect((await found()).filter((line) => line.includes(String(plainPlace)))).toEqual([]);
        // And such a row beside a decision that holds a mark is reported: what was not signed is not what korbat holds.
        await tx.execute(sql`update audit_log set metadata = metadata #- '{params,unfounded}' where chain_seq = ${place}::bigint`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
      });
    });

    test("3e Task 7: a mark that korbat's own rules deleted is no difference: its report's day left the frame (the retention job's step) or its sender was forgotten (the account's purge); a mark deleted while korbat still knows its report and sender is", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const senders = [await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db), await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db), await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)];
        const reports = [];
        for (const sender of senders) reports.push(await intake(tx, ground.rule(sender.id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId)));
        const items = reports.map((recorded) => recorded.items[0]!.id);
        const marked = await decideIn(tx, mod, reports[0]!.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: items });
        const [place] = await placesOf(tx, [marked]);
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, [marked, place!]).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The first report's day leaves the frame: forget_report_counts deletes its mark, as the retention job does.
        await tx.execute(sql`update intakes set received_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays}::int) where id = ${reports[0]!.intakeId}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update unfounded_marks set reported_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays}::int) where item_id = ${items[0]!}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.forget_report_counts()`);
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select count(*)::int as n from unfounded_marks where decision_id = ${marked}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 2 });
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The second sender's account is deleted: its purge forgets who sent the report and deletes the mark with it.
        await authAccount(tx, senders[1]!.id, "0 seconds");
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.forget_reporter(${senders[1]!.id}::uuid)`);
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select count(*)::int as n from unfounded_marks where decision_id = ${marked}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The third mark taken out by hand, while its report is in the frame and its sender known: that is a difference.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from unfounded_marks where item_id = ${items[2]!}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
      });
    });

    test("3f Task 6: it reports a gap closed as not needed without its confirmed audit row; an item whose disabling a restore lost is no difference while its gap names it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [gap] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, acted_at, imported_at, class, closed_at, disposition)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 4, repeat('c', 64), 'case_decided', now(), now(), 'no_measure', now(), 'not_needed') returning id`);
        const [order] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_via)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 'tco_removal', 'DE', 'Bundeskriminalamt', ${`T-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true, 'cli') returning id`);
        const [item] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into legal_order_items (order_id, position, link, disabled_at, preserve_until) values (${order!.id}::uuid, 1, 'sha256:x', now(), now() + interval '6 months') returning id`);
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, [gap!.id, order!.id]).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([
          `gap: it is closed as not needed, and no confirmed audit row gap_closed names it`,
          `order: item ${item!.id}: it is recorded as disabled, and no measure of an order decision names it`,
        ]);
        await tx.execute(sql`
          insert into restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, acted_at, imported_at, class)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 5, repeat('d', 64), 'order_effected', 'order_item', ${item!.id}, now(), now(), 'order_effect')`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`gap: it is closed as not needed, and no confirmed audit row gap_closed names it`]);
      });
    });

    test("it reports a post whose level the migrator set by hand, an image whose state was set, and a seal in force one of whose listed posts has lost an image row", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const removed = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const first = await report(tx, aPost(removed.postId));
        await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const sealed = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const suspect = await report(tx, aPost(sealed.postId), "csam");
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        const [sealAction] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from decision_actions where decision_id = ${seal}::uuid`);
        const mine = [removed.postId, sealed.postId, ...removed.mediaIds, ...sealed.mediaIds, sealAction!.id];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // A removed post made visible again by hand, around the one writer of the level.
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set moderation_level = 'visible', state = 'visible' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["post: its level is stored as visible, and the ledger of measures gives removed"]);
        // The level put right and only the state left: the two must agree unless the author deleted the post.
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set moderation_level = 'removed' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["post: its state is stored as visible, and its level is removed"]);
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // A sealed image shown again by hand.
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`update post_media set moderation_state = 'visible' where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[0]!}'`));
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["image: its state is stored as visible, and the ledger of measures gives sealed"]);
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`update post_media set moderation_state = 'sealed' where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[0]!}'`));
        // A sealed image row destroyed, which only the owner of the database can do: the keep trigger switched off first.
        await tx.execute(sql.raw("alter table public.post_media disable trigger post_media_keep"));
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`delete from post_media where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[1]!}'`));
        await tx.execute(sql.raw("alter table public.post_media enable trigger post_media_keep"));
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`seal: it lists post ${sealed.postId} with 2 image rows, and the post has 1 now`]);
      });
    });

    test("the command itself reads on the API's role alone and exits 1 with what it found", async () => {
      // The shared database holds audit rows of decisions that earlier suites removed again, so the run is at fault or clean
      // by what they left; either way it reads, counts and answers, and the exit code follows its first line.
      const run = await cli(["text-verify"], { DATABASE_URL_API: process.env.DATABASE_URL_API! });
      expect(run.lines[0]).toMatch(/^(out text-verify: what the record names is what korbat holds: |err text-verify: FAILED, [0-9]+ problems? in )[0-9]+ confirmed rows, [0-9]+ decisions, [0-9]+ posts, [0-9]+ images and [0-9]+ seals in force/);
      expect(run.code).toBe(run.lines[0]!.startsWith("out ") ? 0 : 1);
    });
  });

  describe("access-request and an authority's demand (3f Task 5)", () => {
    test("a case whose notification record carries a running 'not to the person' is marked access.authorityHold in place of the lane-0 mark, with its day or an open end; one whose end passed is not; the handle's draft runs as the migrator", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const author = await one<{ handle: string }>(tx, sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
        // A seal opens the case's record; an authority then asks that the person is not told, with no end.
        const suspect = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
        await decideIn(tx, mod, suspect.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        const event = (caseId: string, until: string | null) =>
          tx.execute(sql`insert into public.authority_notification_events (notification_id, kind, at, how, not_to_person, not_to_person_until)
                         select n.id, 'request', now(), 'a letter', true, ${until}::timestamptz from public.authority_notifications n where n.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
        await event(suspect.caseId, null);
        // Two lane-0 cases with records the command line opened: one with an end ahead, one whose end passed.
        const second = await imagePost(tx, 0, p.authorId);
        const ahead = await report(tx, aPost(second.postId), "rule", "R5");
        const third = await imagePost(tx, 0, p.authorId);
        const passed = await report(tx, aPost(third.postId), "rule", "R5");
        for (const caseId of [ahead.caseId, passed.caseId]) {
          await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via) values ('owed', '{dsa18_1}', ${caseId}::uuid, ${p.authorId}::uuid, now(), 'cli')`);
        }
        await event(ahead.caseId, "2030-01-02T03:00:00Z");
        await event(passed.caseId, "2020-01-02T03:00:00Z");

        const drafted = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: author.handle }, noContactsHere, (ids) => authorityHoldsFor(tx, ids));
        const cases = new Map(((drafted as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft.cases as { id: string; authoritiesCheck: string | null; authorityHold: string | null }[]).map((c) => [c.id, c]));
        expect(cases.get(suspect.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: null, authorityHold: ACCESS_WORDS.authorityHold(null) });
        expect(cases.get(ahead.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: null, authorityHold: ACCESS_WORDS.authorityHold("2030-01-02") });
        expect(cases.get(passed.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: ACCESS_WORDS.authorities, authorityHold: null });
        expect(ACCESS_WORDS.authorityHold(null)).toBe(
          "An authority asked that this person is not told of its request (no end given yet). Do not send this case's part of the draft, and do not say that an authority is the reason, before counsel has read it.",
        );
        // Without the migrator's reader nothing is marked: the API's role reads no record.
        const plain = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: author.handle }, noContactsHere);
        expect(((plain as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft.cases as { authorityHold: string | null }[]).every((c) => c.authorityHold === null)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("a handle's draft runs in the migrate service: without the migrator's URL and APP_ORIGIN it is refused and drafts nothing", async () => {
      const lines: string[] = [];
      const code = await runStaffCommand(["access-request", "@someone"], { DATABASE_URL_API: loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API }, { log: (line) => lines.push(line), error: (line) => lines.push(line) });
      expect(code).toBe(1);
      expect(lines).toEqual(["access-request: a handle's draft runs in the migrate service, which holds DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE and APP_ORIGIN; nothing was drafted"]);
    });
    const noContactsHere = async () => [];
  });

  describe("access-request", () => {
    const noContacts = async () => [];

    test("for a handle: every case with its items' sources and grounds, its snapshots (an erased one without content, a sealed image by id and state), its decisions and appeals; the urgent cases marked; no reporter anywhere; one audit row of counts", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const author = await one<{ handle: string }>(tx, sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
        // Lane 2, closed without action, and its evidence erased: the snapshot is printed with its day and no content.
        const reporter = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const quiet = await intake(tx, ground.illegal(reporter.id), aPost(p.postId));
        const quietCase = quiet.items[0]!.caseId!;
        await decideIn(tx, mod, quietCase, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        await ageCase(tx, quietCase, "3 days");
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${quietCase}::uuid)`);
        // Lane 0, closed: a report under R5 that an admin answered with a removal, which the author appealed.
        const second = await imagePost(tx, 0, p.authorId);
        const threat = await report(tx, aPost(second.postId), "rule", "R5");
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, admin, threat.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] });
        await appealOf(tx, removal, p.authorId, "It was a joke.");
        // Lane 0, open: a report of child sexual abuse material about the account, its images sealed while deciding.
        const suspect = await report(tx, anAccount(p.authorId, author.handle), "csam");
        await decideIn(tx, mod, suspect.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        // A new look at the first post, in a case of its own: its snapshot lists the two images, now sealed.
        const third = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        // The account's own report about someone else.
        const elsewhere = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const own = await intake(tx, ground.illegal(p.authorId), aPost(elsewhere.postId));

        const drafted = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: `@${author.handle.toUpperCase()}` }, noContacts);
        expect(drafted.ok).toBe(true);
        const draft = (drafted as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft;
        const cases = draft.cases as { id: string; authoritiesCheck: string | null; closedAt: string | null; items: Record<string, unknown>[]; snapshots: { id: string; erasedOn: string | null; withheld: boolean; content: { body: string | null; media: Record<string, unknown>[] } | null }[]; decisions: Record<string, unknown>[]; appeals: Record<string, unknown>[] }[];
        const byId = new Map(cases.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
        expect([...byId.keys()].sort()).toEqual([quietCase, threat.caseId, suspect.caseId, third.caseId].sort());

        // The lane-2 case is not marked; the two urgent ones are, the closed one too.
        expect(byId.get(quietCase)!.authoritiesCheck).toBeNull();
        expect(byId.get(third.caseId)!.authoritiesCheck).toBeNull();
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: ACCESS_WORDS.authorities, closedAt: expect.any(String) });
        expect(byId.get(suspect.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: ACCESS_WORDS.authorities, closedAt: null });
        expect(ACCESS_WORDS.authorities).toBe("check the R2, Art. 18 and order records before sending: an authority may need the person not to be told yet, or national law may restrict access (GDPR Art. 23(1)(d))");

        // Sources as categories, with ground, rule and category.
        expect(byId.get(quietCase)!.items).toEqual([{ source: "a notice under Article 16", ground: "illegal content", rule: null, category: SPEECH, arrivedAt: expect.any(String) }]);
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)!.items).toMatchObject([{ source: "a report by another user", ground: "a korbat rule", rule: "R5" }]);
        expect(byId.get(suspect.caseId)!.items).toMatchObject([{ source: "a notice under Article 16", ground: "child sexual abuse material", rule: null }]);

        // The erased snapshot: its day, and no content.
        expect(byId.get(quietCase)!.snapshots).toEqual([{ id: expect.any(String), takenAt: expect.any(String), erasedOn: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), withheld: true, content: null }]);
        // A held snapshot with its content; each sealed image by id and state, and nothing more.
        const shown = byId.get(third.caseId)!.snapshots[0]!;
        expect(shown).toMatchObject({ erasedOn: null, withheld: false, content: { body: "a post" } });
        expect(shown.content!.media).toEqual(p.mediaIds.map((id) => ({ id, state: "sealed" })));
        // The decisions with their statement's data and texts, and the author's own appeal with its statement.
        // 3e: the removal under R5 gave the post its strike, which the draft lists among the decision's measures.
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)!.decisions).toMatchObject([{ id: removal, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", rule: "R5", measures: [{ kind: "remove", image: null, noEffect: null }, { kind: "strike", image: null, noEffect: null }], facts: expect.any(String), reason: expect.any(String), legalReference: null }]);
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)!.appeals).toMatchObject([{ decisionId: removal, statement: "It was a joke.", result: null }]);
        expect(byId.get(suspect.caseId)!.decisions).toMatchObject([{ kind: "interim", rule: "R2", measures: [{ kind: "seal_media" }] }]);

        // Under withheld: the identities, counted and never printed, and each text another person wrote, marked.
        expect(draft.withheld.identities).toEqual({ count: 3, reason: "rights of others: GDPR Art. 15(4), recital 63" });
        expect(draft.withheld.texts).toEqual([{ caseId: quietCase, kind: "explanation", text: "It breaks the law.", note: "send only after a person has weighed the writer's rights (C-203/22)" }]);
        const printed = JSON.stringify(draft);
        for (const hidden of [reporter.id, reporter.handle, quiet.intakeId]) expect(printed).not.toContain(hidden);
        // The account's own reports, as it sent them.
        expect(draft.ownReports).toMatchObject([{ ref: own.ref, ground: "illegal content", explanation: "It breaks the law.", items: [{ item: 1, link: `${ORIGIN}/post/${elsewhere.postId}`, shownOutcome: null, reexamination: false }] }]);
        // One audit row: the account, and counts.
        expect((await auditRows(tx, "access_request_drafted", p.authorId)).map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([{ actor_id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", target_type: "user", target_id: p.authorId, metadata: { cases: 4, contacts: 0 }, step_up: null }]);

        expect(await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: "nobody_has_this" }, noContacts)).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "no account has the handle @nobody_has_this" });
      });
    });

    test("an R4 removal made final leaves no R4 text in the draft: the snapshots are printed without content and the post's body is gone", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const author = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const secret = `a home address ${randomUUID()}`;
        const [post] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`insert into posts (author_id, body, created_at) values (${author.id}::uuid, ${secret}, now() - interval '30 days') returning id`);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(post!.id));
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const draftOf = async () => JSON.stringify(((await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: author.handle }, noContacts)) as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft);
        expect(await draftOf()).toContain(secret);
        await ageCase(tx, caseId, "7 months");
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${removal}::uuid) as done`)).toEqual({ done: true });
        const after = await draftOf();
        expect(after).not.toContain(secret);
        expect(after).toContain('"contentErasedOn":"');
      });
    });

    test("for an address: the contacts the auth module found, each with the name it gave and its notices; the audit row names nobody", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const named = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const contactId = randomUUID();
        const intakeId = await insertIntake(tx, { kind: "user", channel: "signed_out", contactId, allegesIllegal: true, category: SPEECH, explanation: "This post is unlawful.", citedLaw: "Section 5", bonaFide: true, lookupHash: hex64() });
        await insertItem(tx, { intakeId, caseId: await openCase(tx, "post", p.postId), targetId: p.postId, lane: 1 });
        await insertItem(tx, { intakeId, caseId: await openCase(tx, "account", named.id), targetType: "account", targetId: named.id, position: 2, lane: 1, namedHandle: "as_named" });
        const [notice] = await tx.execute<{ ref: string }>(sql`select ref from intakes where id = ${intakeId}::uuid`);
        const asked: string[] = [];
        const drafted = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { email: "notifier@korbat.local" }, async (email) => {
          asked.push(email);
          return [{ id: contactId, name: "Ann Notifier" }, { id: randomUUID(), name: null }];
        });
        expect(asked).toEqual(["notifier@korbat.local"]);
        const draft = (drafted as { draft: ContactsAccessDraft }).draft;
        expect(draft.contacts).toMatchObject([
          {
            name: "Ann Notifier",
            notices: [
              {
                ref: notice!.ref,
                ground: "illegal content",
                category: SPEECH,
                explanation: "This post is unlawful.",
                citedLaw: "Section 5",
                items: [
                  { item: 1, link: `${ORIGIN}/post/${p.postId}`, shownOutcome: null, reexamination: false },
                  // An account under the handle the notice named, never the one the profile holds.
                  { item: 2, link: `${ORIGIN}/u/as_named`, shownOutcome: null, reexamination: false },
                ],
              },
            ],
          },
          { name: null, notices: [] },
        ]);
        expect(JSON.stringify(draft)).not.toContain(named.handle);
        expect((await auditRows(tx, "access_request_drafted", null)).at(-1)).toMatchObject({ target_type: null, target_id: null, metadata: { cases: 0, contacts: 2 }, step_up: null });
      });
    });

    test("the id before an id: one row is read by its id through a page of one", () => {
      expect(uuidBefore("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001")).toBe("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000");
      expect(uuidBefore("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")).toBeNull();
      expect(uuidBefore("3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b00")).toBe("3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3aff");
      expect(uuidBefore("3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-000000000000")).toBe("3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b29-ffffffffffff");
      expect(() => uuidBefore("3F1C2B1E-8D4A-4C1E-9B2A-6F0E5D4C3B00")).toThrow(TypeError);

  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the moderation tables and the staff links hold what they held before it", async () => {
    const after = await rowCounts(apiDb);

});
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { uuids } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/**
 * 3d Task 1: fixtures of the quarantine's record (3d design, sections 6.1 and 12). quarantine_files is the migrator's
 * alone: the API's role holds no right on it, so every read, write and count here is made as the migrator.
 */

/** One file's row of the quarantine, as the migrator reads it, times as text. */
export interface QuarantineRow {
  media_id: string;
  file: string;
  post_id: string | null;
  size: number | null;
  sha256: string | null;
  moved_at: string;
  returned_at: string | null;
  destroyed_at: string | null;
  lost_at: string | null;
  lost_told: string | null;
  imported_at: string | null;
  unknown: boolean;
}

/** The rows of these images, by image and file. */
export async function quarantineRows(q: Db | DbTx, mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<QuarantineRow[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<QuarantineRow & Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    select media_id, file, post_id, size::int as size, sha256, moved_at::text, returned_at::text, destroyed_at::text, lost_at::text,
           lost_told::text, imported_at::text, unknown
      from public.quarantine_files where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)}) order by media_id, file`);
  return found.map((row) => ({ ...row }));
}

/** How many rows the table holds, as the migrator (the API role cannot count them). */
export async function quarantineCount(q: Db | DbTx): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.quarantine_files`);
  return row!.n;
}

/** The plan as the migrator reads it, for these images only, as "<direction> <image id>" strings, sorted. */
export async function planOf(q: Db | DbTx, mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ direction: string; media_id: string }>(sql`select p.direction, p.media_id from public.quarantine_plan() p where p.media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  return found.map((row) => `${row.direction} ${row.media_id}`).sort();
}

/**
 * What ageCustodyForTest moves back: a decision (when a move in became due) with its ledger rows; an image's quarantine
 * rows; an alert kind's rows; (3d Task 6) a signal, by its id, or the request for a person about a decision, by the
 * decision's id.
 */
export type CustodyAgeTarget =
  | { decision: string }
  | { media: string }
  | { alerts: "quarantine_due" | "quarantine_lost" | "automated_waiting" | "automated_objection" | "automation_capped" }
  | { signal: string }
  | { objection: string };

/**
 * The fixture of 3d's section 12, `ageCustodyForTest(target, interval)` (Task 1; Tasks 2, 6 and 7 grow it): as the
 * migrator, moves the times of the rows a day's alert or a due move is judged by back by the interval. It is the only way
 * a test meets a day's alert: every time is forced when it is first written, and no setting shortens a number. For a
 * decision: its decided_at, and the created_at of its ledger rows and of every ledger row that reversed one of them (when
 * a return became due). For an image: every time its quarantine rows hold. For an alert kind: when each of its outbox
 * rows was created. 3d Task 6: for a signal, when it was written and when it was handled, so the sweep's window and its
 * minute are met; for a request for a person, when it was sent, so its target and the limit on waiting are met. Run it
 * inside a transaction that ends in a rollback, or undo it.
 */
export async function ageCustodyForTest(q: Db | DbTx, target: CustodyAgeTarget, interval: string): Promise<void> {
  if ("decision" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.decisions set decided_at = decided_at - ${interval}::interval where id = ${target.decision}::uuid`);
    await q.execute(sql`
      update public.decision_actions set created_at = created_at - ${interval}::interval
       where decision_id = ${target.decision}::uuid
          or reverses_action_id in (select a.id from public.decision_actions a where a.decision_id = ${target.decision}::uuid)`);
  } else if ("media" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`
      update public.quarantine_files
         set moved_at = moved_at - ${interval}::interval, returned_at = returned_at - ${interval}::interval,
             destroyed_at = destroyed_at - ${interval}::interval, lost_at = lost_at - ${interval}::interval
       where media_id = ${target.media}::uuid`);
  } else if ("signal" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.automated_signals set created_at = created_at - ${interval}::interval, handled_at = handled_at - ${interval}::interval where id = ${target.signal}::uuid`);
  } else if ("objection" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.automated_objections set created_at = created_at - ${interval}::interval where decision_id = ${target.objection}::uuid`);
  } else {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - ${interval}::interval where kind = ${target.alerts}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Removes, as the migrator, the quarantine's rows of these images and, given the time the test began, the staff alerts
 * raised since then that name no message and no order: those its seals, lifted seals and records raised
 * (moderation_urgent, moderation_csam_lifted, quarantine_lost). Files of this kind run one at a time.
 */
export async function removeCustody(migrateDb: Db | DbTx, mediaIds: readonly string[], alertsSince?: string): Promise<void> {
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.quarantine_files where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  if (alertsSince !== undefined) {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where message_id is null and order_id is null and created_at >= ${alertsSince}::timestamptz`);
  }
}
```

```ts
    expect(await failure(upload(h.deps, ada.id, { ...h.jpeg(), contentLength: String(MEDIA_MAX_BYTES + 1) }))).toMatchObject({ code: "file_too_large", status: 413 });
    const mib = new Uint8Array(1024 * 1024);
    const chunks = [BYTES.jpeg, ...Array.from({ length: 20 }, () => mib)];
    expect(await failure(upload(h.deps, ada.id, { ...h.jpeg(), contentLength: "1000", body: bodyOf(...chunks) }))).toMatchObject({ code: "file_too_large", status: 413 });
    expect(readdirSync(h.files.uploads.tmp)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("an account holds at most 20 uploads that are not on a post", async () => {
    const ada = await h.established();
    const ids: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) ids.push((await upload(h.deps, ada.id, h.jpeg())).id);
    expect(await failure(upload(h.deps, ada.id, h.jpeg()))).toMatchObject({ code: "too_many_pending_uploads", status: 409 });
    h.worker.failed(ids[0]!, "corrupt_image");
    await status(h.deps, ada.id, ids[0]!);
    expect((await upload(h.deps, ada.id, h.jpeg())).status).toBe("processing");
  });

  test("an account in its first day may upload 20 images an hour, and removing them gives nothing back", async () => {
    const newcomer = await h.fresh();
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) await remove(h.deps, newcomer.id, (await upload(h.deps, newcomer.id, h.jpeg())).id);
    const refused = await failure(upload(h.deps, newcomer.id, h.jpeg()));
    expect(refused).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited", status: 429 });
  });

  test("uploads stop while the disk is nearly full", async () => {
    const full = await mediaHarness(db, { minFreeBytes: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER });
    const ada = await full.established();
    expect(await failure(upload(full.deps, ada.id, full.jpeg()))).toMatchObject({ code: "uploads_unavailable", status: 503 });
    full.cleanup();
  });

  test("an account without a profile cannot upload", async () => {
    expect(await rejection(upload(h.deps, h.newId(), h.jpeg()))).toBe("not_found");
  });

  test("3e: while the account's suspension runs, an upload is refused account_suspended (403) by the statement that writes its row: no row is left and the received file is discarded", async () => {
    const ada = await h.established();
    await suspendRowForTest(migrateDb, ada.id);
    const before = await h.deps.repo.pendingCount(ada.id);
    const uploads = readdirSync(h.files.uploads.incoming).length;
    expect(await failure(upload(h.deps, ada.id, h.jpeg()))).toMatchObject({ code: "account_suspended", status: 403 });
    expect(await h.deps.repo.pendingCount(ada.id)).toBe(before);
    expect(readdirSync(h.files.uploads.tmp)).toEqual([]);
    expect(readdirSync(h.files.uploads.incoming).length).toBe(uploads);
    await liftRowForTest(migrateDb, ada.id);
    expect((await upload(h.deps, ada.id, h.jpeg())).status).toBe("processing");
  });

  test("removing an upload deletes its row and file and asks the worker to delete what it made", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = await Promise.all([h.established(), h.established()]);
    const sent = await upload(h.deps, ada.id, h.jpeg());
    h.worker.ready(sent.id);
    expect(await rejection(remove(h.deps, bob.id, sent.id))).toBe("not_found");
    await remove(h.deps, ada.id, sent.id);
    expect(await h.deps.repo.find(sent.id)).toBeNull();
    expect(existsSync(h.files.uploads.upload(sent.id))).toBe(false);
    expect(await h.files.deletionRequests()).toContain(sent.id);
    expect(await rejection(remove(h.deps, ada.id, sent.id))).toBe("not_found");
  });

  test("an image that is on a post cannot be removed on its own", async () => {
    const ada = await h.established();
    const sent = await upload(h.deps, ada.id, h.jpeg());
    h.worker.ready(sent.id);
    await status(h.deps, ada.id, sent.id);
    const postId = await newPost(createSocialRepo(db), ada.id, h.clock.next(), "with an image");
    await db.update(postMedia).set({ postId, position: 0, altText: "a test image" }).where(eq(postMedia.id, sent.id));
    expect(await rejection(remove(h.deps, ada.id, sent.id))).toBe("not_found");
    expect((await h.deps.repo.find(sent.id))?.postId).toBe(postId);
  });
});
```

```ts
const SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING: DecisionInput = { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] };
const SEAL_FOR_GOOD: DecisionInput = { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] };

/**
 * Every method of the media repository, in one record (3c design, section 12). A method that deletes image rows is run
 * against a frozen post below; a method that gives an image, or what an image is, to someone is run against sealed
 * images; and a method that does neither says why. The record is typed over the repository's methods and compared with
 * them at run time, so a method added to createMediaRepo fails this file until whoever adds it has said which it is,
 * and a new deleter or reader fails it until it has a run of its own.
 */
type Role = { is: "deleter" } | { is: "reader" } | { is: "neither"; why: string };
const METHODS: Record<keyof MediaRepo, Role> = {
  accountCreatedAt: { is: "neither", why: "reads when an account was onboarded, and no image row" },
  pendingCount: { is: "neither", why: "counts an account's uploads that are on no post" },
  insertProcessing: { is: "neither", why: "inserts an upload on no post" },
  find: { is: "reader" },
  finalize: { is: "neither", why: "records the worker's verdict on an upload that is still processing" },
  deleteUnattached: { is: "deleter" },
  fileAccess: { is: "reader" },
  attach: { is: "neither", why: "puts its author's own upload on a new post" },
  detachAll: { is: "deleter" },
  purgeOwner: { is: "deleter" },
  forPosts: { is: "reader" },
  readyImages: { is: "reader" },
```
