```ts
  for (const kind of ["tco_removal", "dsa_art9"] as const) {
    for (const verified of [false, true]) {
      for (const held of [false, true]) {
        for (const texts of [null, TEXTS]) {
          const order = facts({ kind, verified, held, informedAt: held ? "2026-11-16T00:10:00.000Z" : DISABLED, withholdAuthor: kind === "tco_removal" || held, preserveUntil: kind === "tco_removal" ? facts().preserveUntil : null, preserveFirstUntil: kind === "tco_removal" ? facts().preserveFirstUntil : null, crossBorder: kind === "tco_removal" });
          cases.push({ name: `${kind} verified=${verified} held=${held} texts=${texts !== null}`, input: notice(order), texts });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  cases.push({ name: "held by korbat's mistake", input: notice(facts({ held: true, informedAt: "2026-10-05T00:00:00.000Z", holdEndReason: "not_ordered" })), texts: null });
  cases.push({ name: "erased", input: notice(facts()), texts: TEXTS, erasedOn: "2027-04-05" });
  for (const ground of ORDER_GROUNDS) cases.push({ name: `reinstated: ${ground}`, input: reinstatement(ground), texts: null });

  test("no notice says that korbat found anything, cites a rule, prints an address or a handle, or offers korbat's appeal", () => {
    const v2 = Object.values(REDRESS_TEXTS[2]) as string[];
    for (const c of cases) {
      const all = statementParagraphs(c.input, { texts: c.texts, erasedOn: c.erasedOn ?? null }).join(NL);
      expect(all, c.name).not.toMatch(/korbat found|It breaks|illegal content in your post|shows them to nobody(?! but)/);
      expect(all, c.name).not.toMatch(/@/);
      expect(all, c.name).not.toMatch(/(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])R[1-6]([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)/m);
      expect(all, c.name).not.toMatch(/You can appeal|choose "Appeal"|appeal to korbat/);
      for (const sentence of v2) expect(all, c.name).not.toContain(sentence);
      // The authority's own words are the screen's, in their block; no paragraph holds them.
      expect(all, c.name).not.toContain(TEXTS.reasons);
    }
  });

  test("an unverified notice says which authority the order names, never that korbat confirmed it", () => {
    const unverified = statementParagraphs(notice(facts())).join(NL);
    expect(unverified).toContain("It names OCLCTIC, France, as the authority that issued it, under the reference TCO-2026-17, and reached korbat on 2026-10-04.");
    expect(unverified).not.toContain(N.lead.confirmed);
    const verified = statementParagraphs(notice(facts({ verified: true, orderedFrom: "issued", orderedOn: "2026-10-03" }))).join(NL);
    expect(verified).toContain(`, and is dated 2026-10-03. ${N.lead.confirmed}`);
  });

  test("only a removal order's notice says that the law obliges korbat; a DSA order's says the law it was issued under requires it", () => {
    const tco = statementParagraphs(notice(facts())).join(NL);
    const dsa = statementParagraphs(notice(facts({ kind: "dsa_art9", preserveUntil: null, crossBorder: false }))).join(NL);
    expect(tco).toContain("the law obliges korbat to carry out such an order");
    expect(dsa).not.toMatch(/obliges|leaves korbat no choice/);
    expect(dsa).toContain(N.everywhere.dsa_art9);
    expect(dsa).not.toContain("Article 6 of the Regulation");
  });

  test("the paragraphs in the table's order, for a held removal order from another state whose texts came later", () => {
    const informed = "2026-11-16T00:10:00.000Z";
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(notice(facts({ held: true, informedAt: informed })), { texts: { ...TEXTS, textsAt: "2026-11-20T08:00:00.000Z", reasonsAt: "2026-11-20T08:00:00.000Z" } });
    expect(paragraphs).toEqual([
      N.done.disabled(POST_TIME, `/post/${POST.id}`, "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC"),
      N.lead.tco_removal("OCLCTIC", "France", "TCO-2026-17", ", and reached korbat on 2026-10-04"),
      N.notAssessed.tco_removal,
      N.heldUntilNow.tco_removal("2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", "2026-11-16 00:10 UTC"),
      N.textsSince("2026-11-20 08:00 UTC"),
      N.copy,
      `${N.scrutiny("Germany")} ${N.reasonsAt("2026-11-20 08:00 UTC")}`,
      N.preserved("2027-04-05 09:30 UTC"),
      N.everywhere.tco_removal,
      N.noAppeal.tco_removal,
      N.wrongItem,
    ]);
  });

  test("a hold ended as korbat's mistake says so in place of the hold's paragraph; texts recorded before the telling print no since line", () => {
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(notice(facts({ held: true, informedAt: "2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z", holdEndReason: "not_ordered" })), { texts: TEXTS });
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(N.heldUntilNow.notOrdered("2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", "2026-10-06 10:00 UTC"));
    expect(paragraphs).not.toContain(N.heldUntilNow.tco_removal("2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", "2026-10-06 10:00 UTC"));
    expect(paragraphs.join(NL)).not.toContain("korbat added the authority's words");
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(`${N.scrutiny("Germany")} ${N.reasonsAt("2026-10-06 10:00 UTC")}`);
  });

  test("3f's review: the reasons recorded after the telling and the remedies later still: the since line prints the remedies' time, the scrutiny sentence the reasons' own", () => {
    const told = "2026-10-04T09:30:00.000Z";
    const texts = { ...TEXTS, reasonsAt: "2026-10-05T11:00:00.000Z", textsAt: "2026-10-06T15:30:00.000Z" };
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(notice(facts({ informedAt: told })), { texts });
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(N.textsSince("2026-10-06 15:30 UTC"));
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(`${N.scrutiny("Germany")} ${N.reasonsAt("2026-10-05 11:00 UTC")}`);
  });

  test("without texts the notice says that they follow; a measure that changed nothing says so; the erasure replaces the preservation", () => {
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(notice(facts(), { measures: [measure("disable_by_order", { noEffect: "already" })] }));
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(N.textsFollow);
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(W.already("post"));
    expect(paragraphs.join(NL)).toContain(N.noReasonsYet);
    const erased = statementParagraphs(notice(facts()), { erasedOn: "2027-04-05" });
    expect(erased).toContain(N.erased("2027-04-05"));
    expect(erased.join(NL)).not.toContain("korbat keeps the post");
  });

  test("a reinstatement renders its lead, its ground's fixed sentence, what is shown now and the lift, on each ground", () => {
    for (const ground of ORDER_GROUNDS) {
      expect(statementParagraphs(reinstatement(ground)), ground).toEqual([
        N.reinstated.lead("2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", POST_TIME, `/post/${POST.id}`),
        ORDER_DRAFTS.reinstate[ground],
        N.reinstated.now,
        N.lifted,
      ]);
    }
    expect(statementParagraphs(reinstatement("withdrawn"), { erasedOn: "2027-04-05" })).toContain(N.reinstated.erased("2027-04-05"));
  });

  // Task 4 (design, sections 6.4 and 6.8): erase_order_records deletes an order's row, items and events three years after
  // its last event; its decisions stay in the ledger with no order's facts left to read.
  const goneOrder = () => statement({ kind: "order", outcome: "restricted", ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: null, facts: null, reason: null, source: "order", redressVersion: 3, measures: [measure("disable_by_order")], order: null });
  const goneReinstatement = () => ({ ...reinstatement("withdrawn"), order: null });
  const minute = (at: string) => `${at.slice(0, 10)} ${at.slice(11, 16)} UTC`;

  test("Task 4: once the order's records are deleted, its notice says only that an order was given effect, and when, and its reinstatement that it was lifted", () => {
    const order = goneOrder();
    expect(statementParagraphs(order)).toEqual([N.recordsDeleted.done(POST_TIME, `/post/${POST.id}`, minute(order.decidedAt)), N.recordsDeleted.gone]);
    expect(statementParagraphs(goneReinstatement())).toEqual([N.reinstated.lead("2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", POST_TIME, `/post/${POST.id}`), N.recordsDeleted.gone, N.lifted]);
    expect(N.recordsDeleted.gone).toContain(`${ORDER_RULES.recordKeepYears} years after an order's last event`);
    // Nothing of the order is left to name, and nothing a notice must never say is said.
    for (const paragraphs of [statementParagraphs(goneOrder()), statementParagraphs(goneReinstatement())]) {
      const all = paragraphs.join(NL);
      expect(all).not.toMatch(/korbat found|It breaks|@|You can appeal|OCLCTIC|TCO-2026-17/);
    }
  });

  test("Task 6: a disabling taken again after a restore says so after `everywhere`, with the lost day, and that the six months count from the first time", () => {
    const again = notice(facts(), { reapplied: { lostOn: "2026-10-02" } });
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(again, { texts: TEXTS });
    const everywhere = paragraphs.indexOf(N.everywhere.tco_removal);
    expect(paragraphs[everywhere + 1]).toBe(N.reapplied("2026-10-02"));
    expect(N.reapplied("2026-10-02")).toBe(
      "The post was first disabled on 2026-10-02. korbat lost its record of that when it had to restore its database from a backup, and disabled the post again with this decision; the six months above count from the first time.",
    );
    // A notice of a disabling that was not lost says nothing of a restore.
    expect(statementParagraphs(notice(facts()), { texts: TEXTS }).join(NL)).not.toMatch(/restore/);
  });

  test("3f's review (people6): an extended preservation prints the first end as six months from the disabling and the extended one as longer; an erasure says that the preservation ended", () => {
    const extended = statementParagraphs(notice(facts({ preserveExtended: true, preserveFirstUntil: "2027-04-05T09:30:15.250Z", preserveUntil: "2027-10-05T09:30:00.000Z" })), { texts: TEXTS });
    const at = extended.indexOf(N.preserved("2027-04-05 09:30 UTC"));
    expect(at).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(extended[at + 1]).toBe(N.preservedLonger("2027-10-05 09:30 UTC"));
    expect(extended.join(NL)).not.toContain("until 2027-10-05 09:30 UTC, six months from the disabling");
    // Not extended: the one end, as before.
    const plain = statementParagraphs(notice(facts()), { texts: TEXTS });
    expect(plain).toContain(N.preserved("2027-04-05 09:30 UTC"));
    expect(plain.join(NL)).not.toContain("keep them longer");
    // An erasure after an extension, or one a freeze delayed, ends a preservation that was not six months.
    expect(N.erased("2027-10-05")).toBe("The preservation ended on 2027-10-05. korbat erased the post's text, its images and its copies of them. The post cannot be reinstated.");
    expect(N.reinstated.erased("2027-10-05")).toBe("korbat had already erased the post's content when its preservation ended on 2027-10-05, so nothing can be shown again.");
    expect([N.erased("x"), N.reinstated.erased("x")].join(NL)).not.toContain("six months");
  });

  test("3f's review (people7): a disabling taken again whose notice shows no preservation (a DSA order, or one already erased) names no six months above", () => {
    const dsa = statementParagraphs(notice(facts({ kind: "dsa_art9", preserveUntil: null, preserveFirstUntil: null, crossBorder: false }), { reapplied: { lostOn: "2026-10-02" } }), { texts: TEXTS });
    const everywhere = dsa.indexOf(N.everywhere.dsa_art9);
    expect(dsa[everywhere + 1]).toBe(N.reappliedNoPreservation("2026-10-02"));
    expect(N.reappliedNoPreservation("2026-10-02")).toBe(
      "The post was first disabled on 2026-10-02. korbat lost its record of that when it had to restore its database from a backup, and disabled the post again with this decision.",
    );
    expect(dsa.join(NL)).not.toContain("six months");
    const erased = statementParagraphs(notice(facts(), { reapplied: { lostOn: "2026-10-02" } }), { texts: TEXTS, erasedOn: "2027-04-05" });
    expect(erased).toContain(N.reappliedNoPreservation("2026-10-02"));
    expect(erased.join(NL)).not.toContain("six months above");
    // A removal order's notice that shows its preservation keeps the sentence that counts from the first time.
    expect(statementParagraphs(notice(facts(), { reapplied: { lostOn: "2026-10-02" } }), { texts: TEXTS })).toContain(N.reapplied("2026-10-02"));
  });
});

describe("3f Task 6: a decision taken again after a restore (design, sections 7.17 step 7 and 10.4, W.2)", () => {
  test("the sentence, word for word, names the lost decision's day and that the time to appeal counts from this one", () => {
    expect(STATEMENT_WORDS.reapplied("2026-10-02")).toBe(
      "korbat first took this decision on 2026-10-02. It lost its record of that when it had to restore its database from a backup, and has taken the decision again here. Your time to appeal counts from this one.",
    );
  });

  test("it follows what was done, before where and how long; a decision that took nothing again has no such sentence", () => {
    const again = statementParagraphs(statement({ reapplied: { lostOn: "2026-10-02" } }));
    expect(again.slice(0, 3)).toEqual([`korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`, STATEMENT_WORDS.reapplied("2026-10-02"), "This applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date."]);
    expect(again.slice(2)).toEqual(statementParagraphs(statement()).slice(1));
    expect(text(statement())).not.toMatch(/restore/);
    expect(text(statement({ reapplied: null }))).not.toMatch(/restore/);
    // A correction taken again: after its lead and what it lifted.
    const corrected = statementParagraphs(
      statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed: { kind: "final", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: DECIDED }, reapplied: { lostOn: "2026-10-02" } }),
    );
    expect(corrected[2]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.reapplied("2026-10-02"));
  });
});

describe("the package", () => {
  test("its index re-exports the statement and its words: the index is the package's only door", () => {
    expect(typeof statementParagraphs).toBe("function");
    expect(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation).toBe("No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.");
  });
});

describe("IMAGE_LOST_NOTICE (3d design, sections 7.1 and 9.6; W.8): an image korbat lost", () => {

    expect(IMAGE_LOST_NOTICE.mail("2026-10-01")).toBe(

describe("3d Task 6: a program's measure and a person's decision after a score (design, sections 7.10 and 10.8; W.3, W.4)", () => {
  const R1 = getRule("R1", 3)!;
  const SCORE = { kind: "r1_score", source: null, matchKind: null, listedAs: null, viewed: null } as const;
  /** A program's withhold of one image under R1, as the step records it: no decider, interim, fully automated. */
  const program = (more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}) =>
    statement({
      kind: "interim",
      rulesVersion: 3,
      redressVersion: 4,
      facts: null,
      reason: null,
      source: "own_initiative",
      measures: [measure("withhold_media")],
      automatedDetection: true,
      automatedDecision: "fully",
      signal: SCORE,
      ...more,
    });
  /** A moderator's final removal of the image after the program's finding, with the record of whether they opened it. */
  const person = (viewed: boolean, more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}) =>
    statement({ rulesVersion: 3, redressVersion: 4, source: "own_initiative", measures: [measure("remove_media")], automatedDetection: true, automatedDecision: "not_automated", signal: { ...SCORE, viewed }, ...more });

  test("a program's statement, paragraph by paragraph, in its own order, with Ask for a person in the place of the interim redress", () => {
    expect(statementParagraphs(program())).toEqual([
      `korbat hid one image of your post of ${POST_TIME} from other people while it decides.`,
      "This applies everywhere korbat is available, for as long as korbat decides the case.",
      "This lasts until a moderator has decided. A program does nothing else: it removes nothing, hides no text, and does not suspend, limit or end your account.",
      "What this decision is about was found by an automated check of korbat's own.",
      "Automated means were used to find this and to take this measure: a program rated an image of your post as likely within rule R1, and korbat hid that image at once. No person took part in this measure, and no moderator has decided yet.",
      `The rule this was done under: korbat rule R1, "${R1.title}": ${R1.text}`,
      REDRESS_TEXTS[4].askPerson,
    ]);
  });

  test("a program's measure is never worded as a finding, and says how to reach a person, with no score, no staff text and no word that a person looked", () => {
    const words = text(program());
    expect(words).not.toMatch(/It breaks|korbat's reasons|The facts|looked at the image|confirmed|posted such|is child sexual abuse material/);
    expect(words).toContain("Automated means were used");
    expect(words).toContain("Ask for a person");
    // No number but the post's time, the target of version 4's redress and the Digital Services Act's article.
    expect([...words.replace(POST_TIME, "").matchAll(/[0-9]+/g)].map((match) => Number(match[0]))).toEqual([1, 1, 24, 53]);
    // Even a stated fact or reason of a program's decision is not printed: it has none, and the paragraph states what it rests on.
    expect(text(program({ facts: "x", reason: "y" }))).not.toMatch(/The facts|korbat's reasons/);
  });

  test("a person's decision after a score says that a program found it, and that the moderator looked only where the record shows it", () => {
    const seen = statementParagraphs(person(true));
    expect(seen).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.found.r1.viewed);
    expect(seen).toContain("What this decision is about was found by an automated check of korbat's own.");
    expect(seen).not.toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation);
    expect(STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.found.r1.viewed).toBe(
      "Automated means were used to find this: a program rated an image of your post as likely within rule R1. They were not used to decide it: a moderator looked at the image and took this decision.",
    );
    const unseen = text(person(false));
    expect(unseen).toContain(
      "Automated means were used to find this: a program rated an image of your post as likely within rule R1. They were not used to decide it: a moderator took this decision without opening the image.",
    );
    expect(unseen).not.toContain("looked at the image");
    // Without a record of the view (null), it is never said that the moderator looked.
    expect(text(person(false, { signal: SCORE }))).not.toContain("looked at the image");
    // The rest is 3c's: the finding, the facts, the reason and the appeal.
    expect(unseen).toContain(`It breaks korbat rule R1, "${R1.title}"`);
    expect(unseen).toContain("You can appeal this decision once");
  });

  test("a person's decision that gives a strike keeps the strike's sentence on the software beside the program's finding", () => {
    const words = text(person(true, { measures: [measure("remove_media"), measure("strike", { endsAt: "2027-10-04T09:30:15.250Z", activeThen: 1 })] }));
    expect(words).toContain(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.found.r1.viewed} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.strikeRule}`);
    expect(words).not.toContain("No automated means were used");
  });

  test("a decision made before 3d reads as it was sent: no automated member, 3c's sentence and the moderator as the source", () => {
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ source: "own_initiative" }))).toContain("What this decision is about was found by a moderator.");
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toContain("No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.");
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ automatedDetection: false, automatedDecision: "not_automated", signal: null }))).toEqual(statementParagraphs(statement()));
  });

  test("a match's words are the known material's: this version refuses to render one rather than say more than it holds", () => {
    const match = { kind: "known_match", source: "Source", matchKind: "exact", listedAs: "csam", viewed: null } as const;
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(program({ ruleId: "R2", measures: [measure("seal_media")], signal: match }))).toThrow(/not worded/);
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(person(false, { signal: match }))).toThrow(/not worded/);
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(person(false, { automatedDecision: "partially" }))).toThrow(/not worded/);
  });

  test("a program's statement needs a redress version that holds Ask for a person", () => {
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(program({ redressVersion: 3 }))).toThrow(/Ask for a person/);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/src/cli/automation.ts`

```ts
/**
 * automation-status (3d design, section 8.10; Task 6), in the api service, on the API's own role, read-only:
 *
 *   docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/staff.js automation-status
 *
 * A line each: the edge's purge adapter and its outbox; the R1 check, whether it acts, its model and threshold version,
 * and the two days of its impact assessment; known material; the head's witness, its last value and the keeper's mail;
 * whether signed-out readers are counted; what a program found today and what its sweep gave up on; and the use of every
 * limit of a program, by rule. It runs in the api service because what it reports are the API's settings, which it reads
 * with loadConfig as the server does, and the database is read in one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction as the API's
 * role: it writes nothing, and prints no token, no address, no score and no text.
 *
 * The caps count what decisions_record counts: a program's decisions under one rule in the hour and the 24 hours before
 * now, rolling, so the lines say so. "Today" is the UTC day, as the transparency figures count days.
 *
 * Known material is Task 7's: until it is built, its line says that no comparison exists in this version.
 *
 * This file has no entry point of its own, so both bundles can include it (build.mjs says why that matters).
 */
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { AUTOMATION_RULES, R1_TEST_THRESHOLD, SWEEP_HOURS } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { R1_TEST_MODEL } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import type { Config } from "../config";

export const AUTOMATION_USAGE = [
  `${"  automation-status".padEnd(41)}print each adapter of 3d, its settings and impact assessments, a program's findings today and`,
  `${"".padEnd(41)}the use of each of its limits; read-only; run it in the api service`,
];

/** The settings automation-status reports, each read as the server reads it. */
export type AutomationSettings = Pick<
  Config,
  "EDGE_PURGE" | "R1_CLASSIFIER" | "AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS" | "AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1" | "AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1_ACTS" | "HEAD_WITNESS" | "HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL" | "RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT"
>;

/** What the database holds that automation-status reports, read in one statement. */
interface StatusRow {
  purges_waiting: number;
  purges_failed: number;
  head_day: string | null;
  head_witnessed: boolean | null;
  found_r1: number;
  found_r2: number;
  found_none: number;
  given_up: number;
  r1_hour: number;
  r1_day: number;
  r2_hour: number;
  r2_day: number;
  r1_waiting: number;
  r2_waiting: number;
  oldest_request: string | null;
}

/** The R1 check's model, as the API names it: the test scorer's marker model, none while off, and the build's onnx model. */
function r1Model(settings: AutomationSettings): { name: string; thresholdVersion: number } {
  if (settings.R1_CLASSIFIER === "test") return { name: R1_TEST_MODEL, thresholdVersion: R1_TEST_THRESHOLD.thresholdVersion };
  // The onnx adapter is refused by this build's configuration (section 5), so off is the one other value that reaches here.
  return { name: "none", thresholdVersion: AUTOMATION_RULES.r1ThresholdVersion };
}

/** The lines of automation-status, from the settings and one read of the database. */
export async function automationStatus(q: Pick<Db, "execute"> | Pick<DbTx, "execute">, settings: AutomationSettings): Promise<string[]> {
  const c = "automation-status";
  const [row] = (await q.execute(sql`
    select (select count(*)::int from public.edge_purges p where p.outcome is null) as purges_waiting,
           (select count(*)::int from public.edge_purges p where p.outcome = 'failed' and p.done_at > now() - interval '24 hours') as purges_failed,
           h.day::text as head_day, h.token is not null as head_witnessed,
           -- A program's findings since the start of the UTC day, by the rule each cites; the kind is compared as text (0038).
           (select count(*)::int from public.intakes i where i.kind::text = 'automated' and i.rule_id = 'R1' and i.received_at >= t.start) as found_r1,
           (select count(*)::int from public.intakes i where i.kind::text = 'automated' and i.rule_id = 'R2' and i.received_at >= t.start) as found_r2,
           (select count(*)::int from public.intakes i where i.kind::text = 'automated' and i.rule_id is null and i.received_at >= t.start) as found_none,
           -- The sweep reads the signals of the last SWEEP_HOURS hours; an older one left unhandled is one it gave up on.
           (select count(*)::int from public.automated_signals s where s.handled_at is null and s.created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => ${SWEEP_HOURS}::int)) as given_up,
           (select count(*)::int from public.decisions d where d.decided_by is null and d.rule_id = 'R1' and d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 hour') as r1_hour,
           (select count(*)::int from public.decisions d where d.decided_by is null and d.rule_id = 'R1' and d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 day') as r1_day,
           (select count(*)::int from public.decisions d where d.decided_by is null and d.rule_id = 'R2' and d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 hour') as r2_hour,
           (select count(*)::int from public.decisions d where d.decided_by is null and d.rule_id = 'R2' and d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 day') as r2_day,
           -- The measures of a program in force, by rule, as decisions_record counts them for its limit unanswered.
           (select count(*)::int from public.measures_in_force m join public.decisions d on d.id = m.decision_id where d.decided_by is null and d.rule_id = 'R1') as r1_waiting,
           (select count(*)::int from public.measures_in_force m join public.decisions d on d.id = m.decision_id where d.decided_by is null and d.rule_id = 'R2') as r2_waiting,
           (select to_char(min(o.created_at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') from public.automated_objections o
             where exists (select 1 from public.measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = o.decision_id)) as oldest_request
      from (select date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC' as start) t
      left join lateral (select x.day, x.token from public.head_publications x
                          where x.kind = 'head' and x.published_at is not null and x.retired_at is null
                          order by x.day desc limit 1) h on true`)) as unknown as StatusRow[];
  const r = row!;
  const model = r1Model(settings);
  const day = (value: string | undefined) => value ?? "not set";
  const rules = AUTOMATION_RULES;
  return [
    `${c}: edge purge: ${settings.EDGE_PURGE}; ${r.purges_waiting} purges waiting, ${r.purges_failed} failed in 24 hours.`,
    `${c}: R1 check: ${settings.R1_CLASSIFIER}, acts ${settings.AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS}; model ${model.name}, threshold version ${model.thresholdVersion}; impact assessment ${day(settings.AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1)}, for its measure ${day(settings.AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1_ACTS)}.`,
    // Task 7 builds the comparison with known material and its settings; until then nothing of it exists to report.
    `${c}: known material: off; no comparison is built in this version.`,
    `${c}: head witness: ${settings.HEAD_WITNESS}; last value ${r.head_day ?? "none"}, witnessed ${r.head_day === null ? "no" : r.head_witnessed ? "yes" : "no"}; keeper's mail ${settings.HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL === undefined ? "not set: no daily mail is sent" : "set"}.`,
    `${c}: signed-out readers: ${settings.RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT === "on" ? "counted" : "not counted"}.`,
    `${c}: a program's findings today: ${r.found_r1} under R1, ${r.found_r2} under R2, ${r.found_none} without a rule; signals the sweep left unhandled after ${SWEEP_HOURS} hours: ${r.given_up}.`,
    `${c}: a program's decisions under R1: ${r.r1_hour} of ${rules.decisionsPerHour} in the last hour, ${r.r1_day} of ${rules.decisionsPerDay} in the last 24 hours; under R2: ${r.r2_hour} of ${rules.r2DecisionsPerHour}, ${r.r2_day} of ${rules.r2DecisionsPerDay}.`,
    `${c}: a program's measures waiting for a person: under R1 ${r.r1_waiting} of ${rules.unansweredMax}, under R2 ${r.r2_waiting} of ${rules.unansweredMax}; the oldest unanswered request for a person: ${r.oldest_request ?? "none"} (no new measure under either rule once one is older than ${rules.unansweredHours} hours).`,
  ];
}

/** automation-status on a pool: the read in one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction, so every line is of one moment. */
export async function automationStatusOn(apiDb: Db, settings: AutomationSettings): Promise<string[]> {
  return apiDb.transaction((tx) => automationStatus(tx, settings), { isolationLevel: "repeatable read", accessMode: "read only" });
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/automated-repo.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { ALERT_KINDS, type AutomatedDecidedParams, type SignalHandled, type SignalKind, type StatementSignal } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { iso, rows, type Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * The automated decision's statements (3d design, sections 6.6, 7.9 and 7.10; Task 6): the signals, a decision without a
 * decider, the requests for a person, and what the case page, the queue, the home screen and the statement read of them.
 * Every write is the API's role's, through the grants and triggers of the migration automated_decisions: a signal's last
 * four columns are set once each, an objection is inserted once and refused unless its decision's measure is in force,
 * and a decision without a decider stands only when decision_holds passes at commit.
 */

/** A signal as the step reads it. */
export interface SignalRow {
  id: string;
  kind: SignalKind;
  mediaId: string;
  score: number | null;
  thresholdVersion: number | null;
  createdAt: string;
  intakeItemId: string | null;
  decisionId: string | null;
  handledAt: string | null;
  handled: SignalHandled | null;
}

type RawSignal = {
  id: string;
  kind: SignalKind;
  media_id: string;
  score: number | null;
  threshold_version: number | null;
  created_at: string;
  intake_item_id: string | null;
  decision_id: string | null;
  handled_at: string | null;
  handled: SignalHandled | null;
};

const SIGNAL_COLUMNS = sql`s.id, s.kind, s.media_id, s.score, s.threshold_version, ${iso("s.created_at")} as created_at, s.intake_item_id, s.decision_id, ${iso("s.handled_at")} as handled_at, s.handled`;

const signalOfRow = (row: RawSignal): SignalRow => ({
  id: row.id,
  kind: row.kind,
  mediaId: row.media_id,
  score: row.score === null ? null : Number(row.score),
  thresholdVersion: row.threshold_version,
  createdAt: row.created_at,
  intakeItemId: row.intake_item_id,
  decisionId: row.decision_id,
  handledAt: row.handled_at,
  handled: row.handled,
});

/**
 * Step 1 of the automated step (7.9): the signal of a score, one statement that does nothing when the image has a
 * signal of the kind already, handled or not (automated_signals_one is over all rows), so a handled one is never written
 * again beside it. Answers the new signal's id, or null when there was one.
 */
export async function insertScoreSignal(q: Runner, signal: { mediaId: string; score: number; thresholdVersion: number }): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ id: string }>(
    q,
    sql`insert into public.automated_signals (kind, media_id, score, threshold_version)
        values ('r1_score', ${signal.mediaId}::uuid, ${signal.score}::real, ${signal.thresholdVersion}::smallint)
        on conflict (media_id, kind) do nothing
        returning id`,
  );
  return row?.id ?? null;
}

/** A signal by its id, or null. Inside the step it is a statement of its own after the profile's lock. */
export async function signalOf(q: Runner, signalId: string): Promise<SignalRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<RawSignal>(q, sql`select ${SIGNAL_COLUMNS} from public.automated_signals s where s.id = ${signalId}::uuid`);
  return row ? signalOfRow(row) : null;
}

/** The image's signal of a kind, or null. */
export async function signalFor(q: Runner, mediaId: string, kind: SignalKind): Promise<SignalRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<RawSignal>(q, sql`select ${SIGNAL_COLUMNS} from public.automated_signals s where s.media_id = ${mediaId}::uuid and s.kind = ${kind}`);
  return row ? signalOfRow(row) : null;
}

/** Step 2.2's last write: the finding's item on its signal, once (the guard refuses a second). */
export async function joinSignal(tx: DbTx, signalId: string, itemId: string): Promise<void> {
  await tx.execute(sql`update public.automated_signals set intake_item_id = ${itemId}::uuid where id = ${signalId}::uuid`);
}

/**
 * What the step did with the signal, once, with the decision of a measure: `measure` names its decision, every other end
 * names none. The guard forces handled_at to the database's now().
 */
export async function signalHandled(tx: DbTx, signalId: string, handled: SignalHandled, decisionId: string | null = null): Promise<void> {
  await tx.execute(sql`update public.automated_signals set handled = ${handled}, handled_at = now(), decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid where id = ${signalId}::uuid`);
}

/**
 * A decision without a decider (7.9 step 2.4), from the params the system's audit row will carry: no decider and no text;
 * everything else the row holds is the triggers'. The id is the API's, so the audit row and the signal can name it.
 */
export async function insertSystemDecision(tx: DbTx, row: { id: string; caseId: string; params: AutomatedDecidedParams }): Promise<void> {
  const p = row.params;
  await tx.execute(
    sql`insert into public.decisions (id, case_id, kind, reviews_decision_id, seen_state_version, through_seq, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, category_keyword,
                                      snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, facts_digest, reason_digest, legal_reference_digest, decided_by)
        values (${row.id}::uuid, ${row.caseId}::uuid, ${p.kind}::decision_kind, null, ${p.stateVersion}::int, ${p.throughSeq}::int, ${p.outcome}::decision_outcome,
                ${p.ground}::decision_ground, ${p.ruleId}, ${p.rulesVersion}::smallint, ${p.redressVersion}::smallint, ${p.category}, null,
                ${p.snapshotId}::uuid, ${p.snapshotDigest}, null, null, null, null)`,
  );
}

/**
 * The sweep's own read (7.9, "What starts it"): the signals of these kinds that no step handled, between one minute and
 * `hours` hours old, the oldest first: what a crash or a failed step left. The minute leaves a step started by an entry
 * its time to commit.
 */
export async function unhandledSignals(q: Runner, kinds: readonly SignalKind[], hours: number, limit: number): Promise<string[]> {
  if (kinds.length === 0 || limit <= 0) return [];
  const found = await rows<{ id: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select s.id from public.automated_signals s
         where s.handled_at is null and s.kind = any(${`{${kinds.join(",")}}`}::text[])
           and s.created_at < now() - make_interval(mins => 1) and s.created_at > now() - make_interval(hours => ${hours}::int)
         order by s.created_at, s.id limit ${limit}::int`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

/**
 * The fact `count` of the alert automation_capped: the findings that stand without a measure since the cap was met, that
 * is the signals handled `capped` since the newest one a program took a measure on.
 */
export async function cappedSinceLastMeasure(q: Runner): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ n: number }>(
    q,
    sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.automated_signals s
         where s.handled = 'capped'
           and s.handled_at >= coalesce((select max(m.handled_at) from public.automated_signals m where m.handled = 'measure'), '-infinity'::timestamptz)`,
  );
  return row!.n;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- "Ask for a person"

/** The one statement that writes an objection; its trigger refuses objection_not_open, and a second one meets the key. */
export async function insertObjection(q: Runner, decisionId: string, text: string): Promise<void> {
  await q.execute(sql`insert into public.automated_objections (decision_id, text) values (${decisionId}::uuid, ${text})`);
}

/** The requests for a person whose measure is in force: unanswered, since nothing stores an answer. With the oldest's time. */
export async function objectionsWaiting(q: Runner): Promise<{ count: number; oldestAt: string | null }> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ n: number; oldest: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select count(*)::int as n, ${iso("min(o.created_at)")} as oldest from public.automated_objections o
         where exists (select 1 from public.measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = o.decision_id)`,
  );
  return { count: row!.n, oldestAt: row!.oldest };
}

/**
 * The sweep's daily alert automated_waiting (7.14, "Alerts a job writes"): when requests for a person have waited longer
 * than the published target with their measures in force, one row of the outbox with their count and the oldest one's
 * time, under F's daily rule: none while a row of the kind was written in the last 24 hours. Answers whether it wrote one.
 */
export async function automatedWaitingAlert(q: Runner, targetHours: number): Promise<boolean> {
  const entry = ALERT_KINDS.automated_waiting;
  const written = await rows<{ id: string }>(
    q,
    sql`insert into public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, facts)
        select 'automated_waiting', ${entry.priority}, ${entry.scope},
               jsonb_build_object('count', w.n, 'oldestAt', to_char(w.oldest at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'))
          from (select count(*)::int as n, min(o.created_at) as oldest from public.automated_objections o
                 where o.created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => ${targetHours}::int)
                   and exists (select 1 from public.measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = o.decision_id)) w
         where w.n > 0
           and not exists (select 1 from public.alert_outbox x where x.kind = 'automated_waiting' and x.created_at > now() - make_interval(hours => 24))
        returning id`,
  );
  return written.length > 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- what staff read

/** Home's two counts of a program's measures (8.2): those in force waiting for a person, and those whose author asked for one. */
export async function automatedOverview(q: Runner, max: number): Promise<{ waiting: number; oldestAt: string | null; objected: number; oldestObjectionAt: string | null; cases: string[]; objectedCases: string[] }> {
  const [waiting] = await rows<{ n: number; oldest: string | null; cases: string[] | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select count(*)::int as n, ${iso("min(w.decided_at)")} as oldest,
               (select array_agg(c.case_id order by c.at, c.case_id) from (select x.case_id, min(x.decided_at) as at from (
                  select d.case_id, d.decided_at from public.measures_in_force m join public.decisions d on d.id = m.decision_id where d.decided_by is null) x
                 group by x.case_id order by min(x.decided_at), x.case_id limit ${max}::int) c) as cases
          from (select d.case_id, d.decided_at from public.measures_in_force m join public.decisions d on d.id = m.decision_id where d.decided_by is null) w`,
  );
  const [objected] = await rows<{ n: number; oldest: string | null; cases: string[] | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select count(*)::int as n, ${iso("min(w.created_at)")} as oldest,
               (select array_agg(c.case_id order by c.at, c.case_id) from (select x.case_id, min(x.created_at) as at from (
                  select d.case_id, o.created_at from public.automated_objections o join public.decisions d on d.id = o.decision_id
                   where exists (select 1 from public.measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = o.decision_id)) x
                 group by x.case_id order by min(x.created_at), x.case_id limit ${max}::int) c) as cases
          from (select d.case_id, o.created_at from public.automated_objections o join public.decisions d on d.id = o.decision_id
                 where exists (select 1 from public.measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = o.decision_id)) w`,
  );
  return {
    waiting: waiting!.n,
    oldestAt: waiting!.oldest,
    objected: objected!.n,
    oldestObjectionAt: objected!.oldest,
    cases: waiting!.cases ?? [],
    objectedCases: objected!.cases ?? [],
  };
}

/** The case page's items a program opened (CaseView.signals): each item with its signal's kind and threshold's version. */
export async function caseSignals(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<{ itemId: string; kind: SignalKind; thresholdVersion: number | null }[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ item_id: string; kind: SignalKind; threshold_version: number | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select s.intake_item_id as item_id, s.kind, s.threshold_version from public.automated_signals s join public.intake_items i on i.id = s.intake_item_id
         where i.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid order by i.seq, s.id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ itemId: row.item_id, kind: row.kind, thresholdVersion: row.threshold_version }));
}

/** The request for a person about a program's measure in force on the case (CaseView.objection), or null; the oldest when several stand. */
export async function caseObjection(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<{ text: string; createdAt: string } | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ text: string; created_at: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select o.text, ${iso("o.created_at")} as created_at from public.automated_objections o join public.decisions d on d.id = o.decision_id
         where d.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid and o.text is not null and exists (select 1 from public.measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = o.decision_id)
         order by o.created_at limit 1`,
  );
  return row ? { text: row.text, createdAt: row.created_at } : null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- what the statement reads

/**
 * The automated finding a statement speaks of (DecisionStatement.signal; 7.10, 10.2), read from the decision's own
 * columns and its signal, never from a later event. A decision without a decider: its own signal. A person's decision:
 * the first program's item it considered (a final decision the items it answered; one taken while deciding the items
 * unanswered at its time), and a correction or a review the decision it is about's. For a score, `viewed` is true on a
 * person's decision when the case's access log holds that person's view of the signal's image on this case before the
 * decision and the decision is not stored as unseen; null on a program's. Null when the decision considered no program's
 * finding. It reads the program's items and nothing of a report: no sender, no word and no count.
 */
export async function statementSignal(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementSignal | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ kind: SignalKind; viewed: boolean | null }>(
    q,
    sql`with d as (select x.id, x.case_id, x.kind, x.decided_by, x.decided_at, x.unseen, x.reviews_decision_id from public.decisions x where x.id = ${decisionId}::uuid),
             -- The decision whose considered items count: the reviewed one for a review or a correction, else itself.
             c as (select coalesce(r.id, d.id) as id, coalesce(r.decided_by, d.decided_by) as decided_by, coalesce(r.kind, d.kind) as kind,
                          coalesce(r.decided_at, d.decided_at) as decided_at, d.case_id
                     from d left join public.decisions r on r.id = d.reviews_decision_id and d.kind::text in ('review', 'correction'))
        select s.kind,
               case when d.decided_by is null then null
                    else not d.unseen and exists (select 1 from public.case_access_log l
                                                    where l.case_id = d.case_id and l.staff_id = d.decided_by and l.kind = 'image_viewed'
                                                      and l.media_id = s.media_id and l.at < d.decided_at) end as viewed
          from d, c, public.automated_signals s
         where (c.decided_by is null and s.decision_id = c.id)
            or (c.decided_by is not null and s.intake_item_id in (
                  select i.id from public.intake_items i
                   where i.case_id = c.case_id
                     and case when c.kind::text = 'final' then i.answered_by = c.id
                              else i.created_at <= c.decided_at
                                   and (i.answered_by is null or (select a.decided_at from public.decisions a where a.id = i.answered_by) > c.decided_at) end))
         order by s.created_at, s.id limit 1`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  return { kind: row.kind, source: null, matchKind: null, listedAs: null, viewed: row.viewed };
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/automated.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  AUTOMATION_RULES,
  AutomatedDecidedParams,
  CAP_LIMITS,
  R1_TEST_THRESHOLD,
  RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY,
  SWEEP_BATCH,
  SWEEP_HOURS,
  type CapLimit,
  type DecisionView,
  type ObjectionRequest,
  type SignalHandled,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { REDRESS_VERSION, RULES_VERSION } from "@korbat/rules";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../auth";
import { createJob, type JobLock } from "../lib/jobs";
import { isDeadlock, isLockNotAvailable } from "../lib/lock-bounds";
import { imagePost } from "../media";
import { appendAuditRow } from "../staff";
import { staffAlert } from "./alerts";
import { authorDecisionView } from "./author";
import { authorDecision } from "./author-repo";
import {
  automatedWaitingAlert,
  cappedSinceLastMeasure,
  insertObjection,
  insertScoreSignal,
  insertSystemDecision,
  joinSignal,
  objectionsWaiting,
  signalHandled,
  signalOf,
  unhandledSignals,
  type SignalRow,
} from "./automated-repo";
import { snapshotIn } from "./cases";
import { ModerationError, type ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { isStartOver, recordIntakeIn, type IntakeGround } from "./intake";
import { caseById, insertAction, isSerializationFailure, raisedDetail, raisedMessage, violatedUniqueConstraint } from "./repo";
import { sendStatement } from "./statement";

/**
 * The automated step, its sweep and "Ask for a person" (3d design, sections 2 rows 14 to 25, 5 "The lock order", 6.6,
 * 7.9, 7.10 and 7.14; Task 6). A signal is a fact about one image on a post: a score at or over the threshold (and, from
 * Task 7, a match record). The step turns it into a program's finding and, where the setting allows it, into one
 * protective measure, a decision without a decider that is always interim, holds exactly that measure, and stands only
 * with the system's audit row and its signal (decision_holds at commit). It never runs inside the transaction that made
 * the post or stored the signal's fact: it is a deciding transaction of its own, which takes the author's profile first,
 * as every deciding transaction does. So an image can be public for seconds before a measure.
 *
 * The program never has the last word: its measure lasts until a person decides the case or lifts it, its author is told
 * at once and can ask for a person, and four limits (counted by rule, and two on what waits for a person) stop it from
 * taking new measures, never from opening findings, when nobody answers. No score is ever logged, printed or answered.
 */

/** How often the step's transaction is run again after a deadlock, a lock timeout or a case that closed under it, as an intake is. */
const RETRIES = 3;
/** The longest one run of the step waits for a lock, as an intake waits. */
const LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

/** The sweep's name: its lock is `job:automated-sweep`. A round a minute after the last one ended (7.14). */
export const AUTOMATED_SWEEP_JOB = "automated-sweep";
export const AUTOMATED_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000;

/** The alert automation_capped goes at most once an hour, under this key of the limit store (7.9 step 3). */
export const CAPPED_ALERT_KEY = "automation-capped";
export const CAPPED_ALERT_WINDOW_MS = 60 * 60_000;
/** The alert automated_objection goes at most once in 15 minutes (7.10 step 3). */
export const OBJECTION_ALERT_KEY = "automated-objection";
export const OBJECTION_ALERT_WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60_000;

/**
 * The threshold a score is compared with, and its version, as R1_CLASSIFIER has it (section 5, "The threshold while only
 * the test adapter exists"): none while the scorer is off; the test scorer's own 0.5 under version 0 under `test`; and
 * the owner's measured threshold for a real classifier, which no build of 3d carries, and which opens nothing while it
 * is null. Null means that no score opens anything.
 */
export function r1Threshold(config: Pick<ModerationDeps["config"], "R1_CLASSIFIER">): { threshold: number; thresholdVersion: number } | null {
  if (config.R1_CLASSIFIER === "off") return null;
  if (config.R1_CLASSIFIER === "test") return { threshold: R1_TEST_THRESHOLD.threshold, thresholdVersion: R1_TEST_THRESHOLD.thresholdVersion };
  return AUTOMATION_RULES.r1Threshold === null ? null : { threshold: AUTOMATION_RULES.r1Threshold, thresholdVersion: AUTOMATION_RULES.r1ThresholdVersion };
}

/** What one run of the step did: how it handled the signal ("already" when another run had), and the finding's case and the decision it made, if any. */
export interface StepOutcome {
  handled: SignalHandled | "already";
  caseId: string | null;
  decisionId: string | null;
  /** The limit a refused measure met, for the alert automation_capped. */
  limit: CapLimit | null;
}

/** The ground of a program's finding under R1: rule R1 with its default category, no sender, no text (7.9 step 2.2). */
const R1_GROUND: IntakeGround = {
  kind: "automated",
  channel: "system",
  reporterId: null,
  findingBy: null,
  contactId: null,
  ruleId: "R1",
  allegesIllegal: false,
  csam: false,
  category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1,
  categoryKeyword: null,
  citedLaw: null,
  explanation: null,
  bonaFide: false,
  automatedProcessing: true,
};

/** Thrown inside the step's transaction to end it with nothing written: another run handled the signal first. */
class AlreadyHandled extends Error {}

/**
 * The step for one signal (7.9 "The step"), in one transaction on the API's pool with a 10-second lock timeout, run again
 * up to three times on a deadlock, a lock timeout or a case that closed under it, as an intake is. The image's post and
 * its author are read before it: an attached image never moves to another post, and a post's author never changes. After
 * the commit, each in a try of its own: the author's statement when a measure was taken, and the alert automation_capped
 * when a limit refused one. Task 6 builds the step of a score; a match record's step is Task 7's.
 */
export async function automatedStep(deps: ModerationDeps, signalId: string): Promise<StepOutcome> {
  const signal = await signalOf(deps.apiDb, signalId);
  if (signal === null || signal.handledAt !== null) return { handled: "already", caseId: null, decisionId: null, limit: null };
  if (signal.kind !== "r1_score") throw new Error("the automated step of a match record is Task 7's");
  const postId = await imagePost(deps.apiDb, signal.mediaId);
  const authorId = postId === null ? null : await deps.social.postAuthor(postId);
  let outcome: StepOutcome | null = null;
  for (let attempt = 0; outcome === null; attempt++) {
    try {
      outcome = await deps.apiDb.transaction((tx) => stepIn(deps, tx, signal, postId, authorId));
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof AlreadyHandled) return { handled: "already", caseId: null, decisionId: null, limit: null };
      const retried = isDeadlock(err) || isLockNotAvailable(err) || isSerializationFailure(err) || isStartOver(err);
      if (!retried || attempt >= RETRIES) throw err;
    }
  }
  const done = outcome;
  if (done.decisionId !== null) {
    try {
      await sendStatement(deps, done.decisionId);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.warn({ err, decisionId: done.decisionId }, "moderation: a program's statement was not mailed; it stays pending for the dispatch job");
    }
  }
  if (done.handled === "capped") {
    try {
      await alertCapped(deps, done.limit);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err }, "moderation: the staff accounts were not alerted that a program reached a limit");
    }
  }
  return done;
}

/**
 * One run of the step's transaction (7.9 step 2):
 *   1. the author's profile FOR NO KEY UPDATE, the first lock as in every deciding transaction; then, in a statement of
 *      its own, the signal again: a handled one ends the run with nothing written (three entries may start the step for
 *      one image at once). No live author, a post its author deleted, or an image gone, erased or on another post: the
 *      signal is handled `gone`, and nothing else is written;
 *   2. the finding, as the body of recordIntake writes a moderator's: the post's open case or a new one, one intake of the
 *      kind automated on the channel system, one item about the post that names the image, the case's hold on the post's
 *      images and its first snapshot; then the item on the signal;
 *   3. a savepoint;
 *   4. the measure, only with AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS=on: a snapshot of the post as it stands when the case's newest differs,
 *      the decision without a decider, its one withhold_media of the image, the signal handled `measure` with the
 *      decision, and last the system's plain audit row automated_decided;
 *   5. a refusal of the measure (already_protected, automation_capped) rolls back to the savepoint: the finding stands and
 *      the signal is handled `covered` or `capped`; without a measure for any other reason it is handled `finding`.
 * At commit decision_holds holds the decision to exactly this shape, or nothing commits.
 */
async function stepIn(deps: ModerationDeps, tx: DbTx, signal: SignalRow, postId: string | null, authorId: string | null): Promise<StepOutcome> {
  await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('lock_timeout', ${`${LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS}ms`}::text, true)`);
  const locked = authorId === null ? [] : await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [authorId], "no key update");
  const current = await signalOf(tx, signal.id);
  if (current === null || current.handledAt !== null) throw new AlreadyHandled();

  // Gone: read after the profile's lock, which the author's deletion and the purge take too, so neither can commit meanwhile.
  const post = postId === null ? null : await deps.social.postRef(postId);
  const images = postId === null ? [] : await deps.media.signals(tx, postId);
  const live = locked.length === 1 && !locked[0]!.deleted && post !== null && post.state !== "deleted_by_author" && images.some((image) => image.mediaId === signal.mediaId);
  if (!live || postId === null) {
    await signalHandled(tx, signal.id, "gone");
    return { handled: "gone", caseId: null, decisionId: null, limit: null };
  }

  const recorded = await recordIntakeIn(deps, tx, { ground: R1_GROUND, live: [{ type: "post", id: postId, position: 1, mediaId: signal.mediaId }] });
  const item = recorded.items[0];
  if (item === undefined || item.caseId === null) throw new Error("a program's finding was stored without a case");
  await joinSignal(tx, signal.id, item.id);

  if (deps.config.AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS !== "on") {
    await signalHandled(tx, signal.id, "finding");
    return { handled: "finding", caseId: item.caseId, decisionId: null, limit: null };
  }
  try {
    const decisionId = await tx.transaction((sp) => measureIn(deps, sp, { caseId: item.caseId!, postId, signalId: signal.id, mediaId: signal.mediaId }));
    return { handled: "measure", caseId: item.caseId, decisionId, limit: null };
  } catch (err) {
    const refusal = raisedMessage(err);
    if (refusal === "already_protected") {
      await signalHandled(tx, signal.id, "covered");
      return { handled: "covered", caseId: item.caseId, decisionId: null, limit: null };
    }
    if (refusal === "automation_capped") {
      const detail = raisedDetail(err);
      const limit = (CAP_LIMITS as readonly string[]).includes(detail ?? "") ? (detail as CapLimit) : null;
      await signalHandled(tx, signal.id, "capped");
      return { handled: "capped", caseId: item.caseId, decisionId: null, limit };
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

/** What a program's measure is taken on: the finding's case, its post, the signal and the signal's image. */
export interface MeasureInput {
  caseId: string;
  postId: string;
  signalId: string;
  mediaId: string;
}

/**
 * The params of a program's withhold, as the system's audit row carries them (AutomatedDecidedParams, 10.4): the values
 * every program's decision fixes, with the case's version as this transaction reads it after the item joined, the
 * snapshot and the current rulebook and redress versions.
 */
export function automatedParams(input: { stateVersion: number; snapshot: { id: string; digest: string }; mediaId: string }): AutomatedDecidedParams {
  return AutomatedDecidedParams.parse({
    kind: "interim",
    stateVersion: input.stateVersion,
    throughSeq: 0,
    reviewsDecisionId: null,
    snapshotId: input.snapshot.id,
    snapshotDigest: input.snapshot.digest,
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: "R1",
    rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION,
    redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION,
    category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1,
    categoryKeyword: null,
    actions: [{ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: input.mediaId }],
    factsDigest: null,
    reasonDigest: null,
    legalReferenceDigest: null,
    unfounded: [],
    replaced: false,
  });
}

/**
 * Step 2.4, inside the step's savepoint: the measure of a score. The snapshot of the post as it stands when the case's
 * newest differs (the snapshot route's own run); the decision's row without a decider; its one ledger row; the signal
 * handled `measure` with its decision; and last the system's plain audit row automated_decided on the case, naming the
 * decision, its one signal and the case's target, with the params decision_holds compares. Answers the decision's id.
 */
export async function measureIn(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "social" | "media">, tx: DbTx, input: MeasureInput): Promise<string> {
  const row = await caseById(tx, input.caseId);
  if (row === null) throw new Error("a program's finding names a case that does not exist");
  const snapshot = await snapshotIn(deps, tx, row);
  // The case's version as this transaction reads it after the item joined and the snapshot: what decisions_record compares.
  const stateVersion = (await caseById(tx, input.caseId))!.stateVersion;
  const params = automatedParams({ stateVersion, snapshot, mediaId: input.mediaId });
  const decisionId = randomUUID();
  await insertSystemDecision(tx, { id: decisionId, caseId: input.caseId, params });
  await insertAction(tx, decisionId, params.actions[0]);
  await signalHandled(tx, input.signalId, "measure", decisionId);
  await appendAuditRow(tx, {
    actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID,
    action: "automated_decided",
    targetType: "case",
    targetId: input.caseId,
    requestId: null,
    metadata: { params, decisionId, signalId: input.signalId, target: { type: "post", id: input.postId } },
  });
  return decisionId;
}

/** The alert automation_capped (7.9 step 3; W.7): the limit met as its fact (1), and the findings that stand without a measure since. */
async function alertCapped(deps: ModerationDeps, limit: CapLimit | null): Promise<void> {
  const count = await cappedSinceLastMeasure(deps.apiDb);
  const fact = limit === null ? {} : { [`limit${limit.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${limit.slice(1)}`]: 1 };
  await staffAlert(deps, CAPPED_ALERT_KEY, CAPPED_ALERT_WINDOW_MS, { template: "automation_capped", facts: { at: deps.now().toISOString(), count, ...fact } });
}

/**
 * A score at or over the threshold of an image on a post becomes its signal and its step (7.9 step 1, then step 2). A
 * score under it, or one while no threshold applies, does nothing. An image that has its signal already starts nothing:
 * the step of that signal runs or ran, and the sweep finds it if it failed.
 */
export async function scoreSignal(deps: ModerationDeps, image: { mediaId: string; score: number | null }): Promise<StepOutcome | null> {
  const threshold = r1Threshold(deps.config);
  if (threshold === null || image.score === null || image.score < threshold.threshold) return null;
  const signalId = await insertScoreSignal(deps.apiDb, { mediaId: image.mediaId, score: image.score, thresholdVersion: threshold.thresholdVersion });
  return signalId === null ? null : automatedStep(deps, signalId);
}

/**
 * ModerationForSocial.imagesPublished (7.9, "What starts it"): createPost calls it after its commit when the post has
 * images. It starts its task on the module's background and returns at once, so createPost never waits for a deciding
 * transaction; with the scorer off it starts nothing. The task reads the post's images' scores, which the media module
 * stored when the worker's result was taken in, and runs the step of each at or over the threshold, one after the other.
 */
export function imagesPublished(deps: ModerationDeps, postId: string): void {
  if (r1Threshold(deps.config) === null) return;
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    for (const image of await deps.media.signals(deps.apiDb, postId)) await scoreSignal(deps, image);
  });
}

/** What one round of the sweep did. */
export interface SweepReport {
  /** Signals a crash or a failed step had left unhandled, run again. */
  retried: number;
  /** Images with a score at or over the threshold and no signal, given one. */
  signalled: number;
  /** Steps that failed again, which the next round tries while the signal is younger than SWEEP_HOURS. */
  failed: number;
  /** Whether the round wrote the daily alert automated_waiting. */
  waiting: boolean;
}

/**
 * One round of the job automated-sweep (7.9, 7.14): at most SWEEP_BATCH signals and images, each read only while its tool's
 * adapter is not off, so no program opens a finding on a day on which /rules prints its tool as off. First the signals
 * between one minute and SWEEP_HOURS old that no step handled (the module's own read of automated_signals); then, through
 * MediaForCases.unsignalled, the images of posts of the last SWEEP_HOURS whose score is at or over the threshold and that
 * no signal names. Each step in a try of its own. Then the daily alert automated_waiting, written once in 24 hours while a
 * request for a person has waited longer than the published target.
 */
export async function sweepRound(deps: ModerationDeps): Promise<SweepReport> {
  const report: SweepReport = { retried: 0, signalled: 0, failed: 0, waiting: false };
  const threshold = r1Threshold(deps.config);
  if (threshold !== null) {
    const pending = await unhandledSignals(deps.apiDb, ["r1_score"], SWEEP_HOURS, SWEEP_BATCH);
    for (const signalId of pending) {
      try {
        await automatedStep(deps, signalId);
        report.retried++;
      } catch (err) {
        report.failed++;
        deps.log.error({ err, signalId }, "automated-sweep: a step failed again; the next round tries it");
      }
    }
    const images = await deps.media.unsignalled(SWEEP_BATCH - pending.length, { hours: SWEEP_HOURS, r1: { threshold: threshold.threshold } });
    for (const image of images) {
      try {
        if ((await scoreSignal(deps, image)) !== null) report.signalled++;
      } catch (err) {
        report.failed++;
        deps.log.error({ err, mediaId: image.mediaId }, "automated-sweep: an image's step failed; its signal stays for the next round");
      }
    }
  }
  try {
    report.waiting = await automatedWaitingAlert(deps.apiDb, AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours);
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err }, "automated-sweep: the alert of requests for a person waiting could not be written");
  }
  return report;
}

/** The sweep as a job of the shared lock: a round a minute after the last one ended, on one instance at a time. */
export function createAutomatedSweepJob(deps: ModerationDeps, lock: JobLock) {
  return createJob({ name: AUTOMATED_SWEEP_JOB, intervalMs: AUTOMATED_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS, lockTtlMs: AUTOMATED_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS, lock, log: deps.log, run: () => sweepRound(deps) });
}

/**
 * POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/objection, "Ask for a person" (7.10): the decision is read for its subject alone
 * (not_found for anyone else, for a decision that does not exist and for one its author was not told of); one statement
 * inserts the request, which its trigger refuses with objection_not_open unless the decision is a program's and a measure
 * of it is in force, and which a second text meets as the primary key, answered with the same code. A suspended account
 * may ask: no suspension is read here, as for the reply and the appeal. After the commit, unwaited for, every staff
 * account is alerted at most once in 15 minutes. The answer is the decision as it now reads.
 */
export async function objectToDecision(deps: ModerationDeps, viewer: string, decisionId: string, request: ObjectionRequest): Promise<DecisionView> {
  const facts = await authorDecision(deps.apiDb, viewer, decisionId);
  if (!facts) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  try {
    await insertObjection(deps.apiDb, decisionId, request.text);
  } catch (err) {
    if (raisedMessage(err) === "objection_not_open" || violatedUniqueConstraint(err) === "automated_objections_pkey") throw new ModerationError("objection_not_open");
    throw err;
  }
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    const waiting = await objectionsWaiting(deps.apiDb);
    await staffAlert(deps, OBJECTION_ALERT_KEY, OBJECTION_ALERT_WINDOW_MS, { template: "automated_objection", facts: { at: deps.now().toISOString(), count: waiting.count } });
  });
  return authorDecisionView(deps, viewer, decisionId);
}
```

### Create `apps/worker/src/score.ts`

```ts
import { R1_TEST_MODEL, carriesR1Marker } from "@korbat/media-protocol";

/**
 * The R1 scorer's seam (3d design, sections 2 rows 19 and 23, 5 "The adapters" and 10.2; Task 6). One interface, chosen by
 * R1_CLASSIFIER when the process starts: `off` (the default) scores nothing, so no score is written and R1 stays
 * report-driven; `test` is the deterministic stand-in of the suites, refused on an open site (config.ts); `onnx`, the real
 * classifier, is not built: it stops the worker at start until the owner's later task adds the runtime and the weights.
 *
 * A scorer is given the small size's raw sRGB pixels that the pipeline already holds, with their three or four channels,
 * and nothing else: no file, no name, no network. It answers a score from 0 to 1, or null for none. It never imports the
 * decoder: only pipeline.ts does.
 */
export interface Scorer {
  /** The model's name as the result file writes it, which the API holds to its own setting. */
  readonly model: string;
  score(pixels: Uint8Array, width: number, height: number, channels: number): Promise<number | null>;
}

/** The test scorer: 1 for an image whose top left corner carries the marker of @korbat/media-protocol's fixtures, else 0. */
export const testScorer: Scorer = {
  model: R1_TEST_MODEL,
  score: async (pixels, width, height, channels) => (carriesR1Marker(pixels, width, height, channels) ? 1 : 0),
};

/** The scorer of the setting: none while it is off. The configuration refused every other value before this is asked. */
export function scorerFrom(setting: "off" | "test"): Scorer | null {
  return setting === "test" ? testScorer : null;
}
```

### Create `packages/contracts/src/automation.ts`

```ts
/**
 * What a program may do (3d design, sections 2 rows 14 to 25, 6.6, 7.9 and 10.1; Task 6): the numbers of the automated
 * decision, mirrored from the database's automation_rules(), which a database test holds member for column; the closed
 * lists of a signal and of a cap's limit, each the CHECK of its column or the detail its refusal carries; and the sweep's
 * batch. It imports nothing, so every other module of the contracts can read it while it loads.
 */

/**
 * The mirror of automation_rules() (section 6.6's table). The caps are counted by rule: R1's decisions an hour and a day,
 * and R2's apart, so a burst of scores never uses up the seals of known matches (row 18). `unansweredMax` measures of a
 * program under one rule in force stop new ones under that rule, and a request for a person older than
 * `unansweredHours` stops new ones under either. `r1Threshold` is null until the owner's build task measures one (row
 * 23): while it is null no score opens anything. `objectionTargetHours` is the published target of an answer to "Ask for
 * a person" (row 25), never a time after which a measure ends. The rest are the numbers of known material (rows 33 to 37),
 * which its task reads.
 */
export const AUTOMATION_RULES: {
  readonly decisionsPerHour: number;
  readonly decisionsPerDay: number;
  readonly r2DecisionsPerHour: number;
  readonly r2DecisionsPerDay: number;
  readonly unansweredMax: number;
  readonly unansweredHours: number;
  readonly refusalsPerHour: number;
  readonly noReportHours: number;
  readonly r1Threshold: number | null;
  readonly r1ThresholdVersion: number;
  readonly objectionTargetHours: number;
  readonly matchTimeoutMs: number;
  readonly matchRetryHours: number;
  readonly matcherDownMinutes: number;
  readonly pdqMinQuality: number;
  readonly matchKeepDays: number;
} = {
  decisionsPerHour: 20,
  decisionsPerDay: 100,
  r2DecisionsPerHour: 20,
  r2DecisionsPerDay: 100,
  unansweredMax: 20,
  unansweredHours: 72,
  refusalsPerHour: 20,
  noReportHours: 24,
  r1Threshold: null,
  r1ThresholdVersion: 1,
  objectionTargetHours: 24,
  matchTimeoutMs: 3000,
  matchRetryHours: 24,
  matcherDownMinutes: 15,
  pdqMinQuality: 50,
  matchKeepDays: 180,
};

/**
 * The test scorer's own threshold and its version (section 5, "The threshold while only the test adapter exists"): under
 * R1_CLASSIFIER=test the API compares a score with 0.5 and records the threshold version 0, so the suite exercises the
 * whole path and no stored signal can be mistaken for one of a real model, whose versions start at 1.
 */
export const R1_TEST_THRESHOLD = { threshold: 0.5, thresholdVersion: 0 } as const;

/** The kinds of a signal (automated_signals.kind): a score at or over the threshold, or a match record (Task 7). */
export const SIGNAL_KINDS = ["r1_score", "known_match"] as const;
export type SignalKind = (typeof SIGNAL_KINDS)[number];

/**
 * What the step did with a signal (automated_signals.handled): a finding without a measure; a finding and its measure;
 * a finding whose measure a cap or a limit refused; a finding whose measure another measure already stood for; or
 * nothing, since the image, its post or its author left first.
 */
export const SIGNAL_HANDLED = ["finding", "measure", "capped", "covered", "gone"] as const;
export type SignalHandled = (typeof SIGNAL_HANDLED)[number];

/**
 * The limit a refusal automation_capped met, its detail and the fact of the alert automation_capped: the hour's or the
 * day's decisions of a program under one rule, its measures under one rule left unanswered, or a request for a person
 * that has waited too long.
 */
export const CAP_LIMITS = ["hour", "day", "unanswered", "waiting"] as const;
export type CapLimit = (typeof CAP_LIMITS)[number];

/** How many signals one round of the sweep takes at most, and how far back it looks (section 7.9). */
export const SWEEP_BATCH = 20;
export const SWEEP_HOURS = 24;
```

```sql
-- Everything below is written by hand (3d design, sections 2 rows 14 to 18 and 25, 5 "The lock order", 6 and 6.6; Task 6).
-- The design numbers this migration 0035; earlier tasks of 3d added migrations the design did not foresee, so it is 0038.
-- As in 0016 to 0037: every function is owned by the migrator, pins its search path to public and pg_temp, names every
-- object schema-qualified and has EXECUTE taken from PUBLIC; an error carries its code as the message under SQLSTATE
-- P0001, and a guard's refusal is moderation_column under SQLSTATE 42501, as 3c's guards answer. "For every role but the
-- migrator" means current_user <> 'korbat_migrate'.
--
-- The rule for the two new values (section 6): ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE cannot be used as a literal of the enum before
-- the migrating transaction commits (55P04), and drizzle runs every pending migration in one transaction. So `automated`
-- and `system` are named as enum literals only inside PL/pgSQL bodies, which are parsed when first called; every CHECK
-- above compares kind::text and channel::text; no index predicate and no default names one; and no statement here runs a
-- function that touches one. The source test enum-literals.test.ts reads this file under that rule.
--
-- 1. The grants. 0001's default privileges gave the API role every right on a new public table; each table loses them
-- all, then gets what section 6.6 lists. automated_signals: the API's role reads, inserts and sets the last four columns
-- (the finding's item, the decision, and when and how the signal was handled), each once by the guard below; no DELETE (the
-- retention of signals is a later task's, as a definer function). automated_objections: it reads and inserts, and neither
-- updates nor deletes: an objection is answered by a person's decision, which stores nothing on it.
REVOKE ALL ON "public"."automated_signals" FROM korbat_api;--> statement-breakpoint
```
