```ts
import { MEASURES, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind, type RuleId, type StandingBasis } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { DecisionMessage } from "../auth";
import type { ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { beginMailRecord, lockPendingAuthorMail, recordAuthorMail, standingWithdrawn, type MailState } from "./repo";
import { statementSignal } from "./automated-repo";
import { endedMeasures, endedStanding, orderNoticeOf, reappliedOn, repliedTo, statementActions, statementDecision, type StatementDecisionRow } from "./statement-repo";

/**
 * The data a statement of reasons and its mail are rendered from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10). A decision is the
 * statement: every element is a column, a ledger row or a saved text, read here into the one shape that @korbat/rules
 * renders for the mail, the author's screen and the console's preview. Nothing read here is changed by a later event, so
 * a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered.
 */

/** A decision's statement with what mailing it needs: whom it is about, and whether its mail is still owed. */
export interface StatementFound {
  statement: DecisionStatement;
  decision: StatementDecisionRow;
}

/** Whether a field reset's old value was still kept when the decision that ends or lifts it was made, and where it can be read. */
function resetFacts(kind: MeasureKind | ReversalKind, held: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean }) {
  const target = MEASURES[kind].target;
  if (target !== "display_name" && target !== "bio") return { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null };
  // The reset's own snapshot holds the old value, by its compare-and-set; a reset that changed nothing removed none.
  return { resetDecisionId: held.decisionId, oldValueKept: held.noEffect === null && held.snapshotKept, resetRuleId: held.ruleId as RuleId | null };
}

/**
 * The statement's data of one decision, or null when no decision has the id. 3f: an order decision, and the correction
 * of one, carries `order`, the facts its notice is rendered from as they stand, with the operator's home state for the
 * scrutiny's paragraph (null where the caller has no setting at hand: a mail renders no notice).
 */
export async function decisionStatement(q: ModerationDeps["apiDb"], decisionId: string, homeState: string | null = null): Promise<StatementFound | null> {
  const decision = await statementDecision(q, decisionId);
  if (!decision) return null;
  const notice = decision.kind === "order" || (decision.kind === "correction" && decision.reviewed?.kind === "order") ? await orderNoticeOf(q, decisionId, homeState) : null;
  const actions = await statementActions(q, decisionId);
  const ended = decision.kind === "final" ? await endedMeasures(q, decisionId) : [];
  // 3e: the standing measures whose basis a reversal of this decision broke; absent from a statement that holds none.
  const brokenBasis = decision.kind === "review" || decision.kind === "correction" ? await endedStanding(q, decisionId) : [];
  // 3e Task 4: the reply this correction or review answered by keeping or reversing its measure; absent when none.
  const replied = decision.kind === "review" || decision.kind === "correction" ? await repliedTo(q, decisionId) : null;
  // 3f Task 6: a decision that took again one lost with a restore names the lost decision's day, read from the gap it
  // closed, which is kept as long as the decision; absent from every other statement.
  const lostOn = await reappliedOn(q, decisionId);
  // The facts and the reason are told with a decision that restricts (it holds a measure), with a correction and with a
  // review. Those of a decision without a measure are the case's record, for staff: such a decision tells its author at
  // most that what korbat did while deciding has ended, so the statement's data holds neither, and no mail, screen or
  // export that is rendered from it can carry them.
  const told = decision.kind === "correction" || decision.kind === "review" || actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
  // 3d Task 6 (sections 7.10 and 10.2): the program's finding the decision rests on or considered, read only when its
  // detection was automated; a decision made before 3d reads false, not_automated and null.
  const signal = decision.automatedDetection ? await statementSignal(q, decisionId) : null;
  const statement: DecisionStatement = {
    kind: decision.kind,
    outcome: decision.outcome as DecisionStatement["outcome"],
    ground: decision.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
    ruleId: decision.ruleId as RuleId | null,
    rulesVersion: decision.rulesVersion,
    redressVersion: decision.redressVersion,
    legalReference: decision.legalReference,
    facts: told ? decision.facts : null,
    reason: told ? decision.reason : null,
    source: decision.source as DecisionStatement["source"],
    decidedAt: decision.decidedAt,
    // 3f's review (people3): the appeal's six months count from the telling, which a held decision's release sets.
    informedAt: decision.informedAt,
    post: decision.targetType === "post" && decision.postCreatedAt !== null ? { id: decision.targetId, createdAt: decision.postCreatedAt } : null,
    measures: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as MeasureKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        noEffect: action.noEffect,
        sealed: action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: action.sealedPosts, images: action.sealedImages, deletedImages: action.sealedDeletedImages } : null,
        // 3e: what the ledger fixed for good about a strike, a standing measure and a retirement, so its statement reads as
        // it was sent (a retirement's sentence reads its end from whether the decision suspends or terminates at once).
        ...(action.kind === "strike" ? { endsAt: action.endsAt, activeThen: action.activeThen } : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate"
          ? {
              announced: action.announced,
              days: action.days,
              basis: action.basis as StandingBasis | null,
              earliestStart: action.earliestStart,
              endsAt: action.endsAt,
              restsOn: action.restsOn === null ? null : action.restsOn.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, ruleId: entry.ruleId as RuleId | null })),
            }
          : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "retire_handle" ? { handle: action.handle, placeholder: action.placeholder } : {}),
        // 3e Task 5: a warning's end of counting; a restriction's days, its end and the warning it follows.
        ...(action.kind === "warn_reporting" ? { basis: action.basis as StandingBasis | null, endsAt: action.endsAt } : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "restrict_reporting" ? { basis: action.basis as StandingBasis | null, days: action.days, endsAt: action.endsAt, warnedAt: action.warnedAt } : {}),
      })),
    reversals: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as ReversalKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        ...(action.lifted === null ? { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } : resetFacts(action.kind, action.lifted)),
        // 3e: the handle a reversal of a retirement gives back.
        ...(action.kind === "unretire_handle" ? { handle: action.handle } : {}),
        // 3e: what a lift of a suspension lifted, where its period stood then, and whether it was a withdrawal for another measure.
        ...(action.kind === "lift_suspension"
          ? { liftedKind: action.liftedKind, liftedDecidedAt: action.liftedDecidedAt, periodThen: action.periodThen, replaced: action.replaced, replyFiledAt: action.replyFiledAt }
          : {}),
        // 3e Task 5: what a lift of a reporting measure lifted, and for a restriction whether its days still ran.
        ...(action.kind === "lift_reporting" ? { liftedKind: action.liftedKind, liftedDecidedAt: action.liftedDecidedAt, periodThen: action.periodThen } : {}),
      })),
    endedMeasures: ended.map((measure) => ({ kind: measure.kind as MeasureKind, mediaId: measure.mediaId, ...resetFacts(measure.kind, measure) })),
    ...(brokenBasis.length > 0 ? { endedStanding: brokenBasis } : {}),
    ...(replied !== null ? { repliedTo: replied } : {}),
    order: notice?.facts ?? null,
    ...(lostOn !== null ? { reapplied: { lostOn } } : {}),
    automatedDetection: decision.automatedDetection,
    automatedDecision: decision.automatedDecision,
    signal,
    reviewed:
      decision.reviewed === null
        ? null
        : {
            kind: decision.reviewed.kind,
            ground: decision.reviewed.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
            ruleId: decision.reviewed.ruleId as RuleId | null,
            // The reviewed decision's own rulebook version: its rule is rendered as it was worded when that decision was made.
            rulesVersion: decision.reviewed.rulesVersion,
            legalReference: decision.reviewed.legalReference,
            decidedAt: decision.reviewed.decidedAt,
            // 3e's review (people1): a measure on the terms is answered on the terms, never on the rule its decision cited.
            basis: decision.reviewed.basis as StandingBasis | null,
          },
  };
  return { statement, decision };
}

/**
 * The subject of the statement's mail, by the decision's kind and outcome (3c design, section 7.15), as a key of the mail
 * template's own table: a seal first, whatever else the decision holds; then a decision taken while deciding, on a post
 * or on an account; a final restriction; a final decision that restricts nothing but ends or lifts what was done while
 * deciding, and a correction of a decision taken while deciding; a reversal of a final decision; and a kept appeal.
 */
export function mailSubjectOf(statement: DecisionStatement): Extract<DecisionMessage, { template: "moderation_decision" }>["subject"] {
  const seals = statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media");
  // 3d Task 6 (W.8): a program's decision first, by its one measure.
  if (statement.automatedDecision === "fully") return seals ? "program_seal" : "program_withhold";
  const post = statement.post !== null;
  if (statement.kind === "interim") return seals ? "seal_deciding" : post ? "post_deciding" : "profile_deciding";
  if (statement.kind === "final") {
    if (seals) return "seal_final";
    if (statement.outcome === "restricted") return post ? "post_restricted" : "profile_restricted";
    return "lifted_deciding";
  }
  if (statement.kind === "correction") return statement.reviewed?.kind === "interim" ? "lifted_deciding" : "reversed";
  return statement.outcome === "kept" ? "appeal_kept" : "reversed";
}

/**
 * The template a decision's statement is mailed under (3e design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6): the first row of 7.15's
 * table that fits, and moderation_decision otherwise, so that a strike, a retirement and their reversals ride on 3c's
 * mail. In order: an announced suspension or termination; one taken at once; the answer to a reply (a statement with
 * `repliedTo`); a lift of one (a withdrawal signed `replaced` under its own lead), or a decision whose reversal ended one by
 * breaking its basis; a final warning about reporting; a final restriction of reporting. A lift of a reporting measure,
 * also one that ends a restriction with its warning, rides on moderation_decision.
 */
export function mailTemplateOf(statement: DecisionStatement, paragraphs: readonly string[], mailedBefore = false): DecisionMessage {
  // 3f (design, section 7.19): three rows in front. An order decision is mailed its notice, or, once its first mail went
  // and the authority's words were added since, that the notice grew; a reinstatement after an order that it grew. None
  // carries the notice's paragraphs: each mail says only that a notice is there.
  if (statement.kind === "order") return { template: mailedBefore ? "order_notice_added" : "order_notice", paragraphs: [] };
  if (statement.kind === "correction" && statement.reversals.some((reversal) => reversal.kind === "reinstate_by_order")) return { template: "order_reinstated_notice", paragraphs: [] };
  const standing = statement.measures.find((measure) => measure.kind === "suspend" || measure.kind === "terminate");
  if (statement.kind === "final" && standing !== undefined && standing.announced === true) {
    const measure = standing.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend";
    if (standing.earliestStart === undefined || standing.earliestStart === null) throw new Error("an announced measure's mail names its earliest start: the statement's data holds none");
    // The window is the row's own: its earliest start less its decision's time, in hours.
    const window = Math.round((Date.parse(standing.earliestStart) - Date.parse(statement.decidedAt)) / 3_600_000);
    return { template: "suspension_announced", measure, days: measure === "terminate" ? null : (standing.days ?? null), window, earliestStart: standing.earliestStart, paragraphs };
  }
  if (statement.kind === "final" && standing !== undefined && standing.announced === false) {
    const measure = standing.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend";
    return { template: "suspension_started_at_once", measure, days: standing.days ?? null, endsAt: standing.endsAt ?? null, paragraphs };
  }
  const lift = statement.reversals.find((reversal) => reversal.kind === "lift_suspension");
  if (statement.repliedTo !== undefined) {
    // A review that reverses part but leaves the measure in force answers the reply as a kept answer does.
    const lifted = lift !== undefined && lift.replaced !== true;
    return { template: "reply_answered", outcome: lifted ? "reversed" : "kept", paragraphs };
  }
  if ((statement.kind === "review" || statement.kind === "correction") && lift !== undefined && lift.replaced === true && lift.liftedDecidedAt) {
    return {
      template: "suspension_lifted",
      measure: lift.liftedKind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend",
      why: "replaced",
      decidedAt: lift.liftedDecidedAt,
      replied: lift.replyFiledAt !== undefined && lift.replyFiledAt !== null,
      paragraphs,
    };
  }
  if ((statement.kind === "review" || statement.kind === "correction") && lift !== undefined && lift.periodThen) {
    return { template: "suspension_lifted", measure: lift.liftedKind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend", why: "lifted", period: lift.periodThen.state, paragraphs };
  }
  const broken = (statement.endedStanding ?? []).find((entry) => entry.kind === "suspend" || entry.kind === "terminate");
  if (broken !== undefined) return { template: "suspension_lifted", measure: broken.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend", why: "basis", period: broken.periodThen.state, paragraphs };
  if (statement.kind === "final" && statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "warn_reporting")) return { template: "reporting_warned", paragraphs };
  const restriction = statement.measures.find((measure) => measure.kind === "restrict_reporting");
  if (statement.kind === "final" && restriction !== undefined) {
    if (typeof restriction.days !== "number" || typeof restriction.endsAt !== "string") throw new Error("a restriction of reporting's mail names its days and its end: the statement's data holds neither");
    return { template: "reporting_restricted", days: restriction.days, endsAt: restriction.endsAt, paragraphs };
  }
  return { template: "moderation_decision", subject: mailSubjectOf(statement), paragraphs };
}

/**
 * Mails a decision's statement to its author when that mail is still owed, and records what became of it: `sent`,
 * `no_address` for an account that is gone, `failed` when the relay refused the address for good. A failure of the relay
 * is thrown, and the mail stays pending for the dispatch job. Answers what was recorded, or "none" when nothing was owed.
 *
 * The decision's row is taken before the mail is sent, in the transaction that records the result (beginMailRecord): a
 * database that cannot write refuses that, and nothing is sent, so a mail is never sent again and again for want of a
 * record. Two senders of one statement (the decision's own request and the dispatch job) then send it once: the second
 * waits for the row and finds the mail recorded.
 *
 * 3e (design, section 5, the lock order, item 4): for a decision that holds an announced suspension or termination, the
 * outcome fixes the measure's start (the database's decisions_mail_standing derives the profile's columns), so the
 * transaction takes the subject's profile FOR NO KEY UPDATE before it records the outcome. It takes it right before the
 * record and after the send (3e's review, database3): a profile held across a relay that stalls would hold every write of
 * the account and every follow of it, and the decisions about it, for as long as the relay. The decision's row comes first
 * then, which no deciding transaction waits for: a decision about the account takes the decisions it answers FOR KEY SHARE
 * only, through its foreign key, and the take-down, the only transaction that takes a profile and then a decision's row
 * FOR UPDATE, takes only a termination whose period has started, which a notice still owed never gives.
 *
 * A statement whose suspension or termination a later decision has lifted, or whose basis a reversal has broken, while
 * its mail was owed (3e's review, proofs1) is recorded failed and never sent: it would name a start and invite a reply
 * that no longer exist. The check is a statement of its own after the decision's row is held, so it sees every lift that
 * committed before; the measure, lifted, fixes no start whatever is recorded.
 */
export async function sendStatement(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "auth" | "social">, decisionId: string): Promise<MailState | "none"> {
  const found = await decisionStatement(deps.apiDb, decisionId);
  if (!found || found.decision.authorMail !== "pending") return "none";
  const subject = found.decision.subjectId;
  // The statement is rendered before anything is sent: one that cannot be rendered is no mail, and stays pending.
  const message = mailTemplateOf(found.statement, statementParagraphs(found.statement), found.decision.authorMailAt !== null);
  const standing = found.statement.kind === "final" && found.statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "suspend" || measure.kind === "terminate");
  const announced = standing && found.statement.measures.some((measure) => (measure.kind === "suspend" || measure.kind === "terminate") && measure.announced === true);
  return deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await beginMailRecord(tx);
    if (!(await lockPendingAuthorMail(tx, decisionId))) return "none";
    let state: MailState;
    if (standing && (await standingWithdrawn(tx, decisionId))) state = "failed";
    else {
      const result = subject === null ? "no_address" : await deps.auth.mailAccount(subject, message);
      // A stop of the address never holds a statement back, so "suppressed" is never answered for it.
      state = result === "sent" ? "sent" : result === "refused" ? "failed" : "no_address";
    }
    if (announced && subject !== null) await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [subject], "no key update");
    await recordAuthorMail(tx, decisionId, state);
    return state;
  });
}

import type { CreatePostRequest, Pagination, PostView, ThreadResponse } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { isDeadlock } from "../../lib/lock-bounds";
import { SocialError, type SocialDeps, type ViewerId } from "../context";
import { decodeCursor } from "../cursor";
import { enforceWriteLimit } from "../limits";
import type { PostRow, ProfileRow } from "../repo";
import { isTombstone, loadPostViews, pageCursor, postView, postViews } from "../views";
import { postAccess } from "../visibility";

/** The viewer's own profile row; the tiers need its creation time. */
export async function ownProfile(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string): Promise<ProfileRow> {
  const profile = (await deps.repo.findProfiles([viewer])).get(viewer);
  if (!profile) throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  return profile;
}

/**
 * A post the viewer wants to act on. The post's own state is judged first, so someone probing ids
 * learns nothing about hidden or deleted posts from a block. Then the refusal is directional: when
 * the viewer blocked the author it is `blocked`; when the author blocked the viewer it is
 * `hiddenCode`, which reveals nothing.
 */
export async function targetPost(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, id: string, hiddenCode: "not_found" | "post_unavailable" = "not_found"): Promise<PostRow> {
  const hidden = () => new SocialError(hiddenCode, hiddenCode === "not_found" ? 404 : 400);
  const row = (await deps.repo.findPosts([id])).get(id);
  if (!row) throw hidden();
  if (postAccess(viewer, row, false) !== "shown") throw hidden();
  if (row.authorId !== viewer) {
    const relation = await deps.repo.relation(viewer, row.authorId);
    if (relation.blocked) throw new SocialError("blocked", 403);
    if (relation.blockedBy) throw hidden();
  }
  return row;
}

/**
 * A post, a reply or a quote by the viewer. 3e (design, section 5, the lock order, item 3): the repository takes the
 * author's row before the replied-to or quoted author's, and a purge takes its own row before its followers'; a quote of
 * the purged account's post by one of its followers can cross that purge, and PostgreSQL ends one of the two. The post's
 * transaction then changed nothing, so it is run once more: the second try finds the purge committed and answers as for
 * any deleted account. A second deadlock is the caller's.
 */
export async function createPost(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, input: CreatePostRequest): Promise<PostView> {
  const me = await ownProfile(deps, viewer);
  const action = input.replyToId ? "reply" : input.quoteOfId ? "quote" : "post";
  const targetId = input.replyToId ?? input.quoteOfId;
  const target = targetId ? await targetPost(deps, viewer, targetId, "post_unavailable") : null;
  await enforceWriteLimit(deps.limits, viewer, action, me.createdAt, deps.now());
  const write = () =>
    deps.repo.createPost({
      authorId: viewer,
      body: input.body,
      replyToId: input.replyToId ?? null,
      quoteOfId: input.quoteOfId ?? null,
      now: deps.now(),
      lockWith: target && target.authorId !== viewer ? target.authorId : null,
      within: (tx, postId) => deps.media.attach(tx, { postId, ownerId: viewer, items: input.media }),
    });
  const id = await onceMoreOnDeadlock(write);
  // 3d Task 6 (design, sections 5 and 7.9): after the commit, never inside its transaction, a post with images is handed
  // to the moderation module's automated step, which starts its task unwaited for and returns at once; a failure to start
  // it is logged, and the sweep finds the images' scores within a minute. The post's answer never waits for it.
  if (input.media.length > 0) {
    try {
      deps.moderation?.imagesPublished(id);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, postId: id }, "posts: the automated step of a new post's images was not started; the sweep takes them");
    }
  }
  return (await postView(deps, viewer, id))!;
}

/** Runs a write, and once more when the database chose it to give way in a deadlock: it changed nothing (3e design, section 5). */
export async function onceMoreOnDeadlock<T>(write: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  try {
    return await write();
  } catch (err) {
    if (!isDeadlock(err)) throw err;
    return write();
  }
}

export async function getPost(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: ViewerId, id: string): Promise<PostView> {
  const view = await postView(deps, viewer, id);
  if (!view) throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  return view;
}

/** Author only. Deleting twice is a no-op. Someone who may not see the post learns nothing. */
export async function deletePost(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, id: string): Promise<void> {
  const row = (await deps.repo.findPosts([id])).get(id);
  // 3f (design, section 7.10): a post disabled for an authority's order answers its author as a post that does not
  // exist, so its deletion is not_found, as for anyone (the repository's update and posts_guard refuse it too).
  if (!row || row.state === "disabled") throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  if (row.authorId === viewer) {
    // The image rows go with the post, in its transaction. Their files are deleted after the commit: files cannot be rolled back.
    // The media module answers only the rows that are gone: an image a case holds as evidence, and every image of a frozen
    // post, keeps its row, served to nobody, and no deletion is asked for its files.
    let images: string[] = [];
    const remove = () =>
      deps.repo.deletePost(id, viewer, deps.now(), async (tx) => {
        images = await deps.media.detachAll(tx, id);
      });
    try {
      await remove();
    } catch (err) {
      // The deletion takes its posts in the order a report takes them, so the two never deadlock. An account's purge
      // still writes the counters of other accounts' posts in no order (its own comment says so), and the database may
      // end this transaction to break such a cycle. It has then changed nothing, so it is run once more: the author who
      // takes content down is not answered with an error for a wait that is over. A second deadlock is the caller's.
      if (!isDeadlock(err)) throw err;
      images = [];
      await remove();
    }
    await deps.media.requestDeletion(images);
    return;
  }
  const blocked = (await deps.repo.blockedEitherWay(viewer, [row.authorId])).has(row.authorId);
  if (postAccess(viewer, row, blocked) !== "shown") throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  throw new SocialError("not_author", 403);
}

/** The post, its ancestors root first (tombstones where needed), and a page of direct replies oldest first. */
export async function thread(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: ViewerId, id: string, query: Pagination): Promise<ThreadResponse> {
  const post = await getPost(deps, viewer, id);
  const ancestorIds = await deps.repo.ancestorIds(id);
  const loaded = await loadPostViews(deps, viewer, ancestorIds);
  const ancestors = ancestorIds.map((ancestorId) => loaded.get(ancestorId)!);
  const cursor = query.cursor ? decodeCursor(query.cursor) : undefined;
  const rows = await deps.repo.replies(id, viewer, cursor, query.limit);
  const items = await postViews(deps, viewer, rows);
  return { ancestors: ancestors.map((a) => (isTombstone(a) ? a : a)), post, replies: { items, nextCursor: pageCursor(rows, query.limit) } };
}

/**
 * The transparency module (3d design, sections 4 rows 4 and 5, 5, 7.5, 7.6, 7.7 and 7.14; Tasks 4 and 5): the public
 * figures, the audit head's daily value and the public answers. The only file outside src/transparency/ may import; it
 * reads no session and no table of a person, and the architecture test holds every file of it to the names of
 * @korbat/db's schema/transparency.ts and the audit head.
 *
 *   - the recipients' count: the two calls the auth module's resolveSession makes (forAuth, registered with auth.onSeen
 *     once both modules exist) and the month's close;
 *   - the yearly edition: the daily call of edition_publish() for the last closed year and every earlier year with one;
 *   - the head's daily value (Task 5): the day's row of head_publications, the witness adapter (witness.ts, HEAD_WITNESS)
 *     and the keeper's mail through the auth module's mailKeeper (AuthForTransparency);
 *   - GET /api/public/facts, GET /api/public/transparency and GET /api/public/head;
 *   - one job, `transparency`, every ten minutes under the jobs' shared lock: the month's close each round, and after
 *     MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR the editions once a day and the head in each round until the day's value is published and
 *     witnessed, or needs no witness. Each daily part is idempotent by its table's key, so a round after a restart that
 *     runs it again writes nothing.
 */
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import type { Db } from "@korbat/db";
import type { AuthForTransparency } from "../auth";
import type { Config } from "../config";
import { createJob, type JobLock } from "../lib/jobs";
import { publishEditions } from "./editions";
import { publishHead, type HeadPass } from "./head";
import { closeMonths, createRecipientCounter, type RecipientCounter, type SketchStore } from "./recipients";
import { createTransparencyRepo } from "./repo";
import { publicFacts, transparencyRoutes } from "./routes";
import { witnessFrom, type WitnessAdapter } from "./witness";

export type { SketchStore } from "./recipients";
export type { HeadPass } from "./head";
export type { WitnessAdapter } from "./witness";
export { publicTransparency } from "./editions";
export { headValue, publicHead } from "./head";
export { isReadRoute, sketchKeys } from "./recipients";
export { witnessFrom } from "./witness";

/**
 * What the auth module needs from this one (section 5, `auth.onSeen`): resolveSession calls `seen` when a session
 * resolved and `seenSignedOut` for a GET when none did. Both return at once; neither throws, and a failure of Valkey is
 * swallowed: counting never fails or slows a request.
 */
export type TransparencyForAuth = RecipientCounter;

/** The job's name: its lock is `job:transparency`, and its log lines carry it. */
export const TRANSPARENCY_JOB = "transparency";
/** Ten minutes between the end of one round and the start of the next (7.14). */
export const TRANSPARENCY_ROUND_MS = 10 * 60_000;

export interface CreateTransparencyOptions {
  apiDb: Db;
  /** Valkey, for the sketches and the salt. */
  redis: SketchStore;
  /** The auth module's one sender this module needs: the keeper's daily mail to HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL (section 5). */
  auth: AuthForTransparency;
  config: Pick<
    Config,
    "EDGE_PURGE" | "RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT" | "MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR" | "HEAD_WITNESS" | "HEAD_WITNESS_URL" | "APP_SITE" | "R1_CLASSIFIER" | "AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS" | "AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1" | "AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1_ACTS"
  >;
  logger: Logger;
  /** The clock of the counts and of the job's rounds; tests move it. The head's day is the database's own. */
  now?: () => Date;
  /** The head's witness in place of the one HEAD_WITNESS names; for tests (fakeWitness() is no https address). */
  witness?: WitnessAdapter;
}

/**
 * What one round of the job did: the months it closed, the editions it published once a day, and the head's pass, null
 * when the round ran none (before the dispatch hour, or once the day's value needs nothing more).
 */
export interface TransparencyRound {
  months: string[];
  editions: { year: number; version: number }[] | null;
  head: HeadPass | null;
}

export function createTransparency(options: CreateTransparencyOptions) {
  const now = options.now ?? (() => new Date());
  const log = options.logger;
  const repo = createTransparencyRepo(options.apiDb);
  const signedOut = options.config.RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT === "on";
  const forAuth: TransparencyForAuth = createRecipientCounter({ store: options.redis, signedOut, log, now });
  // HEAD_WITNESS's adapter; the configuration refused a test adapter on an open site, and the builder refuses it again.
  const witness = options.witness ?? witnessFrom(options.config);
  const head = { repo, witness, mailKeeper: options.auth.mailKeeper, log };
  // The UTC day of this process's last daily pass of the editions: one a day, after the dispatch hour. A restart runs it
  // again, which the editions' key makes harmless.
  let lastDaily: string | null = null;
  // The day whose first head pass ran (it alone looks for a missed day before), and the day whose value needs nothing
  // more: published, and witnessed or never to be. Until then each round passes again, so a witness that did not answer
  // is asked again in the day's later rounds.
  let headFirst: string | null = null;
  let headDone: string | null = null;

  async function round(): Promise<TransparencyRound> {
    const at = now();
    const months = await closeMonths({ store: options.redis, repo, signedOut }, at);
    if (months.length > 0) log.info({ job: TRANSPARENCY_JOB, months }, "transparency: the recipients' months were stored");
    const day = at.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    if (at.getUTCHours() < options.config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR) return { months, editions: null, head: null };
    let editions: TransparencyRound["editions"] = null;
    if (lastDaily !== day) {
      editions = (await publishEditions({ repo, log }, at)).published;
      lastDaily = day;
    }
    // After the editions, so the day's value covers an edition's audit row written in the same round.
    let pass: HeadPass | null = null;
    if (headDone !== day) {
      pass = await publishHead(head, { firstOfDay: headFirst !== day });
      headFirst = day;
      if (pass.done) headDone = day;
    }
    return { months, editions, head: pass };
  }

  return {
    /** The interface the auth module calls, registered with auth.onSeen in index.ts. */
    forAuth,
    /** The three public routes, mounted by app.ts at /api before the session's resolution. */
    routes: transparencyRoutes({ repo, facts: publicFacts(options.config) }),
    /** One round of the job, as the timer runs it; for tests. */
    round,
    /** Starts the job `transparency` and returns the function that stops it. */
    startJobs: (lock: JobLock) => createJob({ name: TRANSPARENCY_JOB, intervalMs: TRANSPARENCY_ROUND_MS, lockTtlMs: TRANSPARENCY_ROUND_MS * 2, lock, log, run: round }).start(),
  };
}

export type Transparency = ReturnType<typeof createTransparency>;

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { PublicFacts } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Config } from "../config";
import type { AppEnv } from "../env";
import { publicTransparency } from "./editions";
import { publicHead } from "./head";
import type { TransparencyRepo } from "./repo";

/**
 * The public answers (3d design, sections 9.1 and 10.6), mounted at /api after the global rate limit and before the
 * session's resolution (app.ts), as the page status is: neither reads a session, a cookie or a table of a person.
 *
 *   GET /api/public/facts         what is switched on now, read from memory, Cache-Control: no-cache, so /rules prints
 *                                 what runs now, also in the minute after a restart;
 *   GET /api/public/transparency  every year's editions from transparency_editions, Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600:
 *                                 nothing in it changes within a day;
 *   GET /api/public/head          the audit head's published values of the last HEAD_RULES.shownDays days (Task 5), public
 *                                 for an hour too: a day gains its value once, after the dispatch hour, and never the place.
 */

/**
 * The facts of the running server (10.6): booleans, names, days and numbers, never a token, a zone, a host or an address.
 * The comparison with known material is built by a later task and prints off until then; the edge prints its adapter
 * (Task 3), and the head's witness its own (Task 5), never its authority's address. A test adapter prints "on" and says it
 * is one. 3d Task 6: the R1 check prints its state (off; on and flagging; on and withholding, AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS), whether
 * it is the test scorer, and its two impact assessments' days, each in its own block; the model, its digest, its
 * threshold, its version and the publisher's claim stay null while no classifier is built in, which no build of 3d does.
 */
export function publicFacts(config: Pick<Config, "EDGE_PURGE" | "RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT" | "HEAD_WITNESS" | "R1_CLASSIFIER" | "AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS" | "AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1" | "AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1_ACTS">): PublicFacts {
  const r1On = config.R1_CLASSIFIER !== "off";
  return {
    r1: {
      state: !r1On ? "off" : config.AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS === "on" ? "withholds" : "flags",
      test: config.R1_CLASSIFIER === "test",
      model: null,
      digest: null,
      threshold: null,
      thresholdVersion: null,
      publisherClaim: null,
      dpia: config.AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1 ?? null,
      dpiaActs: config.AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1_ACTS ?? null,
    },
    match: { state: "off", test: false, source: null, dpia: null, dpiaActs: null },
    edge: { on: config.EDGE_PURGE !== "off", test: config.EDGE_PURGE === "test" },
    witness: { on: config.HEAD_WITNESS !== "off", test: config.HEAD_WITNESS === "test" },
    recipientsSignedOut: config.RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT === "on",
  };
}

export function transparencyRoutes(deps: { repo: Pick<TransparencyRepo, "editions" | "headDays">; facts: PublicFacts }) {
  const r = new Hono<AppEnv>();
  r.get("/public/facts", (c) => {
    c.header("Cache-Control", "no-cache");
    return c.json(deps.facts);
  });
  r.get("/public/transparency", async (c) => {
    const answer = publicTransparency(await deps.repo.editions());
    c.header("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=3600");
    return c.json(answer);
  });
  r.get("/public/head", async (c) => {
    const answer = publicHead(await deps.repo.headDays());
    c.header("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=3600");
    return c.json(answer);
  });
  return r;
}

const Paragraph = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => <Text className="mt-2 text-base leading-7 text-zinc-300">{children}</Text>;

/** One list of the page, its items read one by one. */
function List({ label, items }: { label: string; items: readonly string[] }) {
  return (
    <View role="list" aria-label={label} className="mt-1">
      {items.map((item) => (
        <Text key={item} role="listitem" className="mt-1 text-base leading-6 text-zinc-300">
          {`- ${item}`}
        </Text>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

/** The sections the terms build from STANDING_RULES and ORDER_RULES, which this page prints with the same builders. */
const NUMBERED_SECTIONS: { title: string; body: string }[] = [
  { title: "Strikes", body: STRIKES },
  { title: "Suspension and termination", body: SUSPENSION },
  { title: "Reporting in bad faith", body: REPORTING_IN_BAD_FAITH },
  { title: "Terrorist content", body: TERRORIST_CONTENT },
];

/**
 * The rules page as it reads with the facts it was given (3d design, section 9.2; W.1): the rules in force, what korbat
 * can do and when, what each automated tool does in the state the running server reports, and the change log. While the
 * facts are on their way the automation section holds its lead alone; when the route did not answer (`"down"`) the fixed
 * texts stand and it reads [page.down]: the page never prints a tool as off or on without the route's answer. `limits` are the program's caps, printed once a tool that rates or
 * compares images is on (their constant comes with the automated decision, Task 6).
 */
export function RulesView({ facts, limits = null }: { facts: PublicFacts | "loading" | "down"; limits?: AutomationLimits | null }) {
  const blocks = typeof facts === "string" ? [] : toolBlocks(facts);
  const anyImageTool = blocks.some((block) => (block.tool === "r1" || block.tool === "match") && block.on);
  return (
    <View>
      <Text accessibilityRole="header" className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-50">
        {RULES_PAGE.title}
      </Text>
      <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.lead}</Paragraph>

      <Heading level={2}>{RULES_PAGE.rulesHeading}</Heading>
      {RULES.map((rule) => (
        <View key={rule.id}>
          <Heading level={3}>{`${rule.id}: ${rule.title}`}</Heading>
          <Paragraph>{rule.text}</Paragraph>
          <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.allowed}</Paragraph>
          <List label={`${rule.id}: ${RULES_PAGE.allowed}`} items={rule.allowed} />
          <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.notAllowed}</Paragraph>
          <List label={`${rule.id}: ${RULES_PAGE.notAllowed}`} items={rule.notAllowed} />
        </View>
      ))}
      <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.law}</Paragraph>

      <Heading level={2}>{RULES_PAGE.measuresHeading}</Heading>
      <Paragraph>{MEASURES_PARAGRAPH}</Paragraph>
      {NUMBERED_SECTIONS.map((section) => (
        <View key={section.title}>
          <Heading level={3}>{section.title}</Heading>
          {termsParagraphs(section.body).map((paragraph, index) => (
            <Paragraph key={index}>{paragraph}</Paragraph>
          ))}
        </View>
      ))}

      <Heading level={2}>{RULES_PAGE.automationHeading}</Heading>
      <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.autoLead}</Paragraph>
      {facts === "loading" ? null : facts === "down" ? (
        <Paragraph>{PAGE_DOWN}</Paragraph>
      ) : (
        <View>
          {blocks.map((block) => (
            <View key={block.tool} role="group" className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 px-3 pb-3">
              {block.paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => (
                <Paragraph key={index}>{paragraph}</Paragraph>
              ))}
            </View>
          ))}
          {anyImageTool ? (
            limits === null ? null : (
              <>
                <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.autoCap(limits)}</Paragraph>
                <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.autoTarget(limits.objectionTargetHours)}</Paragraph>
              </>
            )
          ) : (
            <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.autoNone}</Paragraph>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      <Heading level={2}>{RULES_PAGE.versionHeading}</Heading>
      <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.version(RULES_VERSION)}</Paragraph>
      {[...RULES_CHANGES].reverse().map((change) => (
        <Paragraph key={change.version}>{RULES_PAGE.change(change)}</Paragraph>
      ))}

      <TextLink label={RULES_PAGE.transparencyLink} href="/transparency" />
      <TextLink label={RULES_PAGE.exploreLink} href="/explore/about" />
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * /rules (3d design, sections 9.1 and 9.2), public, signed in or out: it reads no session for its content and sends one
 * GET, /api/public/facts, which the API answers no-cache, so the page prints what is switched on now.
 */
export default function RulesPage() {
  const [facts, setFacts] = useState<PublicFacts | "loading" | "down">("loading");
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    api("/api/public/facts", { schema: PublicFacts })
      .then((answer) => {
        if (live) setFacts(answer);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (live) setFacts("down");
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);
  return (
    <AppShell>
      <ScrollView className="flex-1 bg-zinc-950" contentContainerClassName="px-4 pb-16 pt-6">
        <View className="w-full max-w-xl">
          {/* 3d Task 6: the program's caps and the target of an answer are the contracts' constants, which the database mirrors. */}
          <RulesView facts={facts} limits={AUTOMATION_RULES} />
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ScrollView, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { useLocalSearchParams } from "expo-router";
import type { DecisionView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { AppShell } from "@/components/AppShell";
import { DecisionDetail } from "@/components/moderation/DecisionDetail";
import { SettingsNav } from "@/components/SettingsNav";
import { ErrorText, Loading, TextLink } from "@/components/ui";
import { ApiError, errorMessage } from "@/lib/api";
import { moderation } from "@/lib/moderation";
import { CASES_WORDS, DECISION_WORDS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";

type Shown = { kind: "loading" } | { kind: "missing" } | { kind: "failed"; message: string } | { kind: "decision"; view: DecisionView };

/**
 * One decision (3c design, section 9), under Settings, Cases: the chip on a post and each row of "About you" lead here.
 * The API answers only for the account the decision is about and only for a decision that account was told of; anything
 * else reads as one sentence, whatever the id named.
 */
export default function Decision() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<Shown>({ kind: "loading" });

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setShown({ kind: "loading" });
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const view = await moderation.decision(id);
        if (!cancelled) setShown({ kind: "decision", view });
      } catch (err) {
        if (cancelled) return;
        // No decision of this account has the id, or the address held no id at all.
        if (err instanceof ApiError && (err.status === 404 || err.code === "invalid_request")) setShown({ kind: "missing" });
        else setShown({ kind: "failed", message: errorMessage(err) });
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [id]);

  /**
   * "Appeal": a POST for the decision in the address, with what its author wrote, if anything. The answer is the
   * decision as it now reads, with the appeal waiting, and the screen shows that. A refusal is thrown to the form, which
   * words it in place and keeps what was written.
   */
  async function appeal(statement: string) {
    setShown({ kind: "decision", view: await moderation.appeal(id, statement) });
  }

  /** 3d Task 6: "Ask for a person", as the appeal: the answer is the decision as it now reads, with the request sent. */
  async function ask(text: string) {
    setShown({ kind: "decision", view: await moderation.objection(id, text) });
  }

  return (
    <AppShell>
      <ScrollView contentContainerClassName="px-4 pb-16 pt-4">
        <Text accessibilityRole="header" className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-50">
          {CASES_WORDS.title}
        </Text>
        <SettingsNav current="cases" />
        <View className="mt-6 w-full max-w-xl">
          {shown.kind === "loading" ? <Loading /> : null}
          {shown.kind === "missing" ? <ErrorText message={DECISION_WORDS.notFound} /> : null}
          {shown.kind === "failed" ? <ErrorText message={shown.message} /> : null}
          {shown.kind === "decision" ? <DecisionDetail view={shown.view} onAppeal={appeal} onAsk={ask} /> : null}
          <TextLink label={DECISION_WORDS.back} href="/settings/cases" />
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

import { Link } from "expo-router";
import { MEASURES, type AccountStanding, type AuthorCaseRow, type AuthorNoticesPage, type ReportItem, type ReportsPage } from "@korbat/contracts";

import { AUTO_WORDS, CASES_WORDS, RELEASE_TEXTS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";
import { ORDER_TEXTS } from "@/lib/orders";
import { CASE_ROW_WORDS, bannerSentences, reportingLine, rowStrike, STANDING_TEXTS } from "@/lib/standing";
import { ItemLines } from "./ItemLines";

/** 3e: the kinds whose words in a row are the row's own (9.4), not the measure's label. */
const ROW_KINDS: Partial<Record<AuthorCaseRow["actions"][number], string>> = {
  overrule: CASE_ROW_WORDS.overrule,
  retire_handle: CASE_ROW_WORDS.retired,
  unretire_handle: CASE_ROW_WORDS.unretired,
  suspend: CASE_ROW_WORDS.suspended,
  lift_suspension: CASE_ROW_WORDS.lifted,
  // Task 5: a warning about the account's reports, and the lift of either reporting measure.
  warn_reporting: CASE_ROW_WORDS.warned,
  lift_reporting: CASE_ROW_WORDS.reportingLifted,
};

/**
 * 3e's review (people7; design, section 9.4): a suspension's or a termination's row and a lift's, in the row's own words
 * when the row says what they were: a suspension with its days and kind, a termination, a withdrawal for another measure,
 * the lift of a termination.
 */
function standingWords(row: AuthorCaseRow, kind: AuthorCaseRow["actions"][number]): string | null {
  const measure = row.standingMeasure;
  if ((kind === "suspend" || kind === "terminate") && measure !== undefined) {
    return measure.kind === "terminate" || measure.days === null ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.terminated : CASE_ROW_WORDS.suspendedFor(measure.days, measure.announced);
  }
  const lifted = row.liftedStanding;
  if (kind === "lift_suspension" && lifted !== undefined) return lifted.replaced ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.withdrawn : lifted.kind === "terminate" ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.terminationLifted : CASE_ROW_WORDS.lifted;
  return null;
}

/**
 * What a decision did, in the measures' own labels; a decision without a measure ended what was done while deciding, or
 * took no action. A review that kept the decision is worded by its outcome first: it lifts nothing, and the restriction
 * it answered stands; and so is a kept correction (3e's review, people3), korbat's answer to a reply that kept the
 * suspension or termination, which holds no row of its own.
 */
function done(row: AuthorCaseRow, now: Date): string {
  // 3f (design, section 9.3): an order's notice and the reinstatement after one, in the row's own words.
  if (row.order !== undefined) return ORDER_TEXTS.row[row.order];
  if ((row.kind === "review" || row.kind === "correction") && row.outcome === "kept") return CASES_WORDS.keptDecision;
  // 3e (design, section 9.4): a strike is named with where it stands, its overruling, a retirement and its reversal in
  // the row's own words.
  const labels: string[] = row.actions.map((kind) =>
    kind === "strike" && row.strike
      ? rowStrike(row.strike, now)
      : kind === "restrict_reporting" && row.reportingDays !== undefined
        ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.restricted(row.reportingDays)
        : (standingWords(row, kind) ?? ROW_KINDS[kind] ?? MEASURES[kind].label),
  );
  // Task 5: a reversal that ended a restriction of reporting resting on the decision it reversed says so; and (3e's
  // review, people7) one that ended a suspension or a termination.
  for (const ended of ["suspend", "terminate"] as const) if ((row.endedStanding ?? []).includes(ended)) labels.push(CASE_ROW_WORDS.standingEnded[ended]);
  if ((row.endedStanding ?? []).includes("restrict_reporting")) labels.push(CASE_ROW_WORDS.restrictionEnded);
  if (row.endedInterim) labels.push(CASES_WORDS.ended);
  return labels.length > 0 ? labels.join(", ") : CASES_WORDS.noAction;
}

/** Which kind of decision it is, where that is not plain from what it did. */
function kindWords(row: AuthorCaseRow): string | null {
  if (row.kind === "interim") return CASES_WORDS.whileDeciding;
  if (row.kind === "review") return CASES_WORDS.review;
  if (row.kind === "correction") return CASES_WORDS.correction;
  return null;
}

/**
 * "About you" (3c design, section 9): the decisions about the account that its holder was told of, newest first. Each
 * row is a link to the decision's screen and says what it is about (the post, by its creation time, or the profile), the
 * decision's day, what was done, the rule or the law, and where its appeal stands.

export function DecisionsList({ decisions, now = new Date() }: { decisions: readonly AuthorCaseRow[]; now?: Date }) {
  if (decisions.length === 0) return <Text className="px-4 py-8 text-base text-zinc-400">{CASES_WORDS.noDecisions}</Text>;
  return (
    <View>
      {decisions.map((row) => {
        const kind = kindWords(row);
        return (
          <Link key={row.id} href={`/settings/cases/${row.id}`} asChild>
            <Pressable className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
              <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">{row.post ? CASES_WORDS.post(utcMinute(row.post.createdAt)) : CASES_WORDS.profile}</Text>
              <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-400">
                {/* 3f's review (people9): an order's row shows the day its author was told, which the list sorts it by. */}
                {row.toldOn !== undefined ? ORDER_TEXTS.row.toldOn(row.toldOn) : CASES_WORDS.decidedOn(row.decidedOn)}
                {kind ? ` (${kind})` : ""}
              </Text>
              {/* 3d Task 6 (section 9.6): a decision a program took says so; a person's later decision is its own row. */}
              <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{row.byProgram === true ? AUTO_WORDS.row(done(row, now)) : done(row, now)}</Text>
              {/* 3f: an order's row names no rule and no law of korbat's judgement. */}
              {row.order === undefined && (row.ruleId || row.legal) ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{row.ruleId ? CASES_WORDS.rule(row.ruleId) : CASES_WORDS.law}</Text> : null}
              {row.appealUntil ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.appealOpen(utcMinute(row.appealUntil))}</Text> : null}
              {row.appeal ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.appealState[row.appeal]}</Text> : null}
              {row.reversedOn ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.reversed(row.reversedOn)}</Text> : null}
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, section 9.6): the notices about the account's posts that are not decisions, in "About you" above
 * its decisions, newest first: "Sealed images released", each with its day and a link to its notice. A release whose
 * notice may not be told yet is in no answer, so it is in no list. Nothing is shown while there is none.
 */
export function NoticesList({ notices }: { notices: AuthorNoticesPage["notices"] }) {
  if (notices.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <View className="border-b border-zinc-800">
      <Text accessibilityRole="header" aria-level={2} className="px-4 pt-3 text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">
        {RELEASE_TEXTS.noticesTitle}
      </Text>

          </Pressable>
        </Link>

}

/**
 * "Your standing" (3e design, section 9.4), above "About you": how many of the account's strikes count now, and what that
 * many leads to; then the line of a suspension or a termination that /me carries, not fixed yet, announced, held by a
 * reply or running, in the banner's words (3e's review, people7); and (Task 5) [cases.reporting]: a restriction of the
 * account's reports that runs, or a warning about them that counts.
 */
export function StandingBlock({ activeStrikes, standing = null }: { activeStrikes: number; standing?: AccountStanding | null }) {
  const measure = bannerSentences(standing);
  const reporting = reportingLine(standing);

    <View className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">

        </View>

    </View>
  );

import { Image } from "expo-image";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { Link } from "expo-router";
import { OBJECTION_TEXT_MAX, STATEMENT_MAX, type DecisionAppeal, type DecisionContent, type DecisionStatement, type DecisionView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ORDER_NOTICE, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import { Button, ErrorText, Field, Section } from "@/components/ui";
import { SEALED_IMAGE } from "@/components/social/HiddenImage";
import { clampRatio } from "@/components/social/MediaGrid";
import { API_BASE } from "@/lib/api";
import { errorMessage } from "@/lib/api";
import { appealWaitWords, CONTACT_EMAIL, dailyLimitFailure, utcMinute } from "@/lib/moderation";
import { AUTO_WORDS, CASES_WORDS, DECISION_WORDS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";
import { ORDER_TEXTS } from "@/lib/orders";
import { nowSentence, replyStandsLine, reportingNowLine, restsOnLine, STANDING_TEXTS, standingMeasureOf, strikeLine } from "@/lib/standing";

const Line = ({ children, strong = false }: { children: string; strong?: boolean }) => <Text className={`mt-3 text-base leading-6 ${strong ? "font-semibold text-zinc-100" : "text-zinc-200"}`}>{children}</Text>;
const Note = ({ children }: { children: string }) => <Text className="mt-3 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{children}</Text>;

/** One field of an account as korbat copied it. */
function FieldValue({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <Text className="mt-3 text-base leading-6 text-zinc-200">
      <Text className="font-semibold text-zinc-100">{label}</Text> {value.length > 0 ? value : DECISION_WORDS.empty}
    </Text>
  );
}

/**
 * The content a decision was made on, or the reason it is not shown (3c design, section 7.6). A post's text is never
 * sealed, so it stands beside its sealed images, each drawn as the placeholder that tells the author nobody is shown it.
 * The images of a post its author deleted are kept for the case and shown to nobody. Every other image comes from the
 * app's own image route, which serves the author their withheld and removed images too.
 */
function Content({ content }: { content: DecisionContent }) {
  if (content.kind === "r4_redacted") return <Note>{DECISION_WORDS.r4Redacted}</Note>;
  if (content.kind === "erased") return <Note>{content.postKept ? `${DECISION_WORDS.erased(content.contentErasedOn)} ${DECISION_WORDS.postKept}` : DECISION_WORDS.erased(content.contentErasedOn)}</Note>;
  if (content.kind === "account") {
    return (
      <View>
        <FieldValue label={DECISION_WORDS.handle} value={`@${content.handle}`} />
        <FieldValue label={DECISION_WORDS.displayName} value={content.displayName} />
        <FieldValue label={DECISION_WORDS.bio} value={content.bio} />
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View>
      {content.deletedByAuthor ? <Note>{DECISION_WORDS.deleted}</Note> : null}
      {content.body.length > 0 ? <Line>{content.body}</Line> : <Note>{DECISION_WORDS.noText}</Note>}
      {content.imagesHidden === "sealed"
        ? Array.from({ length: content.imageCount }, (_, index) => (
            <View key={index} className="mt-3 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-6">
              <Text className="text-center text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{SEALED_IMAGE}</Text>
            </View>
          ))
        : null}
      {content.imagesHidden === "deleted_by_author" && content.imageCount > 0 ? <Note>{DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages}</Note> : null}
      {content.images.map((image) => (
        <View key={image.id} className="mt-3">
          <View className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-800" style={{ aspectRatio: clampRatio(image.width, image.height) }}>
            {/* On the web expo-image takes the <img alt> from accessibilityLabel, not from alt. */}
            <Image source={{ uri: `${API_BASE}${image.small}` }} contentFit="cover" accessibilityLabel={image.alt} style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }} />
          </View>
          <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-300">{image.alt}</Text>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * The statement's paragraphs, or null when this build's rulebook does not hold the version the decision was made under: it
 * is then never rendered as another. An order's notice (3f) reads its authority's words and its erasure fresh with it.
 */
function paragraphsOf(view: DecisionStatement & Partial<Pick<DecisionView, "orderTexts" | "erasedOn">>): string[] | null {
  try {
    return statementParagraphs(view, { texts: view.orderTexts ?? null, erasedOn: view.erasedOn ?? null });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** The authority's words a notice holds, each under its label (W.2), in the order the notice names them. */
function authorityWords(view: DecisionView): { label: string; text: string }[] {
  const texts = view.orderTexts ?? null;
  if (texts === null) return [];
  const labelled: [string | null, string][] = [
    [texts.reasons, ORDER_NOTICE.reasonsLabel],
    [texts.redress, ORDER_NOTICE.redressLabel],
    [texts.scope, ORDER_NOTICE.scopeLabel],
  ];
  return labelled.flatMap(([text, label]) => (text === null ? [] : [{ label, text }]));
}

/**
 * 3f (design, section 9.3): the notice of an authority's order, and of the reinstatement after one. Its title says what it
 * is; its paragraphs are ORDER_NOTICE's, rendered by statementParagraphs from the statement's data read fresh; the
 * authority's words stand whole in a block of their own; the post is never shown while the order's measure stands; and no
 * appeal is offered: in its place, where the order can be challenged, how korbat's own mistake is put right, and that
 * the notice grows.
 */
function OrderNotice({ view }: { view: DecisionView }) {
  const paragraphs = paragraphsOf(view);
  const words = authorityWords(view);
  return (
    <View role="article">
      <Text accessibilityRole="header" aria-level={1} className="text-lg font-semibold text-zinc-50">
        {ORDER_TEXTS.notice.title}
      </Text>
      {view.post ? <Text className="mt-1 text-base text-zinc-300">{DECISION_WORDS.post(utcMinute(view.post.createdAt))}</Text> : null}
      <View className="mt-2">{paragraphs ? paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => <Line key={index}>{paragraph}</Line>) : <Note>{DECISION_WORDS.cannotRender}</Note>}</View>
      {words.length > 0 ? (
        <View role="group" aria-label={ORDER_NOTICE.wordsBlock} className="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 px-3 pb-3">
          <Text className="mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-300">{ORDER_NOTICE.wordsBlock}</Text>
          {words.map((entry) => (
            <View key={entry.label}>
              <Line strong>{entry.label}</Line>
              <Line>{entry.text}</Line>
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      ) : null}
      {view.content === null ? (
        // 3f's review (people5): a DSA order that does not withhold leaves the post to its author, and the note says so.
        <Note>{view.order?.withholdAuthor === false ? ORDER_TEXTS.notice.noContentRemoved : ORDER_TEXTS.notice.noContent}</Note>
      ) : (
        <Section title={DECISION_WORDS.content}>
          <Content content={view.content} />
        </Section>
      )}
      <Note>{ORDER_TEXTS.notice.noAppeal}</Note>
      {view.kind === "order" ? <Note>{ORDER_TEXTS.notice.wrongItem(CONTACT_EMAIL)}</Note> : null}
      <Note>{ORDER_TEXTS.notice.fresh}</Note>
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * The appeal's form (3c design, section 9): an optional statement, free of form, and the button. The request is a POST
 * the screen sends; a refusal is worded under the button, and what was written stays.
 */
function AppealForm({ onAppeal }: { onAppeal: (statement: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  const [statement, setStatement] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function send() {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await onAppeal(statement);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(dailyLimitFailure(err, "appeals"));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <View>
      <Note>{DECISION_WORDS.appealHint}</Note>
      <Field label={DECISION_WORDS.appealStatement} value={statement} onChangeText={setStatement} multiline maxLength={STATEMENT_MAX} />
      <Button label={DECISION_WORDS.appeal} onPress={() => void send()} busy={busy} />
      <ErrorText message={error} />
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * An answered appeal: the day, and the statement of the decision that answered it (the review, or the correction that
 * reversed everything before a review came), rendered as every statement is, with a link to that decision's own screen.
 */
function AppealAnswer({ appeal }: { appeal: Extract<DecisionAppeal, { state: "answered" }> }) {
  const paragraphs = paragraphsOf(appeal.statement);
  return (
    <View>
      <Line strong>{DECISION_WORDS.appealAnswered(appeal.answeredOn)}</Line>
      <Note>{DECISION_WORDS.appealAnswer}</Note>
      {paragraphs ? paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => <Line key={index}>{paragraph}</Line>) : <Note>{DECISION_WORDS.cannotRender}</Note>}
      <Link href={`/settings/cases/${appeal.answeredBy}`} asChild>
        <Pressable className="mt-3 self-start">
          <Text className="text-sm text-sky-400 underline">{DECISION_WORDS.answerScreen}</Text>
        </Pressable>
      </Link>
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * Where the appeal of a decision stands (3c design, sections 7.7 and 9), the first that applies: the answer to an appeal
 * that was answered; for one that waits, that it waits for a reviewer, or why nobody at korbat can review it now; while
 * none was filed, until when one can be, with the form when the screen can send it; or that a restriction reversed in
 * full leaves nothing to appeal.
 */
function Appeal({ view, onAppeal }: { view: DecisionView; onAppeal?: (statement: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  const { appeal } = view;
  if (appeal?.state === "answered") return <AppealAnswer appeal={appeal} />;
  if (appeal?.state === "pending") {
    return (
      <View>
        <Line>{DECISION_WORDS.appealFiled(appeal.filedAt.slice(0, 10))}</Line>
        <Line strong>{appealWaitWords(view) ?? DECISION_WORDS.appealWaiting}</Line>
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (view.appealUntil) {
    return (
      <View>
        <Line>{DECISION_WORDS.appealUntil(utcMinute(view.appealUntil))}</Line>
        {onAppeal ? <AppealForm onAppeal={onAppeal} /> : null}
      </View>
    );
  }
  return <Line>{DECISION_WORDS.reversed(view.reversedOn ?? "")}</Line>;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 6 (design, sections 7.10 and 9.4): "Ask for a person" on a program's decision, from DecisionView.askPerson read
 * fresh: the button while the measure is in force and no request exists, which opens one field under [auto.askLead]; the
 * request as sent with korbat's published target ([auto.asked]); and once a person has decided, [auto.decided] with a
 * link to that decision. A refusal is worded under the button and what was written stays; objection_not_open reads as
 * [auto.decided] without the day. A suspended account can ask: nothing here reads its standing.
 */
function AskPerson({ view, onAsk }: { view: DecisionView; onAsk?: (text: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  const ask = view.askPerson ?? null;
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  if (ask === null) return null;

  async function send() {
    if (busy || onAsk === undefined) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await onAsk(text);
    } catch (err) {
      // objection_not_open and rate_limited in the app's own words (9.7), anything else as elsewhere.
      setError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Section title={AUTO_WORDS.ask}>
      {ask.state === "asked" ? (
        <View>
          <Line strong>{AUTO_WORDS.asked(utcMinute(ask.createdAt))}</Line>
          <Line>{ask.text}</Line>
        </View>
      ) : null}
      {ask.state === "decided" ? (
        <View>
          <Line strong>{AUTO_WORDS.decided(utcMinute(ask.decidedAt))}</Line>
          <DecisionLink id={ask.decisionId} label={AUTO_WORDS.decidedLink} />
        </View>
      ) : null}
      {ask.state === "open" && onAsk !== undefined ? (
        open ? (
          <View>
            <Note>{AUTO_WORDS.askLead}</Note>
            <Field label={AUTO_WORDS.askField} value={text} onChangeText={setText} multiline maxLength={OBJECTION_TEXT_MAX} />
            <Button label={AUTO_WORDS.ask} onPress={() => void send()} busy={busy} />
            <ErrorText message={error} />
          </View>
        ) : (
          <Button label={AUTO_WORDS.ask} onPress={() => setOpen(true)} />
        )
      ) : null}
    </Section>
  );
}

/** A link to another decision's screen, as a line of its own. */
function DecisionLink({ id, label }: { id: string; label: string }) {
  return (
    <Link href={`/settings/cases/${id}`} asChild>
      <Pressable className="mt-3 self-start">
        <Text className="text-sm text-sky-400 underline">{label}</Text>
      </Pressable>
    </Link>
  );
}

/** The states in which a measure ended before its time, by a decision the block links to. */
const ENDED_BY_A_DECISION = new Set(["never", "lifted", "basis_ended"]);

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 9.2): "Where it stands now", under the statement of a decision that holds a suspension or a
 * termination, from DecisionView.standing read fresh: the sentence of its state, with a link to the decision that ended
 * it before its time; the strikes it rests on (or the decision, for a measure taken at once), each a link to its own
 * screen; "Reply" while the reply is open; and once the person replied, their text while korbat keeps it and where the
 * reply stands.
 */
function StandingNow({ view }: { view: DecisionView }) {
  const standing = view.standing;
  const measure = standingMeasureOf(view);
  if (standing === null || measure === null) return null;
  const protective = measure.basis === "protective";
  const strikes = standing.restsOn.filter((entry) => entry.state !== null);
  const decisions = standing.restsOn.filter((entry) => entry.state === null);
  const reply = standing.reply;
  const stands = replyStandsLine(standing);
  return (
    <Section title={STANDING_TEXTS.now.title}>
      <Line strong>{nowSentence(standing, measure.kind, protective, view.appealUntil)}</Line>
      {ENDED_BY_A_DECISION.has(standing.state) && standing.endedBy !== null ? <DecisionLink id={standing.endedBy} label={STANDING_TEXTS.now.endedBy} /> : null}
      {strikes.map((entry) => (
        <DecisionLink key={entry.decisionId} id={entry.decisionId} label={restsOnLine(entry)} />
      ))}
      {strikes.length > 0 ? <Note>{STANDING_TEXTS.rests.hint}</Note> : null}
      {decisions.map((entry) => (
        <DecisionLink key={entry.decisionId} id={entry.decisionId} label={protective ? STANDING_TEXTS.rests.seal(entry.decidedAt) : STANDING_TEXTS.rests.decision(entry.decidedAt)} />
      ))}
      {decisions.length > 0 ? <Note>{protective ? `${STANDING_TEXTS.rests.basis} ${STANDING_TEXTS.rests.basisProtective}` : STANDING_TEXTS.rests.basis}</Note> : null}
      {standing.replyOpen ? (
        <Link href={`/settings/cases/${view.id}/reply`} asChild>
          <Pressable accessibilityRole="button" className="mt-4 self-start rounded-lg border border-zinc-500 px-4 py-2">
            <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">{STANDING_TEXTS.reply.button}</Text>
          </Pressable>
        </Link>
      ) : null}
      {reply ? (
        <View>
          <Line>{STANDING_TEXTS.reply.replied(reply.filedAt)}</Line>
          {reply.text !== null ? <Line>{reply.text}</Line> : reply.erasedAt !== null ? <Note>{STANDING_TEXTS.reply.erased(reply.erasedAt)}</Note> : null}
          {stands ? <Line>{stands.text}</Line> : null}
          {stands?.link ? <DecisionLink id={stands.link} label={STANDING_TEXTS.reply.answer} /> : null}
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </Section>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e Task 5 (design, section 9.2): "Where it stands now" under the statement of a decision that restricts the account's
 * reports, from DecisionView.reportingStanding read fresh, since it can end before its date: it runs, it ended, korbat
 * lifted it, or it ended with the warning it rested on; the last two link to the decision that did it.
 */
function ReportingNow({ view }: { view: DecisionView }) {
  const standing = view.reportingStanding ?? null;
  if (standing === null) return null;
  const line = reportingNowLine(standing);
  return (
    <Section title={STANDING_TEXTS.reporting.title}>
      <Line strong>{line.text}</Line>
      {line.link !== null ? <DecisionLink id={line.link} label={STANDING_TEXTS.now.endedBy} /> : null}
    </Section>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 9.2): what the appeal of a standing measure adds above D 9's control: [appeal.early] while an
 * announced measure has not started, [appeal.again] after a kept answer to a reply sent before the start, and
 * [terminate.delete] beside a termination's appeal.
 */
function StandingAppealNotes({ view }: { view: DecisionView }) {
  const standing = view.standing;
  const measure = standingMeasureOf(view);
  if (standing === null || measure === null) return null;
  const open = view.appealUntil !== null && view.appeal === null;
  const notStarted = standing.state === "unfixed" || standing.state === "announced" || standing.state === "held";
  const reply = standing.reply;
  const keptAfterReply = reply !== null && reply.onTime && reply.answeredAt !== null && !ENDED_BY_A_DECISION.has(standing.state);
  return (
    <View>
      {open && notStarted ? <Note>{STANDING_TEXTS.appeal.early}</Note> : null}
      {open && keptAfterReply && reply.answeredAt !== null && view.appealUntil !== null ? <Line>{STANDING_TEXTS.appeal.again(reply.answeredAt, view.appealUntil)}</Line> : null}
      {measure.kind === "terminate" && (open || view.appeal?.state === "pending") ? <Note>{STANDING_TEXTS.terminateDelete}</Note> : null}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * One decision as its author reads it (3c design, section 9): the statement of reasons, rendered by the same function
 * that rendered its mail, from the same data; what the decision is about and the content it was made on; and where its
 * appeal stands. A decision that ends or lifts a field reset links the decision that reset the field while korbat still
 * keeps the old value there. With `onAppeal` a decision that can still be appealed carries the appeal's form.
 */
export function DecisionDetail({ view, onAppeal, onAsk }: { view: DecisionView; onAppeal?: (statement: string) => Promise<void>; onAsk?: (text: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  // 3f: an order's notice, and the reinstatement after one, render as a notice and offer no appeal.
  if (view.order) return <OrderNotice view={view} />;
  const paragraphs = paragraphsOf(view);
  // The decisions whose screens still show a reset field's old value: of the resets this decision lifts, and of those that ended with it.
  const resets = [...new Set([...view.reversals, ...view.endedMeasures].flatMap((entry) => (entry.oldValueKept && entry.resetDecisionId ? [entry.resetDecisionId] : [])))];
  return (
    <View>
      {/* The screen's own title is "Cases": this heading and the sections under it are one level below it. */}
      <Text accessibilityRole="header" aria-level={2} className="text-lg font-semibold text-zinc-50">
        {DECISION_WORDS.title}
      </Text>
      <Text className="mt-1 text-base text-zinc-300">{view.post ? DECISION_WORDS.post(utcMinute(view.post.createdAt)) : CASES_WORDS.profile}</Text>
      {/* 3d Task 6 (section 9.4): [auto.chip] beside the day of a decision a program took; nothing on a post says "program". */}
      {view.automatedDecision === "fully" ? <Text className="mt-1 self-start rounded border border-zinc-600 px-2 py-0.5 text-sm text-zinc-200">{`${AUTO_WORDS.chip}, ${view.decidedAt.slice(0, 10)}`}</Text> : null}

      <Section title={DECISION_WORDS.statement}>
        {paragraphs ? paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => <Line key={index}>{paragraph}</Line>) : <Note>{DECISION_WORDS.cannotRender}</Note>}
        {/* 3d (design, section 9.1): after the rule a statement names, its own or the reviewed decision's, the rules page. */}
        {(view.ruleId ?? view.reviewed?.ruleId ?? null) !== null ? (
          <Link href="/rules" asChild>
            <Pressable className="mt-3 self-start">
              <Text className="text-sm text-sky-400 underline">{DECISION_WORDS.rulesPage}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        ) : null}
        {/* 3e (design, section 9.2): where the strike this decision gave stands now, read fresh. */}
        {view.strike ? <Line strong>{strikeLine(view.strike)}</Line> : null}
        {resets.map((decisionId) => (
          <Link key={decisionId} href={`/settings/cases/${decisionId}`} asChild>
            <Pressable className="mt-3 self-start">
              <Text className="text-sm text-sky-400 underline">{DECISION_WORDS.resetDecision}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </Section>

      <AskPerson view={view} onAsk={onAsk} />
      <StandingNow view={view} />
      <ReportingNow view={view} />

      <Section title={DECISION_WORDS.content}>
        {view.content === null ? <Note>{ORDER_TEXTS.notice.noContent}</Note> : <Content content={view.content} />}
      </Section>

      {view.appeal || view.appealUntil || view.reversedOn ? (
        <Section title={DECISION_WORDS.appeal}>
          <StandingAppealNotes view={view} />
          <Appeal view={view} onAppeal={onAppeal} />
        </Section>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

You can still report illegal content: choose "It is illegal". For the sexual abuse or exploitation of a child, choose the third answer.',

  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  not_found: "That no longer exists.",
  internal: "Something went wrong on our side. Try again.",
